Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

 

Team

As a French tech leader and global successful company, our Talent Acquisition teams are constantly looking for ways to innovate and increase organization efficiency to keep Voodoo ahead of the market. The main focus of the team is to understand how the business strategy will impact our hiring plan, and provide support to find and attract our new talents.

 

You will work hand in hand with our Growth team, which is a transversal entity aiming to maximize and deliver the potential of any mobile product. It combines user acquisition, creative content production, monetization, and the tech capabilities required to turn applications into global hits. With over 150 experts, we operate at the forefront of mobile marketing and ad tech across various types of games (hypercasual, hybrid, 100% IAP).

 

You will be working on highly scalable mobile games, played by millions of people. You will be part of a small and high-performing team and will have the opportunity to grow your skills by hiring A-Players all around the world.

 

Role

Join us as Voodoo's very first Talent Sourcer, embedded in the Growth BU (for both Gaming and Consumer Applications). In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and building strong relationships with top passive talent to fuel the Growth team's hiring across a wide range of profiles — from Marketing specialist, Artist, Developers, etc.

  • Design and execute proactive sourcing strategies tailored to each role, going far beyond LinkedIn Recruiter — think communities, newsletters, events, niche forums, conference speaker lists, and creative outreach

  • Write sharp, personalized, and compelling outreach messages that spark genuine interest and reflect Voodoo's culture and ambitions

  • Build and maintain active talent pools and pipelines for current and future hiring needs, with a strong focus on nurturing long-term relationships

  • Conduct in-depth market mapping to understand talent landscapes, track competitor moves, and identify where the best profiles are and how to reach them

  • Balance volume and quality: manage multiple searches simultaneously while maintaining a high bar for candidate relevance and experience

  • Leverage AI tools and automation (e.g. Claude, ATS) to enhance sourcing efficiency, personalize outreach at scale, and track performance

  • Track and analyze sourcing metrics and iterate on your sourcing strategy

  • Partner closely with recruiters and hiring managers to deeply understand role requirements, team culture and what makes a profile truly stand out - Conducting screening calls might also be a possibility

  • Continuously benchmark sourcing practices and bring fresh, outside-the-box ideas to attract hard-to-reach talent

 

Profile

  • Proven experience in talent sourcing, recruiting, or a research-intensive role — ideally in a fast-paced tech or gaming environment

  • Resourceful and creative: you think beyond LinkedIn and know how to find talent where others don't look

  • Strong written communication skills — you craft outreach messages that people actually want to reply to

  • Proficient with modern sourcing tools and AI and always looking for what's next

  • Strategic thinker: you build and nurture pipelines proactively, not just reactively

  • Data-driven and organized, with the ability to juggle volume and quality across multiple searches at once

  • Collaborative and curious, with a genuine interest in understanding talent markets and staying ahead of trends

jobs.title: Broker Partnerships Lead
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Your mission

Brokers play a structural role in how large and very large employers select, negotiate, and manage their health and prévoyance coverage. We're looking for a Broker Partnerships Lead to build and animate Alan's relationships with the brokers who operate in the Enterprise segment, turning Alan into a trusted, credible, and commercially compelling partner for those actors, and supporting our Enterprise Sales and Key Account Management teams.

⭐ Location

On-site in Paris, Île-de-France.

What makes this role genuinely unique

  • You'll shape how one of Europe's fastest-growing health insurance companies builds its relationships with the brokers operating in the large and very large employer segment across France, and beyond.

  • You'll have real ownership from day one and operate at the highest levels of the broker market.

  • You'll shape Alan’s broker strategy and execute it. Alan is at an early stage of building this capability. The playbook is yours to define and scale.

  • You'll work directly with Alan's Enterprise Sales, Key Account Management, Insurance, and Executive Leadership.

⭐ Your role

Relationships & Presence

  • Build and maintain trusted, long-term relationships with the brokers that sit between us and the largest employers in our markets (whether private or public), at senior and managing director level.

  • Map the ecosystem, prioritize interlocutors, and design Alan's engagement strategy.

  • Be the consistent Alan voice that brokers recognize: someone who shows up, follows through, and is known as easy to deal with without giving away what shouldn't be given.

Partnership with Alan's Enterprise & Commercial work

  • Be a partner to our Enterprise Sales and KAM teams on every broker situation: drive strategic decisions deal by deal and turn ecosystem knowledge into commercial leverage.

  • Introduce the right broker contacts at the right moment in the commercial cycle, transforming relationship capital into pipeline access on large and very large accounts.

  • Share Alan's value and positioning with broker partners to help them understand, represent, and actively promote Alan within their client portfolios.

  • Hold the line on our non-negotiables while finding creative ways to make the collaboration work for both sides.

Sector Engagement & Anticipation

  • Follow the broker market at deal level and ecosystem level: who is growing, who is consolidating, where portfolio shifts are happening, and what it means for Alan's pipeline and positioning.

  • Be a sharp, early internal voice on where the broker market is heading and on the implications for Alan's strategy, including on consolidation, regulation, and competitive dynamics.

Build & Scale

  • Knowledge base: Build and maintain a knowledge library on broker positions, portfolio footprints, engagement history, and contractual frameworks shared with Enterprise Sales and KAM teams to increase win rates.

  • Framework & tools: Implement processes and AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of our broker engagement and contract documentation (conventions de courtage, commission tracking, data sharing agreements).

  • Collaboration: Share best practices with the broader Enterprise & Commercial team and contribute proven methodologies to their scaled commercial operations.

jobs.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

📈 Finance community at Alan

Finance & Strategy exists to enable better decisions, faster, at every level of the company, in a regulated, diverse and ever changing business.

We succeed when ambitious goals become credible plans, when strategic bets are grounded in financial reality, and when the entire company (not just Finance!) speaks the language of performance.

We set the right ambition, we monitor whether we're getting there, and we raise our hand when something needs to change.

We are not record-keepers. We are builders, partners, and challengers. We are looking for people who want to build, support decision making processes and challenge the status quo.

 

The core responsibilities of the Finance & Strategy community are:

  • Strategy & Planning: steers Alan's financial performance through business planning, financial and operational monitoring, investor relations and financing

  • Financial Reporting: is the steward of Alan's financial truth, ensuring that we produce accurate, timely financial data. It owns the reporting to all key stakeholders (board, leadership team, tax authorities, and regulators like the ACPR) and ensures that financial data is the single, uncontested source of truth for the company's performance.

  • Finance Data and Operations: Build and own the core finance data and tooling infrastructure (models, pipelines, and concepts that connect business operations to financial reality). This is where Finance meets product thinking

  • Functional poles with end-to-end ownership of their domain: Treasury, Procurement, M&A

⭐️ Your mission ⭐️

We are looking for a rigorous and hands-on accountant to help shape and run Alan's closing production process.

You will be part of our Financial Reporting area, focusing on Financial production. This area ensures that every number in our books is accurate, timely, and trustworthy, and serves as the source of truth for all financial decisions across the company.

  • Account and bank reconciliation: maintain clean, up-to-date reconciliations across all balance sheet accounts and entities on a daily basis;

  • Contribute to finance transformation and system improvements: identify manual or repetitive tasks and collaborate with Financial Data to drive automation and reduce closing friction over time ; translate new business streams and P&L lines into accounting (acting as an interface between business teams and Finance)

  • Tax and statutory compliance: prepare and file VAT returns, URSSAF declarations, and other statutory filings accurately and on time; coordinate with external advisors where needed

  • Languages: full fluency in French and English

  • Deep command of French accounting standards: VAT rules, URSSAF declarations, bank reconciliation, general ledger management, and month-end close processes

  • Process-driven: you naturally question how things are done and come with concrete ideas to improve them

🤝 Qui nous sommes

Chez Moka.Care nous réinventons la façon de voir la santé mentale en entreprise. Nous croyons en des équipes qui se sentent bien pour une organisation saine.
Concrètement, Moka.Care offre une solution complète de prévention en santé mentale :
Nous accompagnons les salariés avec des sessions individuelles, une application de self-care et un outil de micro-learning intégré à Slack et Teams.
Nous aidons les équipes RH avec une interface de data analytics automatisée et des conseils personnalisés d'experts.
Où en sommes-nous actuellement ? Depuis décembre 2019, plus de 400 entreprises, dont L'Oréal, Spendesk et Engie, ont rejoint Moka.Care, bénéficiant à plus de 300 000 collaborateurs dans le monde entier. Nous avons levé 17,5 millions d'euros auprès d'investisseurs et de business angels de premier rang.
Notre croyance fondamentale : l'excellence in care est notre obsession.
La culture d'entreprise, ce n'est pas juste des jolis mots que l'on affiche sur les murs. Nous incarnons des valeurs tangibles : l’empathie comme fondement, un optimisme insatiable, une responsabilité partagée et de l’agilité.
 

🧑‍💻 Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi 

Au sein de l’équipe Marketing & Communication, et sous la responsabilité de Pauline, Responsable Communication & Marketing Produit, tu auras pour objectifs principaux de :

  • Satisfaire et engager nos clients en communiquant sur nos innovations, en créant des supports et argumentaires pour nos consultants, et en coordonnant des événements pour notre communauté RH.
  • Augmenter l’adoption de notre produit par nos utilisateurs (les salariés des entreprises clientes de Moka.Care) en créant des visuels percutants et en accompagnant nos consultants sur le terrain.
  • Développer la notoriété de Moka.Care, en contribuant à des campagnes créatives et impactantes, qui valorisent notre expertise et notre raison d’être.
Tu travailleras en collaboration très étroite avec nos consultants qui accompagnent nos clients au quotidien.
 

👉 Tes futures missions 

Engagement clients

  • Animer notre communauté de DRH via des événements premium : Club RH (Take.Care Connect), soirée d'été, webinars clients centrés sur le produit Moka...
  • Partager les nouvelles fonctionnalités et nouvelles offres à nos clients via des newsletters, des emails et des communications dans la plateforme RH.
  • Créer des slides et des éléments de langage précis pour aider nos consultants à vendre nos offres et présenter nos nouveautés.

Engagement utilisateurs

  • Participer aux événements de lancement et stands dans les entreprises pour présenter Moka.Care aux salariés.
  • Créer des posters, des vidéos, des goodies et tous types de supports visuels pour donner envie aux salariés d’utiliser Moka.Care.
  • Communiquer auprès de nos utilisateurs sur les atouts de l'app et ses nouvelles fonctionnalités, via des emails dédiés, des notifications in-app...

Notoriété et thought leadership

  • Rédiger des communiqués de presse et des tribunes pour renforcer la visibilité médiatique de Moka.Care.
  • Produire des contenus (interviews vidéos, pages du site, slides...) pour valoriser nos histoires clients.
  • Participer à l'élaboration de campagnes de marque et d'actions d'influence pour faire rayonner notre expertise auprès de décideurs stratégiques.
 
L'entraide est très importante chez Moka.
De temps en temps, tu prêteras main forte aux autres membres de l'équipe Marketing & Communication sur des projets divers, par exemple : aider à l’organisation d’événements et webinaires de prospection, créer des contenus pour le blog, le site ou Linkedin...

📇 Tu es la personne idéale si 

  • Tu as au moins 2 à 3 ans d’expérience en communication externe et/ou interne.
  • Tu es à l'aise à l'oral, et sais adapter ton discours à des interlocuteurs corporate exigeants.
  • Tu sais piloter des projets en autonomie, organiser tes priorités et prendre des initiatives.
  • Tu fais preuve de professionnalisme et d’un vrai sens de l’esthétique dans les contenus visuels que tu crées.
  • Tu maîtrises un ou plusieurs outils de design (nous utilisons Figma). Si tu as des compétences en montage vidéo, c’est un vrai plus.
  • Tu as le sens du storytelling et du mot qui fait mouche.
  • Tu disposes d’un bon niveau d’anglais, te permettant de comprendre et traiter des communications professionnelles.

🚀 En nous rejoignant tu vas 

  • Participer à une aventure entrepreneuriale avec une mission forte.
  • Grandir en tant que personne et apprendre au sein d'une équipe humaine, exigeante et solidaire.
  • Voir chaque jour l'impact concret de ton travail, et participer à notre ambition : devenir leader européen de la prévention en santé mentale au travail. 
  • Aller sur le terrain, à la rencontre des utilisateurs et futurs utilisateurs de Moka.Care.
  • Être responsable de tes objectifs dès le départ : nous recrutons des personnes pour nous mener un cran plus loin.

🤩 Nous prenons soin de toi

  • Accès à Moka.Care : app, sessions individuelles, formations mensuelles et la possibilité de tester les nouvelles fonctionnalités.
  • Work-life balance: 60% au bureau (on veut passer du temps ensemble) et le reste en remote si tu le souhaites (2 jours / semaine ou 1 semaine / mois).
  • Des bureaux très agréables à Bastille avec une salle de sport, un rooftop.
  • Cagnotte May : 1500 euros net/an (125 euros net/mois).
  • Swile pour les tickets restaurants à hauteur 10€ / jour.
  • Gymlib, pour faire du sport;
  • Politique de 7 semaines de congés payés / RTT.
  • Leeto, pour des centaines d’avantages et de réductions, grâce à notre CSE.
  • Mutuelle : SideCare.
  • 50% du pass Navigo ou Veligo.
  • Mac ou windows? Tu choisis, on veut que tu te sentes à l’aise.

Rémunération :

Package annuel brut entre 43 200 euros et 47 200 euros annuel brut (fixe + cagnotte May), selon nos grilles de rémunération en interne.

Cette fourchette est donnée à titre indicatif : le positionnement précis sera défini en fonction de ton expérience, de tes compétences et de ton adéquation au poste, afin de garantir cohérence et équité interne.

🎤 Processus de recrutement

Notre philosophie : un processus de recrutement équilibré, pensé pour te projeter dans ton futur quotidien de travail.

  • 30 minutes de screening pour comprendre ton parcours et tes aspirations.
  • Une première étude de cas pour évaluer tes compétences, et approfondir ton expérience.
  • Une seconde étude de cas pour te mettre en situation face à des enjeux client concrets.
  • Un entretien Values fit pour s’assurer mutuellement que notre cadre et nos valeurs te conviendront.
  • Offre et reverse interview: l’opportunité pour toi de nous poser toutes les questions importantes pour prendre ta décision.

Entre chaque étape tu as un feedback et si besoin nous organisons également des échanges informels avec l’équipe.

Poste ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

It looks after HR systems like BambooHR and Peakon, keeps policies up to date, and manages benefits and payroll. The team is the first point of contact for most People Operations questions.

The role

As our People Experience Administrator, you'll be the first point of contact for iwocans and the person who keeps the employee journey running smoothly, from someone's first day to their last.

Supporting payroll across our UK and German teams is a key part of the role, so you'll play a direct part in making sure every iwocan gets paid correctly and on time.

It's a broad, hands-on role at the heart of our People Operations team, with the flexibility to shape your days and hours around your life, so it suits anyone balancing work with other commitments. You'll own your work and be someone the team relies on.

In this role, you'll:

  • Support the payroll process across our UK and German entities, working with Finance and our People Partners so every iwocan gets paid correctly and on time.

  • Own the day-to-day running of our UK and German benefits, and be the person iwocans come to when they have a question about them.

  • Maintain our HR database (BambooHR) through careful data entry and regular audits, keeping people data accurate across both countries.

  • Coordinate onboarding for every new iwocan, from background checks to new-starter set-up, so their first days run seamlessly.

  • Run the offboarding process, booking and tracking exit interviews.

  • Answer iwocans' day-to-day questions, directly or through our ticketing system.

  • Work across People processes in both the UK and Germany.

The requirements

  • Ideally 1-3 years' experience in a People Operations or HR administration role.

  • Fluent in German and English, so you can confidently support our German team and the payroll and benefit administration.

  • Confident with HR systems (we use BambooHR and Ashby), accurate with data and reporting, and careful with confidential information.

  • Comfortable working independently and juggling competing priorities.

  • Comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to work faster and improve the quality of your work, with good judgement about when to use them.

  • Genuinely excited by the operational side of the People Ops: you love improving processes, driving change, and being at the centre of how things get done.

The salary
These are full-time salaries that we'll pro-rate for the hours you work. We expect to pay from £32,000 - £36,000 for this role in London but, we’re open-minded and want to find the right person for this role, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. The offices

jobs.title: Social Growth Strategist
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is building the creative suite for the AI generation. Millions of creators and marketers already use our platform to generate speech, music, images, and video, and our social presence needs to match the speed and ambition of the product.

We are looking for a Social Media Manager to own and elevate the social presence across both the ElevenLabs and ElevenCreative brands. You will own ElevenCreative on X and LinkedIn, ElevenLabs on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube, and our community on Discord.

This is a hands-on role at the intersection of content strategy, lightweight video editing, and community. You will plan the calendar, capture product moments with our AI creative producers and product teams, and do the recording and editing yourself using tools like Screen Studio, assembling clips, adding text and motion, and adapting each post natively for its platform. You will stay ahead of trends and cultural moments, up-level the brand voice and the quality bar across channels, track performance, and use the data to keep improving what we publish.

The right person lives on social platforms, understands what makes content work natively on each one, and has strong opinions about how an AI-native brand should show up. You should be comfortable writing sharp copy, running a content calendar across multiple channels, and thinking strategically about audience growth and brand positioning.

What you will do

  • Own the social content calendar across X, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn for both ElevenCreative and ElevenLabs, plus our community on Discord, from planning through publishing

  • Coordinate with AI creative producers and product teams to capture product moments such as screen recordings, motion demos, and feature walkthroughs, and adapt them into social-ready assets

  • Record and edit content yourself using tools like Screen Studio, assembling clips, adding text and motion overlays, and formatting natively for each platform

  • Own and grow our Discord community, sparking conversation, surfacing feedback, and keeping it active

  • Plan and execute social content around product launches, feature releases, and company moments

  • Work with the creator partnerships and community teams to source creator work, align on campaigns, and amplify content across channels

  • Monitor platform analytics, tracking engagement, reach, follower growth, and conversion, and use the data to refine strategy

  • Stay ahead of platform trends, algorithm changes, and cultural moments to find opportunities for the brand

  • Up-level the brand voice and raise the quality bar across every channel, keeping a consistent identity

  • Manage community engagement across platforms, responding to comments, surfacing feedback, and joining the right conversations

  • Develop and iterate on content formats that drive engagement and show product capabilities to creators and marketers

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience managing social media accounts for a technology or creative tools company, with a portfolio of work you can share

  • Ability to do lightweight video editing, assembling clips, adding text and motion overlays, and formatting content for different platforms

  • Comfortable recording and editing your own content with tools like Screen Studio, turning product moments into native posts without waiting on a producer

  • Proven ability to write sharp, platform-native copy across X, Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn

  • Fluency in social analytics, you know how to pull insights from native platform dashboards and translate them into content decisions

  • Experience coordinating content across cross-functional teams (video, community, partnerships, product marketing)

  • A genuine understanding of the AI and creative tools landscape, you follow the space, use the tools, and have informed opinions about where things are headed

Bonus

  • Experience managing social for a product used by creators and marketers (e.g., Adobe, Canva, Figma, Runway, or similar)

  • Experience running or growing a community channel such as Discord

  • Experience with social scheduling and management tools (Sprout Social, Later, Buffer, or similar)

  • Experience building a social presence from early stage or leading a rebrand on social

  • Multilingual capabilities

Growth potential

We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:

  • Lead social strategy across all ElevenLabs brands and sub-brands as the social function scales

  • Move into a broader content role spanning video, editorial, and social

  • Expand into brand marketing or creative direction as the growth team evolves

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Madrid, Warsaw and many more.

#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Agent Deployment Engineer - French Speaking
jobs.description:
About Decagon

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

About the Team

Over the past few years, development of LLMs has evolved at a rapid pace. It’s not enough for our customers to just “set it and forget it” when it comes to AI software. Truly successful AI Agents require hands-on execution, rigorous iteration, and deep technical delivery to reach enterprise-grade performance.

We’re creating an Agent Deployment Engineering Org: a specialized technical delivery team responsible for end-to-end execution of AI agent builds. Agent Deployment Engineers own the hands-on work required to deliver best-in-class agents—writing and configuring key components, validating integrations, and ensuring agents perform reliably at scale. This team brings greater specialization and focus to build quality. Agent Deployment Engineers are technical and customer-facing: you’ll interface with senior technical stakeholders on the customer side while also going deep on agent configuration and build execution.

 

About the Role

As an Agent Deployment Engineer, you will be responsible for end-to-end execution of AI agent builds for strategic customers. This is a highly technical delivery role where you will own the implementation work required to launch and scale enterprise-quality agents—partnering with customers and internal teams to define success, translate requirements into build plans, and deliver agents that meaningfully impact the customer’s business.

You’ll work closely with Agent PMs, Agent Success, Engineering, and GTM teams to create tight feedback loops: executing builds, surfacing gaps, and influencing the evolution of Decagon’s agent-building platform based on real customer needs. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, enjoys shipping customer-facing technical work, and can balance hands-on execution with structured thinking.

 

In this role, you will

  • Own end-to-end architecture and execution of AI agent builds for enterprise customers, from systems design and initial scoping through implementation, evaluation, and production deployment.

  • Design and engineer the core agentic logic governing agent behavior, applying engineering principles to optimize quality, reliability, and correctness across non-deterministic model outputs.

  • Engineer and validate layered guardrails and supervisory controls to ensure safe, compliant, and predictable agent performance across real-world scenarios.

  • Architect, build, and test integrations with customer systems (e.g., data pipelines, CRMs, ticketing systems), including building the tools, APIs, and workflows needed for reliable deployments at scale.

  • Interface with senior technical stakeholders at customers to define success criteria and system requirements, and drive technical delivery against timelines.

  • Diagnose, debug, and resolve both probabilistic and technical failures through root-cause analysis of execution traces, error logs, and model behavior.

  • Design evaluation and regression-testing frameworks to validate agent behavior against ground truth and guard against performance drift.

  • Translate customer needs into clear internal documentation and run tight feedback loops with Engineering to drive platform improvements.

  • Partner closely with APMs, Engineering, Design, and Go-To-Market teams to deliver consistent, repeatable, best-in-class agent builds.

 

Your background looks something like this

  • Have 5+ years of relevant experience in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, technical consulting, implementation engineering, technical product/PM, or similar).

  • Native or business-level fluency in both written and spoken English and French is required.

  • Strong technical foundation: comfortable writing code, working with APIs, and building/validating integrations end-to-end.

    Experience delivering production-grade customer solutions that require structured execution, testing/validation, and iteration.

  • Ability to communicate clearly with senior technical stakeholders, translate requirements into implementation plans, and drive delivery.

  • Comfort working in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape solutions as much as you implement them.

 

Even better if you have

  • Experience building with or around LLMs / AI agents (prompting, evaluation, guardrails, tooling, workflow design, etc.).

  • Experience with enterprise SaaS integrations (e.g., ticketing systems, CRM, data pipelines) and associated security/compliance considerations.

  • A Computer Science, Engineering, or Math degree, or equivalent technical experience.

  • Strong product instinct: ability to write crisp PRDs, define success metrics, and contribute customer insight back into product roadmap.

Benefits

We proudly offer the following benefits for our full-time employees:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

  • Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

  • Parental Leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work-life balance

  • Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best

  • Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave)

These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.

Compensation: £110K – £150K • Offers Equity

? Productie & planning

jobs.title: Studenten administratie

Wat wordt er van je verwacht?

jobs.title: Chauffeur CE voor dagtransport – Houtsector
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren chauffeur CE met een passie voor hout en logistiek? Heb je oog voor klanttevredenheid en ben je graag overdag op de baan? Dan is deze job iets voor jou!

Functieomschrijving

Voor een dynamisch en groeiend bedrijf in de houtsector zijn wij op zoek naar een gemotiveerde chauffeur CE voor dagtransport met vertrek vanuit het depot in Rekkem.

Je takenpakket bestaat uit:

  • Het leveren van houtproducten aan klanten in België, en sporadisch in Nederland en Noord-Frankrijk.

  • Zelfstandig bepalen van de optimaalste route op basis van verkeerssituaties.

  • Zorgvuldig omgaan met ladingszekerheid en veilig transport.

  • Het gebruik van een meeneemheftruck is een pluspunt.

  • Je fungeert als het visitekaartje van de firma, dus een verzorgd voorkomen en klantvriendelijkheid zijn essentieel.

  • Je bent in het bezit van een geldig rijbewijs CE en de bijhorende vakbekwaamheidsattesten (code 95).

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kan je behelpen in het Frans.

  • Je beschikt over ervaring met trekker-opleggercombinaties.

  • Je bent autonoom, betrouwbaar en hebt zin voor verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Klantgerichtheid en flexibiliteit zijn jouw tweede natuur.

jobs.title: Meestergast Schrijnwerker – CNC Houtbewerking
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren schrijnwerker met leidinggevende capaciteiten? Heb je passie voor hout en ervaring met CNC-gestuurde machines? Dan is deze job als meestergast schrijnwerker iets voor jou!

Functieomschrijving

Als meestergast schrijnwerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vlot en kwalitatief verloop van het productieproces binnen een moderne houtverwerkende omgeving. Je combineert hands-on werk met leidinggevende verantwoordelijkheden:

  • Zelfstandig bedienen, instellen en opvolgen van CNC-gestuurde vierzijdige schaafmachines (vier stuks) en zaagmachines (twee stuks).

  • Aansturen van verschillende productieteams en het organiseren van de werkplanning.

  • Je zorgt voor het preventieve onderhoud van de machines en beheert ook de slijpdienst.

  • Je staat in voor een ordelijke, veilige en efficiënte werkplaats.

  • Je hebt een technische opleiding of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.

  • Minstens 5 jaar ervaring in houtbewerking met CNC-machines is vereist.

  • Sterke kennis van houtkwaliteit, schaaftechniek en machine-instellingen.

  • Je hebt leidinggevende capaciteiten en ervaring met het aansturen van collega’s.

  • Veiligheid, netheid en kwaliteit staan bij jou centraal.

  • Je spreekt vlot Nederlands en kan je uitdrukken in het Engels.

  • Je bent teamgericht, gemotiveerd en hebt oog voor detail.

jobs.title: Kelner met ervaring
jobs.description:
Voor een stijlvolle en sfeervolle brasserie in Geel zijn we op zoek naar een gedreven kelner met oog voor detail en een passie voor gastbeleving.
Je ontvangt gasten op een warme en professionele manier, verzorgt een vlotte en attente service en draagt bij aan een verfijnde totaalervaring. Samen met het team zorg je ervoor dat elk moment klopt en gasten met een glimlach én een bijzondere ervaring naar huis gaan.
  • Je hebt ervaring in de horeca 
  • Je kan vlot werken met een dienblad 
  • Je kan met 3 borden lopen
  • Je hebt ervaring in afrekenen
  • Flexibel ingesteld : bereid om te werken in de avonden en in de weekends

jobs.title: Student middagpost - Horeca
jobs.description:
Voor een gezellig brasserie te Geel zijn we op zoek naar een studente die tijdens de middagshift wil ondersteunen. 

Studeer je nog en wil je een centje bijverdienen? Wil je je middagpauze op een nuttige manier overbruggen? Dan is deze job zeker iets voor jou!
Je werkt tijdens de middagpost van ongeveer 12u tot 15u. Je zorgt voor een warm onthaal en een vlotte, professionele bediening van onze gasten. Het creëren van een onvergetelijke beleving staat daarbij steeds centraal.

  • Je hebt een eerste ervaring binnen de horeca
  • Je bent een hogeschoolstudent(e)
  • Je kan vlot lopen met een plateau en verschillende borden tegelijk dragen

jobs.title: Chauffeur C – Toiletverhuur (4x10u)
jobs.description:
Voor een toiletverhuurbedrijf in Zeebrugge zijn wij op zoek naar een gemotiveerde Chauffeur C om het team te versterken. Het bedrijf is gespecialiseerd in het plaatsen, ophalen en reinigen van mobiele toiletten en verhuurt daarnaast ook machines en containers.

In deze functie werkt u 4 dagen per week (10 uur/dag) en bent u verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse rondes over heel België. Het is een fysieke job waarin u niet enkel rijdt, maar ook actief instaat voor het onderhoud en transport.

 

Uw takenpakket bestaat uit:

  • Ledigen, reinigen, ophalen en leveren van mobiele toiletten
  • Transporteren en afleveren van machines en containers bij klanten
  • Opladen en afzetten van materiaal volgens planning
  • Zorgen dat alle adressen en klanten correct bediend zijn, zonder openstaande opdrachten
  • Rijbewijs C (met code 95 of bereid om dit te behalen)
  • Fysiek in orde en bereid om een actieve job te doen
  • Praktisch inzicht en handig genoeg voor kleine herstellingen

jobs.title: Traineeship binnen een logistiek bedrijf in de Waaslandhaven
jobs.description:
Ben jij net afgestudeerd en voel je het kriebelen om je carrière te starten in de wereld van Haven & Logistiek? Met dit traineeship krijg je de kans om te proeven van uiteenlopende domeinen zoals Customer Service, Aankoop, Operations, Sales, Transport en Supply Chain. Zo ontdek je waar jouw interesses en talenten liggen.

Hoe ziet jouw dag eruit? Je draait mee op verschillende afdelingen, werkt samen met ervaren collega's en neemt deel aan projecten. Door deze afwisseling leer je niet alleen het bedrijf, maar vooral jezelf en jouw sterktes beter kennen. Elk traject wordt op maat samengesteld, zodat je het maximum uit deze ervaring haalt.

Ben je klaar om jouw carrière een vliegende start te geven? Twijfel niet langer en grijp deze kans om te groeien, te leren en je eigen pad uit te stippelen binnen de logistieke sector. Solliciteer vandaag nog!

  • Je hebt een bachelor of master in logistiek management, bedrijfsmanagement of supply chain.
  • Je bent net afgestudeerd of hebt maximum 1 jaar werkervaring.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd en bruist van energie.
  • Je bent communicatief sterk.
  • Je bent flexibel en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.
  • Je beheerst het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

jobs.title: Medewerker Technische Dienst Elektromotoren
jobs.description:
• Inspecteren, testen en onderhouden van elektromotoren

  • Ondersteunen bij aanpassingen en revisies van elektromotoren
  • Technische gegevens registreren en rapporteren
  • Mee zorgen voor een nette, veilige en georganiseerde werkplaats
  • Je hebt een technische opleiding gevolgd (elektromechanica, elektriciteit, mechanica of gelijkwaardig door ervaring).
  • Je hebt interesse in elektromotoren en techniek.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en kwaliteitsgericht.
  • Je bent leergierig en hebt een hands-on mentaliteit.
  • Je spreekt Nederlands

jobs.title: architect
jobs.description:
Architect

Ben jij een creatieve architect met een sterk gevoel voor ontwerp EN technische haalbaarheid? Wil je meewerken aan kwalitatieve residentiële projecten binnen een professioneel architectenteam?

jobs.title: Productiemedewerker voeding/vlees - €17.59 - vroege ploeg

takenpakket:

jobs.title: Logistiek medewerker – job met variatie

  • Je pickt bestellingen nauwkeurig met een scansysteem en zet alles klaar voor verzending.
  • Je pakt orders correct in en zorgt voor een vlot transportklaar proces.
  • Je ontvangt goederen, controleert leveringen en zet ze op de juiste plaats in de stock.
  • Je houdt het magazijn veilig, ordelijk en overzichtelijk.
  • Af en toe neem je leveringen of rondritten op jou (heb je een rijbewijs C, dan is dat een stevige troef).

  • Je werkt vlot met een computer en bent vertrouwd met ERP-systemen.

  • Je bent flexibel, gemotiveerd en draagt bij aan een positieve sfeer.

jobs.title: Customer Service Medewerker – mooi loon + groei
jobs.description:
Hou je van klantencontact en werk je graag gestructureerd? In deze functie combineer je administratie, verkoop en advies in een afwisselende rol.

jobs.title: Zaalmedewerker
jobs.description:
Heb jij een passie voor gastvrijheid en wil je deel uitmaken van een dynamisch team?

jobs.title: Internal Sales
jobs.description:
Fan van fitness? Sterke communicator?

Dan is deze unieke job voor jou! 

Achter elk succesvol fitnessproject staat iemand die alles op de rails houdt: offertes, bestellingen, opvolging en tevreden klanten.

Als Internal Sales voor deze groeiende onderneming ben jij de commerciële ruggengraat van het team, in nauwe samenwerking met de salescollega's, leveranciers en klanten in heel België.

  • Stel offertes op en verwerk bestellingen.
  • Wees het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten via telefoon en e-mail.
  • Volg leveringen, projecten en openstaande dossiers op samen met sales, logistiek en leveranciers.
  • Houd klant- en productgegevens correct in de systemen.
  • Ondersteun het team met rapportering en commerciële administratie.
  • Je hebt sterke administratieve en organisatorische vaardigheden.
  • Je bent klantgericht, communicatief en helpt graag mensen.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, zelfstandig en proactief.
  • Ervaring in een internal sales- of commerciële supportrol is een plus.
  • Je spreekt Nederlands (en Engels).

jobs.title: Lijnverantwoordelijke etikettering - dagwerk te Oudenaarde
jobs.description:
Als lijnverantwoordelijke binnen de etiketteringsafdeling zorg jij ervoor dat de etiketteringslijn efficiënt en correct draait.

  • Je staat in voor het opstarten, instellen en opvolgen van de etiketteerlijn.

jobs.title: Projectleider
jobs.description:
Voor onze klant gespecialiseerd in vloer- en wandtegels zijn wij op zoek naar een projectleider.

  • Daarnaast stuur je arbeiders aan, stem je af met andere aannemers en geef je technisch advies aan klanten en vloerders.

  • Je spreekt vlot Nederlands, Frans en Engels.

jobs.title: Order Picker
jobs.description:
Als order Picker zorg je ervoor dat iedere bestelling correct en volledig wordt klaargezet. Je werkt met een elektrische transpallet of heftruck en een scanner.
Naast het orderpicken help je ook mee in de serre en ondersteun je waar nodig andere afdelingen.

  • Verzamelen van producten en onderdelen volgens de bestellingen.
  • Werken met een elektrische transpallet of heftruck en scanner.
  • Controleren van aantallen, kwaliteit en etiketten van de producten.
  • Correct verwerken en opvolgen van de bestellingen.
  • Meehelpen met het uitzetten van planten in de serre.
  • Mee instaan voor het onderhoud, de orde en netheid van de serre.
  • Goederen mee wegzetten aan de kaai.
  • Ondersteunen bij het afwerken en klaarmaken van bestellingen.
  • Mee zorgen voor een vlotte en correcte goederenstroom.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en resultaatgericht.
  • Je hebt een echte hands-on mentaliteit en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.

  • Je kan vlot werken met een heftruck of bent bereid dit aan te leren.

jobs.title: Slager met bedrijfswagen
jobs.description:
Ben jij een ervaren slager of rundversnijder en op zoek naar een stabiele job met hoog loon, respect en groeikansen?
Voor een modern familiebedrijf in Koekelare zoeken we een gemotiveerde medewerker voor het versnijden van rundvlees in een kraaknette productieomgeving.

Je komt terecht in een onderneming waar je meer krijgt: meer loon, meer respect en meer kansen.

Je dag start in onze moderne en hygiënische productieruimte in Koekelare.
Het opstart uur is bespreekbaar tussen 5u en 8u, afhankelijk van jouw voorkeur.

Na een korte briefing ga je aan de slag in de snijzaal:

  • Je ontvangt bestellingen digitaal rechtstreeks van de klant.

  • Er wordt verwacht dat je actief meewerkt op de werf waar nodig met oog voor nauwkeurigheid en orde op de werf.

jobs.title: Rioolarbeider speciale technieken
jobs.description:
Onze klant is een gespecialiseerd en groeiend bedrijf in renovatie- en infrastructuurwerken. Ze combineren vakmanschap met moderne technieken om ondergrondse leidingen, rioleringen en infrastructuur duurzaam te herstellen. Er wordt sterk ingezet op veiligheid, kwaliteit en de groei van medewerkers. De werksfeer is collegiaal en praktisch, met respect voor ervaring én motivatie.

Je komt terecht in een organisatie die inzet op speciale technieken zoals UV-relining, putrenovatie en betonherstel.


Jobomschrijving

Als rioolarbeider speciale technieken werk je mee aan het vernieuwen en herstellen van rioleringsleidingen met speciale technieken zoals putrenovatie en injecties/betonherstel.

Je taken:

  • je voert putrenovaties uit door glasvezel te plaatsen en deze aan te smeren
  • je voert injecties uit en herstelt beton op beschadigde plaatsen
  • je brengt afwerklagen aan na injecties en betonherstellingen
  • je werkt met moderne machines zoals inspectiecamera’s en freesrobots
  • je helpt bij sleufloze renovaties (relining)
  • je past je aan aan verschillende werven en omstandigheden

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Voor de vacature van rioolarbeider speciale technieken, zoeken we iemand die niet afschrikt van lange dagen en op logement gaan.

Verder herken je jezelf in onderstaand profiel:

  • je hebt ervaring in de rioleringen
  • je hebt interesse in speciale technieken zoals UV, putrenovatie en betonherstel
  • je hebt interesse in innovatieve technieken
  • je hebt een rijbewijs C en kan je vlot verplaatsen naar verschillende oppikpunten
  • je spreekt Nederlands en/of Frans
De ideale collega is...
  • je bent gemotiveerd en leergierig
  • je werkt graag in teamverband
  • je kan zelfstandig taken uitvoeren
  • je bent flexibel naar werkuren, nachtwerk en overnachtingen
  • je werkt veilig en volgt afspraken correct op
  • je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor je werk

jobs.title: Wegenwerker - Voltijds
jobs.description:
Deze bouwgroep is één van de grootste in België en is elke dag actief op meer dan 250 werven. Met maar liefst 2.000 collega’s werken ze samen aan projecten voor wegen, gebouwen, sportfaciliteiten en waterzuivering.

Wat deze werkgever zo bijzonder maakt, is dat ze alles zelf doen: van de productie tot de uitvoering. Dat zorgt voor topkwaliteit, innovatie én werkzekerheid. Medewerkers krijgen volop kansen om te groeien, samen te werken in sterke teams én mee te bouwen aan projecten om trots op te zijn.

Hier draait het om meer dan werken alleen. Welzijn, teamspirit en een goede balans tussen werk en privé zijn erg belangrijk. Wie hier start, krijgt niet alleen een job, maar echt een toekomst.


Jobomschrijving

3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

Zo ziet je job er uit

Als wegenwerker in het team van Zedelgem zal je verantwoordelijk zijn voor o.a. :

  • Opritten maken of herstellen

  • Kolken aansluiten
  • Bedienen van kleine machines

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

  • Je werkt veilig en georganiseerd.
  • Je bent flexibel naar verplaatsing en uren

jobs.title: asfalt ploegbaas
jobs.description:
ASFALT PLOEGBAAS

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Als ploegbaas voor asfaltwerken ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen planning, uitvoering en kwaliteit. Je houdt het overzicht, begeleidt je team en zorgt dat elk project vlot en correct verloopt.

  • Overleg & planning: Samen met de werfleider bepaal je welke asfaltwerken uitgevoerd worden en plan je ze in op het juiste moment, met de juiste middelen en materialen.

  • Leiding op de werf: Je stuurt je eigen ploeg aan, geeft duidelijke instructies en houdt rekening met veiligheid en onverwachte situaties.

  • Kwaliteit bewaken: Tijdens de uitvoering volg je de werkzaamheden op, stuur je bij waar nodig en zorg je dat alles tot in de puntjes klopt.

  • Oplevering en afrekening: Na afloop meet je de werkzaamheden op voor de afrekening en draag je het dossier over aan de werfleider.

  • Procesoptimalisatie: Je denkt actief mee over hoe de werkprocessen slimmer, sneller en efficiënter kunnen verlopen.



PROFIEL

  • Minstens 3 jaar ervaring in asfaltwerken.

  • Praktisch inzicht, leidinggevende vaardigheden en duidelijke communicatie.

  • Vaardig in opmeten, schetsen en berekenen van hoeveelheden.

  • Autonome, proactieve en nauwkeurige werkstijl.

  • VCA-attest of bereid dit te behalen.

  • Rijbewijs B.

  • Vlotte beheersing van het Nederlands.



AANBOD

  • Moderne en innovatieve machines en gereedschappen.

  • Afwisselend werk: geen dag is hetzelfde.

  • Vast contract volgens de bouw-cao, met salaris dat groeit naargelang je prestaties.

  • Interne en externe opleidingen: wij investeren in jouw groei.

  • Sterke teamspirit: samenwerken, elkaar helpen en plezier op de werkvloer.

  • Erkenning als ‘Great Place To Work’.

jobs.title: Network Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Our client is a key player in the healthcare and social services sector. The work environment is dynamic, collaborative, and innovation-driven, with a strong focus on modernizing its IT landscape and continuously improving operational performance.
They are looking for a Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer to join a team responsible for the implementation, maintenance, support, and administration of the network infrastructure.
This includes network hardware, PCs and servers, printers and other peripherals, as well as the core software installed on them, both at the head office and across around one hundred remote sites.


Jobomschrijving

  • Implement, maintain, and administer the organization's network infrastructure, including network hardware, servers, PCs, printers, peripherals, and foundational software.
  • Support the helpdesk on complex technical issues and provide advanced assistance to end users.
  • Monitor system performance, conduct tuning activities, and ensure the stability and reliability of all network and server environments.
  • Participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation to guarantee operational continuity.
  • Collaborate with software development teams and intervene on existing applications when needed.
  • Mentor and support junior team members, sharing best practices and helping them develop technical skills.
  • Analyze technical needs and contribute to the design, documentation, and implementation of new technical solutions.
  • Ensure the security, resilience, and scalability of the IT infrastructure across all sites.
  • Stay up to date with relevant technologies and propose improvements to enhance the IT landscape.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field.
  • Minimum 10 years of proven experience in a similar role with demonstrated progression.
  • Valid driving license (Category B).
  • You have a good command of technical English and a passive knowledge of Dutch (you can understand Dutch-speaking participants during meetings and work based on documentation written in Dutch).



Technical Skills

  • Strong expertise in managing a Windows 11 desktop fleet and related peripherals.
  • Solid knowledge of Microsoft Windows Server 2019/2022.
  • Good overall knowledge of Linux.
  • Strong understanding of LAN/WAN configuration.
  • Knowledge of relational databases.



Assets (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Aruba switches.
  • Knowledge of Red Hat Enterprise 9, JBoss, Docker.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL and MS SQL Server.
  • Experience with VMware ESX virtualization.
  • Basic software development knowledge.
  • Experience creating MSI packages and scripting in PHP.
  • Knowledge of Office 365 administration.

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Our client is an international organization with a strong reputation in its sector and operations across multiple European markets. Known for its commitment to quality, responsible business practices, and continuous improvement, the company offers a collaborative and multicultural environment where people play a central role in driving success.


Jobomschrijving

As a Senior HR Business Partner, you will play a key role in supporting both employees and managers across several countries and functions.

Acting as a trusted HR partner, you will accompany teams throughout the employee lifecycle, provide day-to-day guidance on people-related topics, and help managers create engaging and high-performing work environments.

This role combines operational involvement with strategic HR initiatives. You will spend time close to the business, understanding the realities of different teams, supporting managers in their people challenges, and ensuring a consistent employee experience across the organization.

HR Partnership & Employee Support

  • Act as the primary HR contact for employees and managers within your assigned business areas.
  • Build strong relationships with teams and maintain a close understanding of business and people challenges.
  • Support managers in addressing day-to-day HR topics, employee engagement, team dynamics, and people development.
  • Accompany employees throughout their journey within the company, ensuring a positive and consistent experience.
  • Regularly connect with teams across different locations to stay close to operational realities.



Employee Relations & People Management

  • Advise and support managers on employee relations matters, performance concerns, wellbeing topics, and workplace issues.
  • Ensure people decisions are aligned with company policies and local employment regulations.
  • Facilitate constructive dialogue between managers and employees when needed.
  • Support disciplinary processes and sensitive employee cases with professionalism and discretion.



Talent & Performance

  • Coordinate performance management and talent review processes within your scope.
  • Support managers in identifying development opportunities and building individual growth plans.
  • Contribute to initiatives aimed at strengthening leadership and team capabilities.
  • Participate in succession planning and talent development discussions.



Employee Experience & Engagement

  • Support onboarding and integration activities to ensure a strong employee experience from day one.
  • Contribute to engagement initiatives and help foster a collaborative and inclusive culture.
  • Gather feedback from employees and managers and translate insights into practical improvements.
  • Promote a culture of continuous feedback and development.



HR Projects & Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to HR projects, process improvements, and the implementation of new initiatives.
  • Help improve HR tools, policies, and ways of working.
  • Support HR reporting and analysis when required.
  • Collaborate closely with other HR functions to ensure a seamless employee experience.

Experience & Background

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
  • More than 7 years of experience as HR Business Partner within an international and fast-paced environment.
  • Proven experience supporting both managers and employees across a broad range of HR topics.
  • Strong exposure to employee relations, performance management, talent development, and organizational change.
  • Good understanding of European employment legislation; experience across multiple countries is an asset.



Skills & Competencies

  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to establish credibility at all levels of the organization.
  • Hands-on and pragmatic approach, with a genuine interest in supporting people and solving problems.
  • Excellent communication and coaching skills.
  • Ability to manage sensitive situations with discretion and professionalism.
  • Well-organized and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Data-aware, with good knowledge of HR systems and reporting tools.
  • Fluent in French and English; additional European languages are considered a plus.
  • Collaborative, approachable, and committed to delivering an excellent employee experience.

jobs.title: Growth Intern - Automation & AI (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Über uns

Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser.

In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. <1% Solardurchdringung. <2% Smart Metering. Kaum Flexibilität oder intelligentes Energiemanagement.

Gleichzeitig zwingt die Regulierung Eigentümer zu massiven Investitionen: Solar wird zur Pflicht, Smart Meter müssen in den nächsten 5 Jahren flächendeckend ausgerollt werden, Heizung und Mobilität elektrifizieren sich. Das Mehrfamilienhaus wird vom Betongold zum aktiven Teil der dezentralen Energieinfrastruktur.

Was fehlt, ist ein integriertes System, das diesen Wandel wirtschaftlich und operativ beherrschbar macht.

VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (§42b EnWG).

Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:

  • Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,

  • ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und

  • digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.

Bereits heute betreuen wir eine dreistellige Anzahl an Projekten - darunter die größten Bestandshalter und Wohnungsbaugenossenschaften - in allen 16 Bundesländern. Damit gehören wir nach kürzester Zeit zu den führenden Anbietern im Markt.

Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.

Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

Dein Profil

  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2), High-Growth Start-ups (idealerweise Operations oder Prozessoptimierung), oder im Projektmanagement in Form von Praktika gesammelt

  • Du hast bereits mit KI-Tools wie Claude, Claude Code und ChatGPT etc. gearbeitet oder brennst darauf, dich schnell einzuarbeiten

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg

  • Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Start-ups, Energie oder Immobilien mit

  • Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten

  • Du strebst danach, die beste Version deiner selbst zu werden und suchst Umgebungen, in denen du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst

  • Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase

  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend

Deine Aufgaben

Mission der Rolle

Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Head of Growth Konrad und unserem CEO Julius zusammen und übernimmst eine zentrale Rolle beim Aufbau unseres AI-enabled Growth Set-ups.

Dein Ziel: Unsere Projektleiter:innen bei der Umsetzung unterstützen, interne Prozesse weiterentwickeln und datenbasierte Entscheidungen ermöglichen. Dabei wirst du ein tiefes Verständnis für Energieprojekte, Operations und Business-Aufbau entwickeln.

1. Prozessanalyse & Priorisierung

  • Du screenst gemeinsam mit den Teams (u. a. Sales, Partnerships, CEO Office) bestehende Abläufe und identifizierst, wo manuelle Arbeit am meisten Zeit kostet

  • Du bewertest Automatisierungspotenzial nach Aufwand vs. Impact und leitest daraus eine klare Priorisierung ab

  • Du hältst Anforderungen und Prozesslogik so fest, dass daraus direkt eine Lösung gebaut werden kann

2. Technische Umsetzung

  • Du analysierst bestehende Prozesse und identifizierst Komplexität sowie Optimierungspotenziale

  • Du hilfst dabei, Entscheidungsprozesse zu strukturieren und Automatisierungen operativ sauber aufzusetzen

  • Du unterstützt beim Aufbau skalierbarer technologischer Strukturen, Standards und Templates für operative Projekte

3. Prozessoptimierung & interne Strukturen

  • Du entwickelst interne Prozesse und Tools (z. B. in Airtable) weiter, um operative Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit zu erhöhen

  • Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale in bestehenden Abläufen und setzt konkrete Optimierungen, z.B. mittels Automatisierungen (Claude), um

  • Du übernimmst bereichsübergreifende Special Projects in den Bereichen Organisation, Tooling und interne Strukturen

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Golang Engineer (EMEA)
jobs.description:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

 

About the Role

We're building WunderGraph Cosmo, the open-source GraphQL Federation solution. Probably the most important component of Cosmo is the Cosmo Router, which - simply put - connects all API endpoints and handles the GraphQL requests and responses whilst applying the Federation protocol (among other magical things, like normalization, execution planning etc.). Fully written in Go, it's the fastest GraphQL Router available and a quite potent (and complex) piece of cutting-edge open-source software. How about joining our team to make it even better and strap the rocket boosters onto GraphQL Federation?

 

TEAM INTEGRATION

  • You align with the Product team and Customer Success teams for product feedback

  • You support and consult with the engineering team.

     

You will be in charge of

  • Develop, refactor and maintain GraphQL Go Tools' (Router) open-source code base in Golang (low GC code)

  • Work closely with your engineering team mates on new Router capabilities (e.g. Open Federation, new data sources)

  • Focus on performance, security and stability of the Router

  • Review Router telemetry to identify areas of improvement

  • Run internal penetration tests of the Router

  • Troubleshoot Router issues, potentially together with our customers' engineers

  • Analyze and accept up open-source contributions on Github

     

The "Engine" is essentially a Golang application which translates GraphQL requests into any other protocol, like OpenAPI, SOAP, gRPC, GraphQL, Apollo Federation, etc. You could consider the Engine as a "GraphQL Compiler" or Transpiler. The Engine is responsible for parsing, normalization, execution planning, execution runtime, etc... If you are interested in working with ASTs, AST transformations, etc... you will love this kind of work. We have performance requirements, so you should be proficient in writing performant and low GC code in Golang.

Some of your tasks will take more than a few weeks to complete, Ideally, you're someone who likes to go deep on one topic instead of going wide and shallow on many different topics.

 

Here's a list of things you might be working on:

  • Extend the Compiler "backend" to support Apollo Federation v2

  • Extend the Compiler "backend" to support gRPC

  • Implement a native Go-based data source for SOAP and OpenAPI, currently we're using a Node.js based solution with a bridge

  • Improve the batching-implementation of the Engine

  • Improve the performance of the Engine in general, driven by feedback from our customers

 

What you bring to the team

  • Senior/Staff level of proven Golang development experience in a leading / ownership role (must have)

  • Self-starter with a clear sense of priorities - no hand-holding needed

  • You must be willing and able to work out solutions on your own. This requires you to dig into hard problems and stay on target until you have solved an issue in a robust way.

  • Experience in working with ASTs, AST transformations etc.

  • Experience in writing performant and low GC code in Golang, and knowledge of how to benchmark Go code

  • You are able to work and thrive in a fully remote environment

  • Excellent communicator (important for a remote team) in English

  • You are willing and able to travel occasionally to meet the team in person (at least twice a year) or join working meetings.

  • You are able to work within the CET time zone.

Bonus points:

  • Experience with GraphQL, API Gateways, Proxies, and Networking in general is a plus

  • Experience with OpenAPI, SOAP, gRPC, GraphQL, Apollo Federation is a plus

  • Existing Open Source Contributions

What Success Looks Like

  • Customers love our product because it works flawlessly, securely and fast - and because it looks darn pretty, too!

  • Developers love our product because of the exceptional DX (as said before, we’re an engineering company, so we care a lot about DX)

  • Your teammates love to work with you because you never let them down, share your knowledge, and ship like crazy as a team

  • Proper tests and clean code that prevent outages and security issues

  • You grow along with us

     

Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

  • Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

  • Competitive compensation

  • Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

  • Team retreats across the globe

     

THE PROCESS

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

  • 30 min intro call with Mariya from our People team

  • 45 min technical background call with one of our engineers. Following this, you will receive a small take home assignment / programming task (max 1 - 2h effort) related to our open source platform. This is your chance to prove your skill!

  • Complete the assignment and review together with our engineers

  • Meet the founders

  • Culture fit call with team members

  • Offer

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

 

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds. To keep up with us, follow us on LinkedIn or GitHub

You can find out more about our ways of working together here:

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources

We’re looking forward to your application so we can grow together!

Samen met de technische verantwoordelijke stel je verbeteringen voor die het systeem stabieler en performanter maken.
  • Daarna ga je praktisch aan de slag: je installeert en configureert nieuwe systemen, integreert oplossingen in bestaande infrastructuren en zorgt ervoor dat alles veilig en efficiënt blijft draaien.
  • Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met collega’s, eindgebruikers en leveranciers. Problemen detecteer je vaak al voordat ze impact hebben. Als IT specialist / system engineer denk je proactief mee en zorg je voor duurzame oplossingen.

Geen dag is identiek: de ene dag werk je aan serverbeheer of cloudoplossingen, de andere dag optimaliseer je een infrastructuur of ondersteun je een klant bij een technische uitdaging.

Belangrijk: dit is een structurele functie binnen een stabiele organisatie, met duidelijke intentie tot een langdurige samenwerking en een vast contract.

Je hoeft niet alles al te kennen, maar je beschikt wel over een stevige basis en het vertrouwen om zelfstandig technische uitdagingen aan te pakken.

  • Technische kennis: je hebt een goede basis in Windows Server, netwerken, virtualisatie en cloudomgevingen. Ervaring met Microsoft 365, Azure, security of infrastructuurbeheer is een sterke troef.
  • Maturiteit: je communiceert professioneel met klanten en collega’s en kan technische oplossingen helder uitleggen.

jobs.title: Warehouse job: order picker in day shift
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.title: Onthaalbediende (immo - vakantieverhuur)
jobs.description:
Voor een immokantoor in Oostduinkerke zoeken wij een commercieel bediende vakantieverhuur. Van gezellige strandhuisjes tot luxe appartementen met uitzicht op zee.

Wat ga je doen:

• Als commercieel medewerker verhuur ben je de held(in) die potentiële huurders met open armen ontvangt (figuurlijk dan, hè!).

• Je bent een ster in het verkopen van dromen - je vertelt vol passie over de accommodaties, de omgeving en alle leuke dingen die Oostduinkerke te bieden heeft.

• Geen boeking is jou te veel! Je regelt reserveringen, beantwoordt vragen via telefoon, e-mail of social media, en zorgt ervoor dat alles op rolletjes loopt.

• Je zal verantwoordelijk zijn voor het volledige proces van de verhuur, waarbij je alles nauwgezet zal opvolgen en je schouders zet onder het project van opstart tot het opstellen van de reservatie.

• Ook na de boeking sta je paraat. Je controleert de schoonmaak (indien nodig verzorg jij de finishing touch) en zorgt ervoor dat de gasten zich welkom voelen vanaf het moment dat ze binnenkomen.

 

Praktische zaken neem jij er met plezier bij.

  • Iemand met een flinke dosis enthousiasme en een sprankelende persoonlijkheid. Jij bent het zonnetje in huis!
  • Werken op zaterdag lukt je perfect! 
  • Je bent een kei in multitasken en houdt het hoofd koel, zelfs als het druk is.
  • Ervaring in de toerisme-, horeca- of verhuurbranche is mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste. Als je maar barst van de motivatie!
  • Kennis van zowel Frans, Duits en noties Engels = zeer belangrijk!

Your profile

Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority.

  • Analytical Expertise: Strong practical experience in general instrumental and wet-chemical analytics (especially NMR, IR, DSC, titration). Experience in specialized polymer testing (e.g., MFR/MFI, tensile testing) or prior experience in a plastics laboratory is a major plus!

  • Synthesis Experience: Experience in carrying out organic syntheses safely according to protocol (SOPs). Specialized knowledge of polymers or reactors is advantageous, but not mandatory—we are happy to train you.

  • Technical Routine: You feel "at home" in the lab. You are confident operating analytical instruments, preparing samples, and performing routine instrument calibrations.

  • Mindset: You bring a "maker" mentality. You are detail-oriented, reliable, and enjoy the dynamic, collaborative energy of a scaling startup.

  • Languages: Working knowledge of English (sufficient for technical documentation and day-to-day team communication) is required. German is a plus, but not necessary.
