jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Pomocníci v kuchyni

Upratujete kuchyňu a zabezpečujete, že je vždy pripravená na ďalšie varenie. Dodržiavate hygienické a bezpečnostné predpisy (HACCP), takže sa naučíte, ako sa starať o bezpečnosť potravín. Po riadnom zaškolení sa samostatne staráte o prípravu raňajok, čo vám dáva možnosť ukázať svoje zručnosti. V prípade potreby a po zaučení zastupujete šéfkuchára. Pracovný čas je flexibilný, aby vyhovoval potrebám nášho tímu a zohľadňoval vašu pohodu. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

jobs.title: Ingénieur Cloud & Infrastructure (H/F)
jobs.description:
RESPONSABILITÉS :

Notre client est une startup luxembourgeoise innovante, spécialisée dans le cloud souverain. Elle accompagne les PME de tous secteurs dans leur transformation numérique, en mettant l'accent sur la sécurité, la performance et l'agilité. L'entreprise connaît une forte croissance, et recrute aujourd'hui pour renforcer son équipe technique un(e) :

INGÉNIEUR CLOUD & INFRASTRUCTURE (H/F)
CDI - LUXEMBOURG SUD - A PARTIR DE 45K€

Sous la responsabilité du Lead Architect, vous serez en charge de l' exploitation et de l'évolution d'une plateforme cloud certifiée ISO 27001, ainsi que des services qu'elle héberge. Vous interviendrez sur trois dimensions clés : l'exploitation technique, la conception d'architectures d'hébergement et le pilotage de projets de migration.
Vos principales missions :
-  Exploitation & évolution de la plateforme : assurer le maintien en conditions opérationnelles, la supervision, l'automatisation et l'évolution de la plateforme Cloud, ainsi que la gestion des incidents, changements et astreintes.
-  Architecture & solutions Cloud : analyser les besoins clients, concevoir des solutions d'hébergement adaptées et contribuer aux propositions techniques et à l'évolution de l'offre Cloud.
-  Sécurité & conformité : contribuer à la sécurisation des infrastructures, au suivi des événements de sécurité et au maintien de la certification ISO 27001.
-  Projets & relation client : piloter les projets de migration et de mise en production, accompagner les clients et revendeurs et assurer la documentation des solutions.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ :

De formation Bac+2 à Bac+5 en informatique, vous disposez de 5 ans minimum d'expérience en administration systèmes Linux. Une expérience en environnement Cloud, hébergement ou infrastructure est un réel atout.

Environnement technique :
-  Systèmes : Linux (Debian, Ubuntu)
-  Cloud & Virtualisation : Apache CloudStack, KVM
-  Conteneurisation & Orchestration : Docker, Kubernetes
-  Automatisation & Infrastructure as Code : Ansible, Terraform, Bash, Python
-  SIEM & Sécurité : Wazuh, OpenSearch
-  Supervision, sauvegarde & exploitation : outils de supervision et de sauvegarde

La maîtrise du français et de l'anglais est indispensable. Toute autre langue constituera un plus apprécié.

Savoir-être :

Vous êtes autonome, rigoureux et curieux, avec un bon sens des responsabilités. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et savez communiquer avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme clients. Vous êtes à l'aise pour documenter, formaliser et apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies.

Vous avez une appétence pour accompagner des collaborateurs juniors et les faire monter en compétences.

Cadre contractuel et avantages :
- CDI contrat luxembourgeois
- Cadre fiscal, medical et social attractif
- Télétravail : 1 jours / semaine
- Poste à pourvoir ASAP

NEXTGEN RH, cabinet de recrutement multi-spécialiste, vous accompagne tout au long du processus via une approche personnalisée, humaine et transparente.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Â 

Role

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

  • Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

  • Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

  • Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

  • Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

  • Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

  • Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

  • Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

  • Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

  • Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

  • Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Â 

Outcomes

  • Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

  • Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

  • AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

  • Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

Â 

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript

  • React.js / Next.js

  • HTML / CSS

  • WebSockets / streaming APIs

  • Node.js

  • REST / GraphQL APIs

Â 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

Â 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

Description du poste :

Vous souhaitez manager des équipes tout en contribuant au bien-être et à la conservation des animaux dans un environnement unique ?

Le ZooParc de Beauval recherche son futur Responsable Carnivores H/F pour piloter un périmètre composé de 3 secteurs animaliers : Koalas Pandas, Fauves et Otaries , chacun encadré par un Chef de secteur.

Votre rôle sera d'accompagner les Chefs de secteur, de faire progresser les équipes, d'optimiser l'organisation et de garantir un haut niveau d'exigence dans les pratiques animalières et la sécurité.

Profil

Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en management et maîtrisez l'encadrement d'équipes dans un environnement opérationnel exigeant.

Une expérience polyvalente dans le milieu animalier est nécessaire . Votre intérêt pour les espèces animales, notamment les carnivores, sera un véritable atout.

Reconnu pour votre leadership, votre capacité à prendre du recul et votre sang-froid, vous savez communiquer clairement, poser un cadre et prendre les décisions nécessaires.

Rigoureux, organisé et doté d'un bon esprit d'analyse, vous aimez faire progresser vos collaborateurs et optimiser les organisations.

Vous souhaitez vous investir dans un poste à responsabilités, au cœur des enjeux liés au bien-être animal, à la sécurité et au développement du ZooParc de Beauval ? Rejoignez-nous !

Poste ouvert aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Notre offre

À votre arrivée, vous bénéficierez d'une formation, d'un accompagnement et d'un parcours d'intégration. Un pack uniforme complet , adapté à votre métier, vous sera remis.

Vous profiterez également de nombreux avantages : accompagnement au logement, covoiturage via BlaBlaCar Daily , mutuelle, CSE, billets à tarifs préférentiels, crèche et événements d'entreprise.

Nous employons le masculin uniquement pour alléger le texte. Ce poste est ouvert aux femmes et aux hommes. Le ZooParc de Beauval pratique l'équité en matière d'emploi (Index Egapro 2026 : 84/100 ).

jobs.title: Senior Tax Accountant
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Tax team is growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Tax Accountant to support our global tax operations. In this role, you’ll run global indirect tax operations and strengthen the systems behind them. As Notion scales across products and jurisdictions, this role exists to make compliance, close, audits, and tax data more accurate, scalable, and audit-ready. You’ll own recurring sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business tax, registrations, notices, reconciliations, and related controls, while building exposure to income tax compliance and reporting. The work is hands-on and cross-functional: you’ll trace differences across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger with Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience partners.

 

This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Take ownership of recurring U.S. and global indirect-tax filings, calendars, data packages, notices, registrations, and close support—with accurate, review-ready work.

 - Establish a reliable reconciliation and exception workflow across billing, tax engines, filings, payments, and the general ledger, escalating issues clearly and early.

 - Use AI-enabled workflows and data tools to investigate variances, quality-check work papers, and improve documentation while preserving human review and controls.

 - Make tax operations more scalable and audit-ready by strengthening controls, process documentation, evidence, handoffs, audit support, and SOX walkthrough readiness.

 - Become a trusted partner to Accounting, Revenue, Billing, Product, Engineering, Data, and Customer Experience—and contribute to income tax compliance and reporting with guidance from experienced teammates.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 - At least 3 years of public accounting and/or industry tax experience, with a primary focus on indirect tax compliance and operations.

 - Hands-on experience with indirect tax compliance or operations, especially U.S. sales and use tax, VAT/GST, business taxes, or other non-income-based taxes; this is the foundation for owning Notion’s recurring global work.

 - Experience preparing accurate reconciliations, journal entries, filings, payments, and audit-ready work papers, with the ability to connect activity across source systems and the general ledger.

 - Strong operational judgment: you manage recurring deadlines, investigate exceptions, keep documentation organized, escalate issues promptly, and drive assigned work through completion.

 - Clear written and verbal communication, with a collaborative approach to working across Finance, Accounting, business teams, and external advisors.

 - Curiosity and learning agility, including willingness to build income-tax capability and demonstrated AI fluency—using AI to analyze data, investigate variances, improve documentation, perform quality checks, or automate repeatable workflows while validating outputs and protecting sensitive information.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $135,000 - $155,000 per year.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Secure Network Design, WWOS Global Solution (m/f)
jobs.description:
Senior Program Manager, Secure Network Design, WWOS Global Solution
Job ID: 10530871 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The Program Manager, Secure Network Design support the End-to-End Secure Network (E2ESN) organization within World Wide Operations Security WWOS, driving programs that create Earth's most reliably secure supply chain through prevention, intervention, and investigation. This role combines Amazon's core program management competencies with domain-specific expertise to architect, plan, and secure Amazon's global transportation network across supply chain miles – Global Mile, First Mile and Middle Mile OTR. Team apply the "Shift-Left" principle to engineer resilience into the network design architecture itself, building a capability that prevents incidents by design rather than chasing them after the fact.

Key job responsibilities

Program Planning & Execution

- Owns the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs with considerable impact across organizations or geographies
- Define program scope, goals, success criteria, and inputs/outputs metrics in collaboration with stakeholders
- Develop and maintain program roadmaps, glidepaths, and work-back schedules aligned to OP planning cycles
- Drive mechanisms (WBRs, MBRs, portfolio reviews) to track progress vs. plan and surface risks early
- Accountable for overall program strategy and tactically driving teams inside and outside the organization to deliver

Secure Network Design

- Architect a Secure-by-Design Transportation Network, embed security principles into network design decisions where security becomes a primary design variable alongside cost, speed, and service level.
- Defines secured network path strategies that ensure that theft and loss are structurally designed out through preventive architecture before they materialize
- Enable actionable intelligence that drives systematic improvements across the network
- Measure adoption rates and alignment metrics for deployed solutions
- Leverage AI-driven decision support and ensure investments are focused on the most at-risk vulnerabilities for maximum impact

Stakeholder Management & Influence

- Partner cross-functionally with Operations, Finance, Tech, Legal, and WWOS teams - Field Loss Prevention, Investigation teams.
- Facilitate alignment across AMER and INTL regional teams to ensure consistent solution deployment and best practices adoption
- Represent program status and strategic direction in leadership reviews
- Serve as the bridge between E2ESN Solutions teams and partner teams
- Build and maintain relationships with partner organizations

Delivery & Operational Excellence

- Identify and mitigate risks, resolve blockers, and escalate appropriately through WWOS governance
- Manage dependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives and workstreams
- Makes appropriate trade-offs to optimize timelines and deliverables in consultation with stakeholders
- Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, lessons learned, and mechanism design
- Establish and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) for program operations

Data & Analytics Stewardship

- Own program-level data quality, ensuring accurate $ loss / entitlement attribution by supply chain segment
- Partner with Data Services teams for dashboard development and automated network coverage tracking
- Parter with Finance team to drive theft/loss estimates using statistical models
- Support AI/ML integration into security solutions to reduce manual investigative burden

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in program management, logistics, operations, supply chain, transportation, or a related field
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Ability to collaborate and lead in a flexible, detail-oriented, fast-paced team environment
- Demonstrated ability to independently use AI tools in daily work, integrating them into program workflows to drive better outcomes, and guiding others on effective adoption

Preferred Qualifications

- Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
- Six-Sigma or equivalent certification
- Certified Protection Professional (CPP)
- ISO 28000 (Supply Chain Security Management System) or TAPA (Transported Asset Protection Association) certification
- Experience with supply chain security frameworks (ASIS, AIBM-CSCRM)

jobs.description:
Description des tâches:


Who we are

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation.
LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner.
The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services.
Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.
www.lnds.lu | LNDS on LinkedIn


Purpose of the job / project

Help design and deliver the data infrastructure that Luxembourg and its European partners rely on for secure, lawful access to sensitive data. You will work alongside senior architects on real systems with real deadlines and take on your own architectural scope as you go.

This is a fixed-term position of 24 months, created to meet a sustained increase in architecture work across our EU project portfolio.
You will work on one or more projects from that portfolio — currently including STORE-1PLUSMG, USE-1PLUSMG, SCAILED, the European Compliance Stack, DDSSC2, COOPAIFA and PANDAI — with assignments set by portfolio priorities and evolving as projects start and close.
We are looking for a Solution Architect to help design and deliver secure, large-scale data infrastructure, working alongside our senior architects.
You will consolidate functional and non-functional requirements from data providers and partner organisations and translate them into architecture documentation.
You will contribute to the specification, configuration, integration, and technical validation of the components behind our data services.
Working with community frameworks such as Gaia-X, IDSA and DSSC, you will help build the data solutions our partners across Europe depend on.


What you will do

Architecture design and documentation

Learn and deliver the core architecture artefacts, starting from established LNDS patterns and templates, and taking on more of the design work as your experience grows.
Maintain the architecture documentation set across assigned projects — keeping it current, internally consistent and ready for formal review. Several projects require successive versioned releases approved at fixed milestones.

Requirements and analysis

Support senior architects in gathering and documenting functional and non-functional requirements from data providers, partner organisations and internal stakeholders.
Analyse and document business constraints.

Implementation support

Work with engineering and operations colleagues to turn architecture into working systems.
Support the specification, configuration, and integration of components.
Support technical validation and acceptance activities, including preparing test scenarios and evidence.

Standards, compliance and quality

Learn, adopt and apply LNDS architectural standards, patterns and review practices consistently, and flag where they do not fit.
Support the implementation of technical and organisational measures under Data Protection by Design and Default, working with Legal and data governance colleagues.

Project and consortium contribution

Contribute to project deliverables and milestones, tracking your own commitments and raising slippage early.
Support proposal preparation with technical input and effort estimation.


Who you are

BSc or MSc in a scientific, technological or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology or computing.
1-2 years working explicitly as a solution or enterprise architect on large-scale or federated data systems.
Working knowledge of distributed systems, APIs and integration patterns, databases, and data modelling.
Exposure with cloud or container platforms, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipelines.
Foundational understanding of information security, authentication and authorisation, encryption, and network segmentation.
Able to write clear technical documentation and produce readable diagrams.
Awareness of GDPR and the broader EU data regulatory landscape.
Familiarity with agile delivery practices.
Excellent communication skills in English.
Working knowledge of one of Luxembourg's official languages (French, German or Luxembourgish) is a plus.
Curious, methodical, and comfortable speaking when you do not understand something.
Willingness to learn architectural concepts and methods, and to develop your information security and regulatory knowledge seriously.
Collaborative, adaptable, and able to work effectively in a cross-functional and multicultural environment.
Interest in health data, genomics, data spaces or public sector data infrastructure.
Prior experience in EU-funded projects is a plus.


About us

What we offer

Dynamic and innovative work environment
Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
Inclusive and diverse culture
European recognition and impactful projects
Shape the future of the data revolution


What sets us apart

The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking.
We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission.
We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies.
Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character.
Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.

We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.

Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting (m/f)
jobs.description:
Assistant Manager – Fund Accounting

Role Overview

Within the Fund Administration department, the Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing a portfolio of complex and high‑profile fund structures, ensuring high‑quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, and timely reporting.

The role combines technical expertise, team leadership, and client ownership. The Assistant Manager acts as a key escalation point for both clients and internal teams and supports the Manager in driving operational excellence, risk management, and process improvement.

Tasks

Client & Delivery Ownership

• Act as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of sophisticated clients (Private Equity, Private Debt, Evergreen structures, Hybrid structures, Open-ended structures).
• Assume end‑to‑end responsibility for service delivery, ensuring compliance with SLAs, fund documentation, and regulatory requirements.
• Manage client expectations proactively and handle escalations independently before involving the Manager where required.
Build and maintain trusted, long‑term client relationships, participating in client meetings, onboarding calls, and post‑audit reviews.

Onboarding

During client onboarding, the Assistant Manager undertakes several crucial tasks to ensure a smooth transition and establish a productive relationship with the new client. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Lead or actively support client onboardings, restructurings, migrations, and system set‑ups.
• Validate fund structures, valuation methodologies, fee models, and reporting frameworks in line with legal documents.
• Coordinate across internal teams (FA, TA, back office, Corporate, AIFM, Risk & Compliance, IT etc) to ensure seamless implementation.
• Review and sign‑off data migration and initial NAVs.

NAV Oversight & Technical Review

During Net Asset Value (NAV) oversight, the Assistant Manager play a critical role in ensuring accuracy, compliance, and smooth operations. Hereunder are some key responsibilities:

• Assume overall accountability for the NAV oversight framework across the assigned client portfolio, ensuring accuracy, consistency, timeliness, and compliance with fund documentation, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements.
• Oversee the end‑to‑end NAV production cycle, including capital activity, income recognition, valuation inputs, investor allocations, and fee calculations.
• Perform in‑depth technical reviews and approvals of complex NAVs, including:

o Private equity, private debt, evergreen funds, and multi‑compartment structures
o Complex instruments (loans, profit‑participating notes, derivatives, look‑through investments)
o FX treatments, waterfalls, and performance fee mechanisms
• Act as a technical reference point on Lux GAAP, IFRS, consolidation and structure‑specific treatments.

• Ensure all NAV‑related deliverables meet agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and internal quality standards.
• Maintain strong documentation standards, including working papers, reconciliation files, and management review evidence, to support both internal controls and external audit requirements.
• Support the preparation of financial statements inputs by ensuring consistency between NAVs, accounting records, and statutory reporting.

Risk Management, Controls & Audit

• Act as a key control owner for the assigned client portfolio, ensuring that fund accounting activities are performed in line with internal policies, ISAE requirements, regulatory obligations, and client documentation.
• Ensure that appropriate preventive and detective controls are in place, operating effectively, and evidenced.
• Review and challenge unusual transactions, valuation judgments, late data, or deviations from standard processes.
• Act as the primary escalation point for NAV issues, breaches, or errors, ensuring timely resolution, root‑cause analysis, and clear documentation.
• Act as the primary liaison for external auditors, managing audit queries and timelines.
• Support the Manager in maintaining a strong control culture across the team and client portfolio.

Team Leadership & People Management

• Provide day‑to‑day supervision of Senior Fund Accountants and Fund Accountants within the team.
• Allocate work effectively, taking into account complexity, risk and deadlines.
• Review deliverables prepared by the team and provide structured feedback.
• Support training, development, and performance management of team members.
• Promote a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and quality.
• Escalate capacity, performance, or quality concerns to the Manager with proposed solutions.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

• Continuously assess existing fund accounting and reporting processes to identify inefficiencies, risks, and improvement opportunities.
• Actively contribute to system enhancements, automation, and standardisation.
• Support the Manager in implementing new operating models, tools, and best practices.
• Encourage a culture of continuous improvement and risk awareness

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics
• ACCA (or equivalent) – qualified or advanced stage preferred
• Strong knowledge of Lux GAAP and IFRS (including consolidation)
• 8+ years of experience in fund administration, primarily for closed-ended funds, open-ended funds and evergreen/hybrid funds, with experience in various asset classes (private equity, private debt, listed loans)
• Prior experience reviewing NAVs and supervising team members is essential.
• Experience in capital hedging and portfolio management.
• Added value for candidates familiar with public loans managed through Allvue or WSO platforms.
• Languages: English fluent; French and/or German is an advantage.
• Additional advantage for candidates with experience using Paxus.

Skills/Behavior

In addition to demonstrating IQEQ's Group Values (Authentic, Bold, Collaborative), the Assistant Manager is expected to:

• Take ownership and accountability
• Demonstrate sound judgement and risk awareness
• Lead and develop others
• Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders
• Navigate complexity and ambiguity
• Balance client service with internal control discipline
• Plan, prioritise, and delegate effectively
• Continuously develop technical and leadership skills

jobs.title: Assistant Manager –  Data analyst AML and FATCA/CRS (m/f)
jobs.description:
Role purpose

This role provides management reporting, business insights, regulatory reporting support and process improvement solutions for the Luxembourg AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS function. The Assistant Manager helps maintain a consolidated Luxembourg-wide view of risks across the client, investor and beneficial ownership population, supporting planning, performance monitoring, capacity management, local regulatory accountability and decision-making.

Working closely with operational teams and stakeholders, the role identifies opportunities to automate repetitive processes, improve data quality, strengthen controls and enhance reporting efficiency. It supports the production of regulatory information required by the CSSF, the Luxembourg tax authorities (AED) and, increasingly, AMLA, with AMLA-related requests already being received and processed by the function.
A significant portion of the information used by the role relates to highly confidential client, investor and beneficial ownership data. The role therefore requires direct Luxembourg access to the full data population, including clients and investors who have refused outsourcing arrangements or whose contractual confidentiality undertakings restrict data transfers outside Luxembourg, in addition to Luxembourg professional secrecy and GDPR requirements.

The role sits at the intersection of AML/KYC operations, governance, data analytics, AI and automation, ensuring that transformation initiatives remain aligned with Luxembourg regulatory requirements, client expectations and operational realities. Its primary purpose is oversight, data consolidation, quality challenge, management intelligence, regulatory reporting support and automation, rather than operational processing.

The role suits someone analytical and process-driven, who can turn complex data into clear business recommendations and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Responsibilities (how we will measure success)

• Timely and accurate delivery of management reporting, dashboards and KPI packs to agreed deadlines;
• Reporting outputs that stakeholders actively use to monitor performance, capacity and workload;
• Measurable efficiency gains from automating manual and repetitive reporting processes;
• Improved data quality and stronger reporting controls, with issues identified and resolved at source;
• Solving problems by providing innovative ideas in improving/developing internal systems to meet set objectives & maximise the team efficiency;
• Clear, actionable insights and recommendations that support planning and management decision-making.
• Effective consolidated Luxembourg-wide oversight of AML/KYC, FATCA and CRS risks, including the full client and investor population relevant to local regulatory accountability;
• Reliable management information, data analytics and regulatory reporting support for Luxembourg management, RCs and Conducting Officers;

Tasks (what does the role do on a day-to-day basis)

• Designing & implementing automated reporting processes and KPIs, using Excel (including VBA), Microsoft Power BI and Power Platform;
• Building and maintaining dashboards, management reporting packs, forecasts and capacity models for operational teams and senior management;

jobs.title: Senior Fund Accounting Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The Senior Fund Accountant is responsible for the oversight and delivery of fund accounting services for a portfolio of closed‑ended Private Equity structures domiciled in Luxembourg. The role focuses on technical fund accounting, NAV oversight, review of complex transactions and financial statements, and close interaction with clients, auditors, and internal teams.

The position requires strong technical expertise in Luxembourg GAAP, a solid understanding of Luxembourg fund laws and structures (RAIF, SIF, SICAV‑SCA, SCSp, SARLs holding structures), and hands‑on experience with closed‑ended private equity fund mechanics.

Tasks

Fund Accounting & NAV Oversight

• Act as the primary reviewer and controller for NAV calculations across a portfolio of closed‑ended funds, including feeder/master and SPV structures.
• Review complex accounting areas, including excused investors, distribution waterfall mechanisms, carried interest, equalisation amongst others
• Ensure NAVs are prepared in accordance with applicable accounting standard (Luxembourg GAAP/IFRS), fund documentation, and agreed accounting policies.
• Review, challenge and approve NAVs, investor reporting, and supporting workpapers.

Financial Statements & Audit Coordination

• Review annual and interim financial statements under Lux GAAP and IFRS where applicable.
• Ensure consistency between NAVs, financial statements, and underlying accounting records.
• Act as the main point of contact for external auditors during interim and year‑end audits.
• Prepare and review responses to audit queries, including technical accounting positions and judgmental areas.
• Contribute to drafting and reviewing accounting policies and disclosure notes.

Client & Stakeholder Management

• Serve as a key contact for clients, investment managers, and other stakeholders.
• Explain complex accounting topics (unrealised FX movements, reinvestment mechanics, NAV drivers, equalisation etc) in a clear and pragmatic manner.
• Participate in client onboarding, including review of legal documentation from an accounting perspective and definition of fund‑specific accounting treatments.

Fund Onboarding & System Set‑Up

• Oversee fund onboarding activities from an accounting perspective, including: Review of fund documentation (LPA, PPM, side letters)
• Validation of chart of accounts and accounting models
• Review of data migration and opening balances
• Ensure correct setup of funds in accounting systems

Risk Management, Controls & Process Improvement

• Identify accounting and operational risks across the client portfolio and ensure appropriate controls are in place.
• Review KPIs and deliverables provided by back office or Global Delivery Teams (GCD) and challenge quality and timeliness where required.
• Support process improvements, standardisation, and automation initiatives within fund accounting

Team Support & Knowledge Sharing

• Act as a technical reference point for junior team members.
• Provide coaching, training, and on‑the‑job guidance on private equity and Luxembourg‑specific accounting topics.
• Support managers in maintaining high technical and quality standards across the team.

Required Experience / Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• 4–6 years of experience in fund accounting within a private equity environment.
• Strong practical knowledge of Luxembourg GAAP and closed‑ended fund accounting.
• Solid understanding of Luxembourg fund structures and legal concepts (ring‑fencing, compartments/sub‑funds, master‑feeder structures).
• Experience dealing with auditors and client‑facing interactions.
• Professional qualification (ACCA or equivalent) is an advantage.
• Experience with fund accounting systems such as Investran is a strong asset.
• Fluent in English; French is an advantage.

Skills/Behavior

• Strong analytical and review skills with attention to detail.
• Ability to interpret fund documentation and translate it into accounting treatments.
• Comfortable handling complex and non‑standard transactions.
• Clear and confident communicator with internal teams and clients.
• Proactive, solutions‑oriented mindset.
• Ability to operate autonomously while collaborating effectively within a team.

The remuneration for this position shall be based on qualification and experience.

Applications including a cover letter and a curriculum vitae should be sent before April 30, 2026 via our website

jobs.title: Head of Internal Audit (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
C-27001 HEAD OF INTERNAL AUDIT
Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies, LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

Context

As the Head of Internal Audit, you will lead, structure and continuously develop LIST's Internal Audit Service, an independent and objective assurance and advisory function serving the Board of Directors through the Finance and Audit Committee.
The role provides independent assurance on the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal control, while supporting compliance with applicable laws and regulations and contributing to the continuous improvement of LIST's organisation and operations.

In addition to defining the internal audit strategy and the risk-based annual audit plan, you will oversee the full audit lifecycle, from planning and execution to reporting, follow-up and quality assurance. The role also leads specific assurance, advisory and investigation assignments and ensures that Internal Audit methodologies, policies, processes and the Internal Audit Charter remain robust and aligned with professional internal audit standards.

Working closely with the Board of Directors, the Finance and Audit Committee, the CEO, Executive Management, Risk Management, external auditors and auditees, you will provide clear insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making while safeguarding the independence, objectivity and credibility of the function.

Your team and environment

Your team - 3 people

• Head of Internal Audit - 1 | leadership of the function, audit strategy, governance and stakeholder engagement
• Internal Audit collaborators - 2 | contribution to assurance, advisory, audit follow-up and continuous improvement activities

The Internal Audit Service operates as an independent function within LIST and coordinates with Risk Management, where relevant, to leverage synergies and avoid duplication of work without prejudice to its independence.
You will report to the Chair of the Board of Directors, or to the Vice-Chair in the event of replacement of the Chair, in accordance with the Internal Audit Charter. For administrative and day-to-day matters, you will report to the CEO.

Description

You will be mainly responsible for:

Internal Audit Leadership & Governance

• Lead and develop the Internal Audit Service, setting a high standard for performance, integrity, objectivity, confidentiality and competence
• Define and implement the internal audit strategy in alignment with LIST's goals and objectives
• Develop, maintain and continuously improve the Internal Audit Charter, policies, methodologies, processes and procedures
• Act as a trusted and independent reference for the Board of Directors, Finance and Audit Committee, CEO and Executive Management on governance, risk and internal control matters

Risk-Based Audit Planning & Delivery

• Identify and prioritise LIST's key risk areas and prepare the annual risk-based internal audit plan for validation by the Finance and Audit Committee and approval by the Board of Directors
• Oversee and conduct assurance, advisory and investigation assignments, including complex and specific missions, in accordance with the Internal Audit Charter and the IIA Global Internal Audit Standards
• Adapt the audit plan and mission work programmes when emerging events or risks require timely action
• Ensure audit work is appropriately planned, documented, reviewed and archived, and that audit conclusions are supported by robust evidence

Governance, Risk, Internal Control & Compliance

• Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of governance, risk management and internal control systems and procedures, with a focus on preventing or detecting risks, losses, errors and fraud
• Coordinate Internal Audit activities with Risk Management and other assurance providers where appropriate, while preserving independence and avoiding duplication
• Escalate significant deficiencies, fraud concerns and other material issues to the appropriate governance bodies and management

Reporting & Stakeholder Engagement

• Review and validate internal audit reports and ensure recommendations are clear, concise, operational and improvement-oriented
• Present audit results, insights and recommendations to auditees, Executive Management, the Finance and Audit Committee and the Board of Directors
• Build constructive relationships with key internal and external stakeholders while maintaining the independence and objectivity required of the function

Follow-up, Quality Assurance & Continuous Improvement

• Lead the follow-up of agreed actions and report progress to the CEO, Finance and Audit Committee and Board of Directors, ensuring that actions are implemented or that residual risk is formally accepted by management
• Establish and maintain a quality assurance and improvement programme for Internal Audit
• Monitor developments in governance, risk management and internal audit practices, including relevant professional standards, and translate them into continuous improvement of the function

Team Leadership & Capability Development

• Lead, coach and develop the Internal Audit team, supporting colleagues in complex assignments and helping remove obstacles to successful audit delivery
• Foster continuous learning and rapid familiarisation with audited subjects across a broad and evolving organisational environment
• Promote LIST's mission, values, internal codes and rules within the Internal Audit Service

Background & experience

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Audit, Internal Control, Risk Management or a similar field.
• Extensive experience in internal and/or external audit, with demonstrated exposure to complex assurance, advisory and investigation assignments.
• Ability to evaluate complex data and business processes.
• Proven ability to lead, structure and continuously develop an internal audit function, including strategy, annual planning, methodologies, quality assurance and team development.
• Strong knowledge of professional internal audit standards and internal control frameworks, together with a deep understanding of risk management principles and practices.
• Broad knowledge of regulatory and business requirements relevant to LIST's environment, including accounting, finance, IP valorisation, GDPR, competition law, commercial law, labour law, State aid and public procurement.
• Proficiency in data analytics and relevant audit and ERP tools.
• Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills, with a methodical and rigorous approach and high attention to detail.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and French, with the ability to present findings and recommendations.
• Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with the Board of Directors, Finance and Audit Committee, Executive Management, auditees, external auditors and other stakeholders.
• High ethical standards, integrity, independence and objectivity, with proven ability to handle sensitive and confidential information.
• Ability to work effectively under pressure, manage short deadlines.
• Familiarity with Research and Technology Organisations (RTOs) is a plus.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works [...]

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA PREDŠKOLSKE DJECE
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (NN br. 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22,101/23 i 22/26), članka 38. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića Balončić, članka 7. Kolektivnog ugovora za zaposlene u Dječjem vrtiću Balončić, Svetvinčenat ( KLASA: 152-01/22-01/01, UR.BROJ: 2163-35-02-1-22-1 od 23.12.2022. godine), Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića Balončić, na 15. sjednici održanoj dana 17. rujna 2026. godine objavljuje

N A T J E Č A J

ZA ZASNIVANJE RADNOG ODNOSA

Za obavljanje poslova na radnom mjestu : ODGOJITELJ (m/ž)

- 2 izvršitelja (m/ž) - na određeno puno radno vrijeme (40 sati tjedno)

Mjesto rada: Dječji vrtić Balončić, Svetvinčenat 98A (matični objekt - sjedište) i

Svetvinčenat 96 ( područni objekt), 52342 Svetvinčenat

Uvjeti za radno mjesto:

Poslove odgojitelja djece od navršenih šest mjeseci života do polaska u osnovnu školu može obavljati osoba koja je završila studij za Rani i predškolski odgoj propisan Pravilnikom o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno – obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (NN 145/24 i 62/25) i razine obrazovanja za rad na radnome mjestu odgojitelja, a koji može biti:

a) sveučilišni prijediplomski studij,

b) stručni prijediplomski studij,

c) studij kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s prijašnjim propisima,

d) sveučilišni diplomski studij,

e) stručni diplomski studij.

  • ispunjavanje uvjeta iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju
  • utvrđena zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta

Radni odnos u dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba koja ima zapreke iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju.

Prijava na natječaj ( vlastoručno potpisana) treba sadržavati priloge u izvorniku odnosno ovjerenoj preslici i to kako slijedi:

  • Životopis
  • Dokaz o državljanstvu
  • Dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi
  • Potvrdu iz elektroničke baze podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o radno pravnom statusu, ne stariju od dana objave natječaja;
  • Dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju;
    • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak sukladno čl. 25. st. 1 i 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne starije od dana objave natječaja;
    • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi prekršajni postupak sukladno čl. 25. st. 3 i 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne starije od dana objave natječaja;
    • potvrdu nadležnog Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidat nema izrečenu mjeru žurnog izdvajanja djeteta iz obitelji ili mjeru za zaštitu osobnih prava i dobrobiti djeteta u nadležnosti suda sukladno članku 25. st. 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju), ne stariju od dana objave natječaja
  • Presliku rodnog lista
  • Uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova odgojitelja/ice ( prije zasnivanja radnog odnosa, odabrani kandidat će se uputiti na liječnički pregled radi utvrđivanja zdravstvene sposobnosti)

Ako se na natječaj javi osoba iz članka 24. stavka 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, koja je završila učiteljski studij, prilikom prijave na natječaj dužna je dostaviti dokaz da nije bila zaposlena u sustavu predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja na radnom mjestu odgojitelja.

U skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe obaju spolova koje ispunjavaju propisane uvjete.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju posebnog zakona, u prijavi su dužni pozvati se na to pravo te dostaviti dokaze o priznavanju posebnog statusa te dokaz o načinu prestanka radnog odnosa kod prethodnog poslodavca.

Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) te članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

jobs.title: VIŠI ASISTENT NA ERC STARTING GRANT PROJEKTU „EVERY SMELL YOU TAKE – SMELL-INDUCED CONDITIONING OF THE IMMUNE SYSTEM DURING INFECTIONS (M/Ž)
jobs.description:
Na temelju odluke Fakultetskog vijeća, Sveučilište u Rijeci, Medicinski fakultet raspisuje NATJEČAJ za izbor suradnika na suradničko radno mjesto viši asistent (m/ž), znanstveno područje Biomedicina i zdravstvo, znanstveno polje Temeljne medicinske znanosti, znanstvena grana citologija, histologija i embriologija, za potrebe znanstvenog istraživanja na ERC Starting Grant projektu „Every smell you take – Smell - induced conditioning of the immune system during infections“ na Zavodu za histologiju i embriologiju Medicinskog fakulteta u Rijeci, 1 (jedan) izvršitelj/ica, s punim radnim vremenom, na određeno vrijeme do 31. listopada 2030. godine. UVJETI:
  • Razina 8.2 – iz područja biomedicine i zdravstva i biotehničkih znanosti,
  • izvrsno znanje engleskog jezika,
  • poznavanje rada na računalu.
DODATNI UVJETI:
  • dosadašnja priznanja i nagrade za izvrsnost u istraživanju i istraživački rad,
  • sudjelovanje u znanstveno-istraživačkom radu (znanstveni projekti), objavljeni radovi, osobna izlaganja na znanstvenim konferencijama, sudjelovanje na ljetnim školama i tečajevima.
Dokumentacija koju je potrebno priložiti (u PDF formatu): životopis i dokazi o ispunjavanju uvjeta. Prijave na natječaj mogu dostaviti osobe oba spola (članak 13. stavak 2. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova, NN 82/08, 69/17). Kandidati koji su stekli obrazovanje izvan Republike Hrvatske, moraju dostaviti mišljenje nadležne agencije o stečenoj inozemnoj stručnoj kvalifikaciji ili dokaz da je pokrenut postupak za stjecanje istog: https://www.azvo.hr/hr/ured-enic-naric/priznavanje-kvalifikacija/priznavanje-i-vrednovanje-inozemnih-obrazovnih-kvalifikacija . Kandidati koji se na temelju posebnih propisa pozivaju na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja, obvezni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze koje posebni propisi određuju za ostvarivanje tog prava. Takvi kandidati ostvaruju prednost prilikom zapošljavanja u odnosu na ostale kandidate, samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članova njihovih obitelji (popis dokaza za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju- ZOHBDR 2021.pdf (gov.hr)), Zakonu o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (popis dokaza za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju- Zakon o civilnim stradalnicima iz DR.pdf (gov.hr)), dužni su se uz prijavu na natječaj pozvati na to pravo, te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju tih uvjeta. Prijavom na natječaj, kandidati natječaja su izričito suglasni da Medicinski fakultet u Rijeci kao voditelj zbirke osobnih podataka može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno važećim pozitivnim pravnim propisima. Fakultet pridržava pravo provesti testiranje kandidata, a o čemu će kandidati koji su predali pravovremene i potpune prijave koje ispunjavaju sve formalne uvjete natječaja biti naknadno obaviješteni. Kandidati koji se ne odazovu razgovoru pred povjerenstvom i/ili testiranju gube status kandidata i mogućnost sudjelovanja u daljnjem kvalifikacijskom postupku. Fakultet pridržava pravo poništiti natječaj i ne izabrati ni jednog kandidata, bez posebnog obrazloženja. Potpuna prijava smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u ovom natječaju. Nepotpune, nepravovremene te prijave koje ne udovoljavaju formalnim uvjetima natječaja neće se razmatrati. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 30 (trideset) dana od dana objave natječaja. Prijave se podnose putem elektroničke pošte pisarnica@medri.uniri.hr s naznakom „Natječaj za izbor višeg asistenta na projektu „Every smell you take – Smell - induced conditioning of the immune system during infections“. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka će biti objavljena po završetku natječajnog postupka na mrežnim stranicama Medicinskog fakulteta u Rijeci.
