jobs.title: Linux System Administrator - 19618
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.

Role Summary

An experienced Linux System Administrator is needed for a consulting assignment focused on designing, building and maintaining a GPU-enabled remote desktop and virtual desktop infrastructure environment. The platform supports high-performance remote desktops for pre-processing and post-processing of High-Performance Computing (HPC) workloads, including simulation, visualization and rendering.

The environment is based on Rocky Linux and Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), with technologies including X11, Xfce4, NICE DCV, EnginFrame and SLURM. The assignment has a strong emphasis on automation, platform engineering, system architecture and long-term operational sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

    Design, deploy, operate and maintain a Linux-based GPU-enabled VDI and remote desktop environment.
    Develop and maintain automation and Infrastructure-as-Code solutions to enable consistent, repeatable platform deployments.
    Use Ansible primarily to automate configuration management, provisioning and operational workflows.
    Ensure that the platform remains secure, scalable, high-performing and maintainable over time.
    Support remote desktop use cases for HPC-related simulation, visualization and rendering workloads.
    Collaborate closely with HPC and infrastructure engineering teams on platform design, integration and operations.
    Document solution architecture, system configurations, deployment workflows and operational procedures.
    Contribute to monitoring, observability and troubleshooting of complex Linux infrastructure environments.

Technical Stack & Requirements

    Rocky Linux and/or Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).
    Ansible and Infrastructure-as-Code practices for automated deployments and configuration management.
    Bash scripting; Python is advantageous.
    Git and GitLab, including experience working with CI/CD pipelines.
    X11 and Linux desktop environments, particularly Xfce4 and GNOME.
    Remote rendering, display and visualization technologies, including NICE DCV and EnginFrame.
    Networking, infrastructure security and monitoring capabilities.
    Prometheus-based monitoring and observability tooling.
    HPC environments and the SLURM workload manager are advantageous.
    Docker, Podman and Open OnDemand are beneficial.

Qualifications & Experience

The ideal consultant has solid hands-on experience as a Linux System Administrator, preferably in Rocky Linux or RHEL environments. Strong experience in automation and Infrastructure-as-Code is required, ideally with Ansible or comparable tooling. The role requires proficiency in Bash scripting, while Python experience is considered beneficial.

Experience with CI/CD practices, version control, Linux graphical environments, remote display technologies, networking, security and monitoring is expected. The consultant should be capable of designing scalable, maintainable technical platforms and independently taking ownership of complex infrastructure environments. Experience supporting HPC platforms, SLURM, remote visualization solutions and container technologies is considered advantageous.

jobs.title: Automotive Design & Development Engineer
jobs.description:
The Automotive Design & Development Engineer is responsible for the design, development, testing, and validation of automotive components and systems in accordance with international automotive standards and Swedish industry practices. The role involves technical responsibility from concept phase through series production.

The position requires advanced engineering competence and independent technical decision-making.

Main Duties and Responsibilities

The employee will perform the following tasks:

Design & Development

    •    Develop and design automotive components and subsystems using CAD software (e.g., CATIA, Siemens NX, Creo, SolidWorks).

    •    Prepare 2D drawings and 3D models including GD&T specifications.

    •    Conduct tolerance analysis and material selection.

    •    Lead concept design reviews and technical feasibility studies.

Engineering Analysis & Validation

    •    Perform engineering simulations such as FEA and CFD.

    •    Support prototype builds and validation testing.

    •    Prepare Design Verification Plan & Report (DVP&R).

    •    Conduct DFMEA and risk assessments.

Product Lifecycle Management

    •    Manage engineering change requests (ECR/ECN).

    •    Prepare technical documentation in compliance with automotive quality standards (IATF 16949, ISO standards).

    •    Coordinate with manufacturing for production readiness.

Supplier & Cross-Functional Coordination

    •    Interface with suppliers for component development and cost optimization.

    •    Support procurement and quality teams during APQP and PPAP processes.

    •    Provide technical support during vehicle launch and production ramp-up.

Qualification Requirements

The position requires:

    •    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or equivalent.

    •    Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in automotive product design and development.

    •    Proficiency in advanced CAD tools (CATIA/NX/Creo/SolidWorks).

    •    Knowledge of automotive development processes (APQP, PPAP, DFMEA).

    •    Experience in engineering simulations (FEA/CFD preferred).

    •    Strong knowledge of automotive safety and regulatory standards.

    •    Fluent English (spoken and written).

The position requires independent problem-solving skills and the ability to work in cross-functional international teams.

Employment Terms

    •    Employment type: Full-time, Project based

    •    Working hours: 40 hours per week

    •    Salary: Salary in line with Swedish collective agreement and meeting the minimum salary requirement for work permit eligibility

    •    Benefits: Occupational pension, insurance, and employment conditions according to Swedish labor law and applicable collective agreement

5. Level of Responsibility

This role is classified as a qualified engineering position requiring higher education and specialized technical competence. The employee will independently manage assigned development projects and contribute to technical decision-making.

jobs.title: HEAD OF TECHNICAL OPERATIONS AND NP CAMO
jobs.description:
Company description:

Scandinavian Airlines System SAS

Job description:  Description  

Do you want to lead the continuing airworthiness function for one of Scandinavia’s largest airline fleets?As Head of Technical Operations and NP CAMO, you will hold the regulatory responsibility for ensuring the airworthiness, safety, compliance, and cost-effective operation of the SAS fleet. Reporting directly to the Accountable Manager, you will lead the CAMO organization and play a critical role in ensuring that all continuing airworthiness activities are conducted in accordance with EASA regulations, company requirements, and operational objectives.This is a senior leadership role with significant operational, regulatory, organizational, and strategic responsibility.

     Challenges you will work on:  

•    Regulatory responsibility for airworthy, safe and economical operation of SAS's aircraft fleet under the limitation of the requirements imposed by European aviation regulations in accordance with EASA Part-CAMO and EASA Air Operations regulation.Main Tasks•    Ensure the development, updating and approval of the fleet's maintenance programs.•    Ensure that all maintenance requirements from manufacturers and authorities are evaluated, implemented and accomplished within the applicable compliance limits.•    Ensure the provision and preparation of approved documentation for all maintenance, repairs and modifications carried out on the aircraft fleet.•    Ensure that the aircraft with continuing airworthiness and approved configuration of the fleet are maintained in accordance with EASA Part-CAMO and Part-M, as applicable, and EASA Air Operations requirements, and that records are kept showing the airworthiness status.•    Ensure that all maintenance, including line maintenance and base maintenance, is planned and executed within the deadlines prescribed in the individual aircraft type maintenance programs and applicable maintenance programme limitations, approved maintenance data, and aircraft technical log requirements.•    Ensure that technical services for aircraft, engines and components are contracted in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, as well as SAS's operational and commercial requirements.•    Ensure the proper storage and management of flight documentation.•    Ensure that SAS's overall maintenance needs are carried out on competitive terms.•    Ensure that continuing airworthiness activities are performed in accordance with applicable requirements, approved procedures, and AOC conditions and limitations, and that aircraft airworthiness and regulatory compliance are maintained.•    Ensure hazards, occurrences, and non-compliances are identified, assessed, and addressed, and that appropriate corrective actions are implemented.•    Ensure clear lines of responsibility and escalation are established and maintained and shall, within the scope of delegated authority, assess and escalate risks affecting airworthiness to the Accountable Manager or other authorized decision-making level, as applicable.Managerial Responsibility and Mandate•    Legal and organizational responsibility for the tasks within Continuing Airworthiness Management.•    Personnel responsibility for all CAMO personnel, with direct leadership responsibility for the management team.•    Delegated budget responsibility for the operation of Technical Operations within SAS CAMO.•    Member of the Accountable Manager management team and contributor to achieving and developing company goals and objectives.

     The Team  

Continuing Airworthiness Management constitutes a key function within SAS operations and requires extensive collaboration across the organization.The role works closely with operational functions throughout SAS and maintains strong relationships with aircraft, engine and equipment manufacturers, maintenance providers, suppliers, and aviation authorities.As Head of Technical Operations and NP CAMO, you will lead the CAMO organization and its management team while supporting a culture focused on safety, compliance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

     To be successful we believe you have  

Key Competencies•    Extensive experience within Continuing Airworthiness Management and aviation technical operations. •    Strong knowledge of EASA Part-CAMO, Part-M, Part-145, and Air Operations requirements. •    Experience leading technical and operational teams in a complex, regulated environment. •    A relevant university degree in Engineering, Aviation Management, or a related field. •    Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills. •    Experience working with aviation authorities, aircraft manufacturers, and maintenance organizations. •    The ability to balance safety, compliance, operational performance, and commercial objectives. A strategic mindset combined with a hands-on approach to leadership and execution.



In addition, we believe you are:•    A strong and inspiring leader with excellent stakeholder management skills.•    Comfortable operating in a highly regulated and complex operational environment.•    Strategic while maintaining a strong operational focus.•    Decisive and able to make informed decisions balancing safety, compliance, operational needs, and business objectives.•    A strong communicator who builds trust and collaboration across functions and organizations.•    Structured, accountable, and committed to maintaining the highest safety and compliance standards.

jobs.title: Olsaro is looking to hire a CTO
jobs.description:
Are you a visionary technology leader with a passion for transforming agriculture through science?

Are you driven to lead R&D innovation at the intersection of biotechnology, sustainability, and food security?

OlsAro Crop Biotech is looking for a dynamic Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to guide our growing team and technical vision as we tackle one of the greatest challenges of our time: feeding the world in a changing climate.

About Us

We are Olsaro Crop Biotech, a pioneering trait development and pre-breeding startup dedicated to developing solutions that empower agriculture to withstand a changing climate. Our focus is on enhancing crop resilience through innovative genetic materials, with the first focus on wheat. From tackling abiotic stresses like salinity and heat to improving nitrogen use efficiency, we are at the forefront of trait development innovation to support resilience and global food security. Having closed a successful seed funding round, we are scaling our efforts both technologically and commercially, aiming for food system resilience for future generations.

The Role: Chief Technology Officer

As our CTO, you will bring a strong background in trait development and the seed industry, taking on a central role in OlsAro’s technology journey. You will lead the R&D team, shape our platform strategy, and drive innovation across trait discovery and variety development. Reporting directly to the CEO and serving as a key member of the senior leadership team, you will have full ownership of the technology roadmap and its execution. This is a highly empowered role with significant influence over both strategic direction and day-to-day decision-making. You will work alongside the CSO as a peer. The CSO, will be responsible for advising technical expertise and setting longer term strategy as a co-founder/C-suite leader.

Your expertise will enable the rapid evelopment and scale-up of breakthrough biotech solutions, working closely with internal teams, external partners, and strategic investors.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute OlsAro’s long-term vision in trait development for cereals.

• Oversee platform development and trait development pipelines from concept to field.

• Lead, inspire, develop and expand our interdisciplinary R&D team.

• Oversee timely, budget-conscious project delivery, while managing resources effectively.

• Forge and manage high-impact collaborations with seed industry and research partners.

• Secure and manage public funding opportunities to support strategic partnerships and R&D initiatives, enabling innovation and long-term growth.

• Build data-driven infrastructure and oversee bioinformatics development.

• Integrate emerging technologies such as gene editing, molecular breeding, and AI-powered trait discovery.

• Represent OlsAro in customer, scientific, regulatory, and investment communities.

• Ensure high standards for reproducibility, data integrity, and regulatory compliance.

Required Qualifications

• Proven leadership experience (7+ years) in technology and R&D roles within agtech, preferably seed industry. Including a strong ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and manage complex projects.

• Ph.D. or equivalent experience in Molecular Biology, Plant Biotechnology, Computational Biology, or related field.

• Experience working in commercial trait development, breeding in a seed or trait development company.

• Proven skills in representing an organization in different communities and contexts, including driving the OlsAro tech-agenda in commercial dialogs.

• Demonstrated expertise in publicly presenting tech-driven business cases and taking part in discussions at business conferences and in scientific communities.

• Proven track record of attracting public funding for R&D and partnerships.

• Experience in trait development methodologies, molecular techniques, data integration, phenomics, and data management tools.

• Strategic thinker with excellent problem-solving, communication, and decisionmaking skills.

• Entrepreneurial mindset and hands-on approach to building systems in a fastpaced startup environment.

• In-depth understanding of regulatory pathways for the commercialization of seeds and traits.

• Expertise in intellectual property development, technology licensing and scaling R&D and product platforms, preferably within startup or early-stage environments.

• Fluent in English.

Join Us

If you are a visionary technology leader with a passion for transforming agriculture through science, then we invite you to join our journey to revolutionize crop development and to contribute to our mission of advancing climate adaptation in cereals.

Position Details

• Type: Full-time, permanent

• Start Date: From 15th of October 2026 (flexible based on candidate availability)

• Location: Gothenburg, Sweden (Medicinaregatan 9C). Physical attendance is mandatory.

• Applications will be evaluated continuously.

How to apply

Please provide your CV and cover letter outlining your qualifications and relevant experience.

Why Join OlsAro in Gothenburg, Sweden?

• Gothenburg is Sweden’s dynamic innovation hub, where world-class universities, cutting-edge startups, and a fast-growing life sciences sector come together in a vibrant, forward-looking city. Beyond its strong professional opportunities, it consistently ranks among Europe’s most livable cities, offering an exceptional quality of life, outstanding healthcare, and a well-functioning social support system. With its welcoming atmosphere, lively cultural scene, cozy cafés, coastal charm, and easy access to Sweden’s beautiful natural parcs. Enjoy the balance of urban culture and nature—with coastlines, archipelagos, forests, and hiking trails at your doorstep.

• Gothenburg is an English-friendly city, with an international community and vibrant tech and research scene

• Sweden offers a high-quality, tuition-free public education system from preschool to university. International and bilingual schools are available in Gothenburg. Sweden consistently ranks highly in international education assessments such as the Trends in International Mathematics and Science Study (TIMSS), reflecting the strong academic foundation provided by the Swedish school system.

• Sweden is a leader in sustainability, gender equality, and family-friendly policies, making it an ideal place to build both a career and a life.

WHO WE ARE

Working as part of a demand-driven, efficient, circular supply chain, our dynamic logistics teams are consciously committed to and guided by our values. We work with scalable and innovative technical solutions, with our customer in mind. We don’t just go with the flow- we manage it, together with our service-focused, competent, motivated teams around the world.

Simply put, our Logistics function ensures the right product arrives at the right place, at the right time, with the right quality and at the right cost within all channels– with the least possible impact on the environment.



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager | AstraZeneca | Lernia

AstraZeneca Nordic is a recognized leader in its core therapy areas and aims to improve the lives of millions of people. This is an area where you are free to be more – you are encouraged to challenge traditional ways and test your curiosity. We drive innovative science, deliver key launches, build close collaboration and partnerships within health care.

This is a consultancy assignment, and the work will be conducted in English, both in terms of documentation and day-to-day communication.

As a Strategic Account Manager at AstraZeneca in Sweden, you will play a pivotal role in transforming care projects and seeking out local and regional business opportunities. Providing value propositions aligned with stakeholder needs and objectives is essential, ultimately driving greater adherence to guideline-directed medical therapies.

Your role will involve developing and implementing local brand operational plans through cross-functional teamwork, collecting and consolidating customer insights, and informing account plans for the brand/franchise strategy.

This is a field-based position and covers the areas Värmland, Örebro, Stockholm, Södermanland and Dalarna.

We welcome new candidates that match the requirements and live in one of following regions (Stockholm, Uppsala, Örebro, Södermanland, Värmland or Västmanland).

About the role

As a Strategic Account Manager, you will be responsible for developing and implementing robust account strategies to achieve commercial targets. In this role, high-value accounts such as hospitals and supply pharmacies will be identified and prioritized, ensuring that AstraZeneca's brands are differentiated in key areas to improve market positioning. Collaboration is key, requiring close work with the local brand team to develop tailored strategies for each account and stakeholder. Efforts will be crucial in achieving favourable brand listings, protocol inclusion, and increased brand usage through effective OMNI channel plan delivery. Leveraging data analytics, market research, and customer insights, you will identify growth opportunities and utilize tools like Veeva to track customer interactions and forecast sales. Your ability to provide value-based selling by highlighting the clinical, economic, and patient outcomes of AstraZeneca's products will be essential. The Process Design Lead - Ultrapure Water / Advanced Water Treatment is responsible for managing, coordinating and delivering defined packages of work, coordinating with other disciplines at regional level, and supporting senior, intermediate and junior engineers. jobs.title: PhD Position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education
jobs.description:
The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a three-year PhD position in Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education. The position is based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg and is available from 1 March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

The position is funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation and is part of PREPARE — Pedagogical Alignment for Responsible AI in Software Engineering Education, a joint project between SDU and the IT University of Copenhagen (ITU).

CIS is a young but fast-growing unit whose research groups span cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, embedded systems, and software engineering. Our students and staff come from Denmark, the rest of the EU, and beyond, and our working language is English.

 

About the position

Generative AI has arrived in our classrooms faster than our pedagogy has adapted to it. Students increasingly delegate the very things we are trying to teach them — verification, trade-off reasoning, judgment, accountability — to tools whose reasoning they cannot inspect. Most institutional responses so far have been restrictions or isolated policies, and neither addresses the underlying problem. This project takes the opposite route: if AI is here to stay in software engineering practice, responsible AI use should be deliberately taught, practiced, and assessed.

This is a unique position in that research and its consequences sit in the same place. You will not be studying a distant phenomenon and writing it up; you will be running studies in live courses, designing interventions from what you find, and seeing them change how software engineering is taught. If you see yourself as someone who wants to help our discipline navigate the AI disruption rather than wait for it to settle, this is that opportunity.

 

Responsibility and opportunities

Concretely, you can expect to:

  • Design and conduct empirical studies of how software engineering students generally use generative AI — how they justify it, what they delegate to it, and where their agency is preserved or surrendered.

  • Translate those findings into agency artifacts, practicum activities, and assessment designs that can be used by real instructors in real courses.

  • Co-develop and evaluate self-learning components, and contribute to alignment work on intended learning outcomes, activities, and assessment together with the ITU stream.

  • Work directly with the head of programs and instructors to implement classroom interventions, whose buy-in is what makes this kind of change hold. Persuading colleagues is part of the craft here, not an afterthought.

  • Publish in leading venues for computing education research, and present internationally.

 

Required scientific qualifications

  • A master’s degree in software engineering, computer science, or a closely related field, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree and including a substantial thesis component. The degree must be completed before the starting date. Students with master’s in education and related fields are welcome to apply.

  • A grade average at or above 10 on the Danish 7-point scale, or a documented equivalent from the awarding institution. Applicants with degrees from outside Denmark should include a grading scale and, where available, a conversion statement.

  • Documented ability to carry out independent scientific work, evidenced by the master’s thesis.

 

Qualifications

Required

  • A software engineering background, with practical familiarity with how software is actually built — you should be able to judge whether an AI-assisted solution is sound, not only whether it runs.

  • A genuine motivation for teaching and education, both in delivery and as an object of research.

  • The ability to design and carry out empirical studies involving students, and to engage stakeholders for support.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Prior research and publication experience.

  • Experience with empirical research methods — interventions, experiment, interviews, coding, thematic or pattern analysis — and with mixed-methods designs.

  • Familiarity with computing education research, or with constructive alignment as a course design framework.

  • Teaching or teaching-assistant experience at university level.

  • Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in software development, and a considered view of where they help and where they do not.

 

Personal competences

  • Critical and ingenious thinking. You question assumptions — including your own, including ours, and including the ones embedded in our education design and the AI tools you will be studying. You are as interested in what a finding does not show as in what it does.

  • A demonstrated passion for software engineering and its education. This project asks you to care about how the next generation of engineers is formed, not only about publishing on the topic.

  • The ability to bring colleagues along. Much of this work happens through instructors and program leaderships who own their courses. We value someone who can earn agreement through evidence, patience, and good listening rather than argument alone.

  • Independence paired with collaboration. You will drive your own studies, and you will do it inside a two-university project with shared deliverables and deadlines.

  • Integrity and care in working with students. You will be researching people who are also being taught and assessed. That asymmetry has to be handled thoughtfully.

  • Comfort with iteration. Design-based research means your first intervention will be wrong in interesting ways. That is the method working, not failing.

 

Workplace description

The Center for Industrial Software (CIS) is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Møller Institute at SDU’s Faculty of Engineering. We are a young unit that has grown quickly, with close ties to industry in the region. We take our international workplace seriously.

You will be based at SDU’s campus in Sønderborg, sitting on the strait that separates the island of Als from the mainland. Sønderborg is a coastal town of around 27,000 in a municipality of 76,000, built around an 800-year-old castle and shaped by its position on the Danish–German border. It is small enough to cross by bike and rich enough in coastline, forest, and cultural life that people who come for a few years often stay longer. The international community is sizeable, thanks to the university and the global companies based nearby, and Copenhagen is a 35-minute flight or a direct train away. Two good starting points: VisitSønderborg for the area itself, and Hej Sønderborg, an English-language blog written for newcomers about living here.

 

Further information about the position contact Associate Professor Adam Alami, at adal@mmmi.sdu.dk.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Before applying the candidates are advised to read the Faculty information for prospective PhD students and the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application. 

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Two recommendation letters, you're welcome to use the form for reference letter at the Faculty website.

  • Master’s and Bachelor’s degree certificates or equivalent, including transcripts of grades (original and an official English translation). 

  • Completed TEK PhD application form for 5+3 applicants. Find the form at the Faculty website.

  • Completed TEK PhD form for calculation grade point average. Find the form at the Faculty website. 

  • An official document describing the grading scheme of the awarding universities (if not Danish). 

  • Only for applicants from programmes that evaluate thesis/examination project by approved/not approved: An official written assessment of the thesis or dissertation project from the grade giving institution. The statement must clearly state that the candidate has been among the top 30 pct. in the graduation class for the study programme.

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications (in case you have any publications).

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 30, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

 

Enrollment and employment terms

Appointment as a PhD fellow is a 3-year salaried position, and the monthly gross salary incl. pension is 37.075 DKK. If you have relevant postgraduate experience, you may be placed on a higher salary step.

Applicants must hold a master’s degree (equivalent to a Danish master's degree) at the time of enrollment and employment. Employment is contingent on enrollment approved by the PhD School. Enrollment will be in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order). Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for PhD fellows as described therein as well as the Protocol on PhD fellows signed by the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

jobs.description:
SCANDINAVIAN MEDICARE ApS SØGER SOSU MEDHJÆLPER TIL HJEMMEHJÆLP

Er du omsorgsfuld, tålmodig og har du lyst til at gøre en forskel i hverdagen for et andet menneske? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Vi søger en engageret og omsorgsfuld SOSU-medhjælper til hjemmepleje, primært med ansvar for støtte og hjælp til en konkret ældre borger i eget hjem.

 

Borgeren har betydelig svær synsnedsættelse. Hun har tidligere haft blodpropper i hjernen og har i den forbindelse også fået en blodprop i et af øjets blodkar, hvilket har medført synstab på dette øje. På det andet øje er synet betydeligt påvirket af fremskreden aldersrelateret degeneration af den gule plet (AMD).

 

Hun har derfor behov for en stabil, omsorgsfuld og tryg person, som kan støtte hende i dagligdagen og hjælpe med både personlige og praktiske opgaver, så hun fortsat kan have en værdig, tryg og så selvstændig hverdag som muligt i sit eget hjem.

Om stillingen

Som SOSU-medhjælper vil du blandt andet have ansvar for:

-              At hjælpe med praktiske opgaver i hjemmet og skabe struktur i hverdagen

-              At yde personlig støtte og hjælp efter behov

-              At ledsage og støtte ved indkøb, gåture og andre daglige aktiviteter

-              At være med til at skabe tryghed og sikkerhed i hjemmet

-              At være opmærksom på hendes behov og kommunikere tydeligt og respektfuldt

-              At bidrage til en hyggelig positiv hverdag

Vi forventer at du:

-              Har en relevant uddannelse eller erfaring inden for pleje og omsorg

-              Er tålmodig, empatisk og omsorgsfuld

-              Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar

-              Er mødestabil og fleksibel

-              Har forståelse for de udfordringer, der kan være forbundet med nedsat syn

-              Er god til at kommunikere og skabe tryg relation

-              Har en positiv indstilling og lyst til at gøre en forskel

-              Kan tale persisk (farsi) eller armensk

Det er vigtigt, at du møder klienten med respekt og nærvær og har lyst til at blive en stabil og tryg del af hendes hverdag. Borgerens selvbestemmelse skal til enhver tid respekteres.

Vi tilbyder:

-              Et meningsfuldt og ansvarsfuldt arbejde, hvor du gør en konkret forskel

-              En hyggelig og rolig arbejdsplads i borgerens eget hjem

-              En tæt og tillidsfuld relation til borgeren

-              Mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling

Medicare08@gmail.com

jobs.title: Scientific Programmer
jobs.description:
This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys tackling undefined challenges, and is motivated to learn and innovate continuously.

In our small and dynamic software team, you'll have the opportunity to engage with all parts of the software stack, fostering a collaborative environment where diverse skills and ideas are valued.

You will be an integral part of our research and development team, by developing and maintaining our products and services for well logging applications. We have developed sensors that emit radar pulses and sample them after reflecting off the wellbore. The Scientific Programmer will assist with improving and developing our software and algorithms to transform the raw data to intuitive 3D visualizations. The key to develop the processing algorithms is understanding how our sensors behave and how the pulses propagate.

Example of tasks:

  • Mathematical modelling of signal pulses

  • Development of new data processing algorithms

  • Improvement of the user interfaces to existing software

  • Increasing the quality of the codebase

  • Improving the performance of the existing processing algorithms

Part of your work could also be in our lab where you will be testing and verifying your own and the team's new solutions and software.

The candidate we are looking for has:

  • Master's degree in Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or similar fields with good academic results

  • Previous experience in, and theoretical knowledge of, digital signal processing

  • Competency in object-oriented programming, with particular focus on Python

  • Good mathematical abilities, preferably with a background in Physics

  • Understanding of the importance of type hinting, logging, exception handling and documentation during development


Experience with the following is beneficial and will be emphasized in the evaluation, so please mention if you have any knowledge or work experience of the following:

  • Mathematical modelling of physical systems

  • Multiprocessing and multithreading in Python

  • The HDF5 file format

  • The QT framework and the Python wrapper 'PyQT5'

  • The data visualization library 'PyQtGraph'

  • Version control with Git

  • Collaborative programming


Requirements:

You will need to be fluent in English, both written and verbal. Norwegian language skill is an advantage. Since the position could require some training in the USA, you must fulfill VISA requirements for travels to the USA.

What we offer you:

As an employee of WELL ID, you'll be at the forefront of developing cutting-edge products and services. You'll have ample opportunities to collaborate with customers and contractors, supported by our team through mentorship programs and continuous learning initiatives to help you succeed.

  • High tech Research and Development

  • Small organization where your effort is recognized

  • Opportunities for growth and personal development

  • A healthy work environment with a lot of experience and niche expertise

Work location:

Office location in Greater Stavanger area.

WELL ID is a Norwegian Well Logging company located at Forus, with 15 dedicated employees. We thrive at delivering superior technology and service in a market dominated by global players.

We develop high-tech products and services based on new sensor physics and cutting-edge electronic solutions.

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 04.10.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland

jobs.title: Udlejningsmægler i København
jobs.description:
Er du vores næste udlejningsmægler i København?

Der er travlt hos Lejeboligmægleren, og vi søger derfor endnu en dygtig udlejningsmægler til vores afdeling i København.

Lejeboligmægleren er en landsdækkende virksomhed med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Odense og Aalborg. Vi er specialiseret i udlejning af boliger og samarbejder med både professionelle ejendomsinvestorer, ejendomsselskaber og private udlejere om alt fra enkeltstående boliger til større projektbyggerier.

 Vi er bindeleddet mellem udlejer og lejer og arbejder hver dag for at sikre en professionel og effektiv udlejning samt den gode oplevelse for begge parter.

 Vi er en virksomhed i vækst med ambitionen om at være den største og foretrukne lejeboligmægler i Danmark – og vi søger nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være med på rejsen.

 

Hos os får du blandt andet:

·         En flad organisation, hvor der ikke er langt mellem medarbejdere og ledelse.

·         En ung arbejdsplads med højt tempo og stærkt socialt sammenhold.

·         Daglige sparringsmøder på tværs af afdelinger.

·         Fleksible arbejdsdage og stor grad af frihed under ansvar.

·         Sociale arrangementer og fælles aktiviteter på tværs af virksomheden.

·         En lønpakke med fast løn og provision.

 

 Om jobbet

Som udlejningsmægler bliver din primære opgave at udleje vores kunders boliger og sikre det rette match mellem bolig og lejer.

 Du får en alsidig hverdag med mange boliger og kundehenvendelser i gang på samme tid. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du arbejder struktureret, følger dine opgaver til dørs og samtidig sikrer en professionel og personlig service over for både lejere og udlejere.

 Du bliver en del af et ungt og energisk team, hvor samarbejde, sparring og gode resultater er i fokus. Vi arbejder tæt sammen, men du får samtidig stor frihed og ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

 Stillingen er på fuld tid, og du skal være indstillet på weekendarbejde – pt. hver 3. weekend. Det er desuden et krav, at du har kørekort. Når du ikke er ude på fremvisninger, arbejder du primært fra vores kommende kontor i København.

 Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

·         Fremvisninger og udlejning af boliger.

·         Kommunikation og koordinering med nuværende og potentielle lejere.

·         Besvare henvendelser via diverse platforme og telefon.

 Dine kvalifikationer

For at trives i rollen som udlejningsmægler er det vigtigt, at du har fokus på service, stærk kommunikation og en positiv indstilling. Du skal også have kendskab til København og omegn samt være i stand til at kommunikere effektivt på både dansk og engelsk.

 Erfaring fra ejendomsbranchen, salg eller kundeservice er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For os er din personlighed, dit drive og din tilgang til kunderne mindst lige så vigtig.

 Derudover skal du være:

·         Serviceminded

·         Struktureret og god til at organisere

·         Udadvendt og trives i en kundekontaktrolle

·         Samarbejdsvillig og en holdspiller

·         Energisk, positiv og klar til nye udfordringer

 

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

 Er du vores nye udlejningsmægler? Send din ansøgning til job@lejeboligmaegleren.dk med emnet "Udlejningsmægler, København". Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at fjerne opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

 Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og CV.

 

Har du spørgsmål?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller os, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores direktør Martin Winther Larsen på tlf. 5354 5054 eller mail mwl@lejeboligmaegleren.dk.

jobs.title: Resort Manager / North Resort Oy
jobs.description:
Haemme asiakasyrityksellemme North Resort Oy:lle Pelloon Resort Manageria vastaamaan uuden resortin päivittäisestä toiminnasta ja liiketoiminnan kokonaisuudesta. Työsuhde on kokoaikainen ja toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, ja valittu henkilö työllistyy suoraan North Resort Oy:n palvelukseen.

North Resort Oy rakentaa Pellon Miekojärven rannalle uuden ympärivuotisen matkailuresortin, jossa yhdistyvät korkeatasoinen majoitus, laadukas ravintolatoiminta, henkilökohtainen palvelu ja aidot lappilaiset elämykset. Resortin toiminta käynnistyy marraskuussa 2026, ja ensimmäiset kansainväliset asiakkaat vastaanotetaan joulukuun alussa.

Tutustu yritykseen tarkemmin: https://www.northpremiumresort.com/

Resort Managerina

Työskentelet käytännönläheisessä johtotehtävässä, jossa yhdistyvät henkilöstön, asiakaskokemuksen, myynnin, talouden, turvallisuuden ja operatiivisen toiminnan johtaminen. Vastuualueeseesi kuuluvat:

* henkilöstön johtaminen, rekrytointi, perehdytys ja kehittäminen,
* asiakaskokemuksen ja palvelun laadun johtaminen,
* myynnin, käyttöasteen ja kaupallisen toiminnan kehittäminen,
* budjetointi, talouden seuranta ja kannattavuuden kehittäminen,
* varausjärjestelmien ja myyntikanavien kehittäminen sekä
* turvallisuuden, omavalvonnan ja vastuullisuuden varmistaminen.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä Sales Managerin sekä muiden avainhenkilöiden ja sidosryhmien, kuten matkailukumppaneiden ja viranomaisten kanssa. Toimit esihenkilönä resortin eri toimintojen päälliköille ja raportoit yhtiön johdolle ja hallitukselle.

Tehtävä edellyttää

* kokemusta matkailu-, hotelli-, ravintola- tai palveluliiketoiminnan johtamisesta,
* vahvaa kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja henkilöstöjohtamisesta,
* kaupallista ja taloudellista ymmärrystä,
* hyviä organisointi- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja,
* kykyä toimia itsenäisesti ja tehdä päätöksiä,
* kiinnostusta uuden liiketoiminnan rakentamiseen,
* sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa.

Parhaiten tehtävässä menestyy henkilö, jolla on aiempaa kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä, esimerkiksi Resort Managerina tai Hotel Managerina. Meille koulutusta tärkeämpää on näyttö onnistuneesta kokonaisuuksien johtamisesta. North Resortin tiimiin sopii parhaiten oma-aloitteinen, käytännönläheinen ja vastuunkantokykyinen johtaja, joka viihtyy kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä ja innostuu uuden rakentamisesta.

Vastineeksi osaamisestasi tarjoamme

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden päästä rakentamaan uutta, korkeatasoista matkailukohdetta sen ensimmäisistä vaiheista lähtien ja vaikuttamaan merkittävästi resortin toimintamalleihin, prosesseihin ja työyhteisöön. Työskentelet kansainvälisten asiakkaiden parissa ja pääset hyödyntämään osaamistasi uuden liiketoiminnan rakentamisessa. Tehtävän palkka on neuvoteltavissa huomioiden aiempi kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi. Tarvittaessa autamme myös asunnon järjestämisessä.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, jätä hakemuksesi pian nettisivuillamme olevan hakulomakkeen kautta tai kysy lisätietoja. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana.

Lisätietoja rekrytoinnista antaa: Jyri Soininen, p. 050 304 8650, jyri.soininen@osuma.fi

jobs.title: Support Worker
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Support Worker Location: 18 Nicholas Street Dublin 8 D08 VCP7 Employer: Depaul Ireland Hours: 39 per week Salary: €32691 - €39000 per annum Key roles: To be a member of a multi-disciplined team using holistic approaches. Working within the principle of harm minimization where residents receive a high degree of care, support and dignity. Depaul has a commitment to service user participation and to empowering residents to manage their own lives.   Offer personal care & support in regard to hygiene issues in accordance with Depaul's career standards, to uphold the dignity and respect of the residents Prompting service users to take their medication regularly. Assisting high support needs residents with getting up in the morning, washing, dressing and changing of clothes, incontinence management etc. in the privacy of rooms. Monitor for pressure areas occurring and know what measures to put in place to prevent them. As required, adapt levels of assistance to needs of particular residents, encouraging maximum levels of independence. Apply the Depaul Carer's personal standard of hygiene in assisting in the prevention of infection. Operate effectively to prevent cross-infection, using recognized Infection Control measures. Assist with maintaining a safe and hygienic environment for residents Offer laundry support for residents – in particular those with incontinence issues. Support and assist residents where possible to be active themselves in maintaining good standards of cleanliness in bedrooms. Ensure the nutritional needs of residents are met. Assist with feeding of residents when required. Promote and support the importance of a well-balanced diet for residents with high support care needs Where appropriate ensure that food is stored hygienically and safely. Offer support and intervene, as directed by the nurse, to the residents in regard to hydration and nutrition. Liaise with Shift Coordinator, as often as required, and participate fully in Handovers, when in attendance Report all Incidents (instructed by the Local Management), as per Depaul's Incident Management procedure. Support other staff in maintaining good order and organization in the house. Eligibility Criteria: Have completed a Third level Qualification or QQI level 5 in social care or another suitably related area. Experience of service user activity planning desirable for this role. Experience of lone working or off-site working an advantage Good working knowledge of risk assessment processes and systems (i.e. S/U Risk assessment, Lone Working, Activity Risk Assessments) The above list is not exhaustive What we can offer you: Strong focus is placed on staff development in the form of robust induction, regular supervision, joint annual reviews, and a wealth of learning and development opportunities. Staff wellbeing is prioritized through a suite of benefits, such as pension, health insurance, Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

jobs.title: Automekaanikko
jobs.description:
Etsimme automekaanikkoa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Kaarinaan! Asiakasyrityksemme on jo pitkään toiminut alalla ja he tarjoavat monipuolisesti palveluitaan liittyen ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjauspalveluihin.

Tehtävässä keskityt tekemään ajoneuvojen huolto- ja korjaustehtäviä, on sitten kyseessä avustavat tai haastavemmat tehtävät. Työpäiviisi voi sisältyä esim. lisävarusteasennuksia, vikojen etsintää, sähköistyksiä, moottorin korjauksia, vaihteistotöitä, jarrutöitä tai sitten yksinkertaisempia määräaikaishuoltoja kuten öljyjen ja suodattimien vaihdot sekä paljon muuta. Töitä tehdään asiakasyrityksen toimipisteellä ma-pe ja 37,5h/viikko.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

\- B-ajokorttia ja SFS 6002 sähkötyöturvallisuuskorttia.

\- Olet suorittanut vähintään ajoneuvoalan perustutkinnon ja sinulla on jo jonkin verran aikaisempaa työkokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä.

\- Ford on merkkinä sinulle entuudestaan tuttu ja mahdollisesti MB sekä VAG-konsernikin.

\- Tehtävään saa normaalin perehdytyksen, mutta odotamme sinulta kyvykkyyttä oppia ja omaksua uusia asioita nopeasti sekä omatoimisuutta.

\- Tärkeänä pidämme myös kykyä sitoutua työhön, pitkäjänteisyyttä, ongelmanratkaisu- ja asiakaspalvelutaitoja, kädentaitoja, joustavuutta sekä itsenäistä, rehtiä ja ammattimaista työskentelyotetta.

Paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä ja työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan. Täytä hakemuksesi ohessa olevan linkin kautta ja kerro siinä mahdollisimman kattavasti itsestäsi, osaamisestasi sekä aikaisemmasta työkokemuksestasi. Kaikki yhteydenotot: Click Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy, Seniorikonsultti Riku Koski, puh. 0504110470, tiedustelut arkisin klo 9-16.

jobs.title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö, Helsingin Ainola Oy, Ainola Kauneusklinikka, Helsinki
jobs.description:
Asiakkuuspäällikkö, Ainola Kauneusklinikka, Helsinki

Haluaisitko olla osa energistä ja intohimoa täynnä olevaa tiimiä Helsingin keskustassa? Ainola Kauneusklinikka, joka on erikoistunut kokonaisvaltaisiin kauneus- ja kosmetologipalveluihin, on kasvattanut asiakaskuntaansa merkittävästi vuoden 2015 avaamisesta lähtien. Tällä hetkellä meillä on jo noin 10 000 aktiivista kanta-asiakasta. Nyt haemme tiimiimme asiakkuuspäällikköä tukemaan kasvua ja kehitystämme.

Tehtäväsi sisältää:

- Klinikkamme palveluiden ja tuotteiden esittelyn sekä myynnin

- Näytehoitojen tekemisen uusille asiakkaille

- Asiakkaiden neuvonnan ja ohjauksen heidän tarpeidensa mukaisesti

- Yhteistyön tiimin kanssa palveluiden kehittämisessä


Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Takuupalkka 20€ / tunti

- Säännölliset työajat (21-30 tuntia/viikko)

- Kattavan perehdytyksen ja jatkuvan koulutuksen, jotta pääset alkuun varmasti

- Mahdollisuuden kehittyä huippuosaajaksi innovatiivisilla tuotteilla ja moderneilla laitteilla

- Kannustavan ja energisen työilmapiirin, jossa tiimityö on keskiössä

- Kilpailukykyisen palkan ja bonukset


Etsimme sinua, jolla on:

- Into kauneudenhoitoalaan ja halu kehittyä alan ammattilaiseksi

- Vahvat sosiaaliset taidot ja positiivinen asenne

- Rohkeus toimia itsenäisesti ja vastuullisesti

- Sujuva suomen kielen taito

jobs.title: BMS Project Manager for Datacenter Projects
jobs.description:
We are recruiting experienced BMS Project Manager for datacenter projects in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites. You will work closely with project teams, subcontractors, consultants, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule, and within budget.

This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in high-profile critical infrastructure projects within a growing and technically demanding industry.

The assignment starts ASAP and is expected to continue for approximately 12 months.

The successful candidate can be employed under a fixed-term employment contract or engaged through a contractor agreement, depending on their situation and preferences.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of building automation projects across multiple datacenter construction sites
* Manage project teams, subcontractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery
* Develop and maintain project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and risk management plans
* Oversee project financials, including cost control, forecasting, reporting, and margin management
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations, quality standards, and project requirements
* Coordinate activities with consultants, contractors, and project stakeholders
* Oversee procurement, logistics, and resource allocation across multiple sites
* Monitor project performance and provide regular project reporting
* Support commissioning, handover, and project close-out activities

What We Are Looking For:

* 5+ years of project management experience within construction, building services, automation, or related industries
* Demonstrated success managing complex, multidisciplinary projects
* Strong understanding of construction contracts, project controls, and safety legislation
* Experience managing project budgets, forecasting, and P&L responsibility
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
* Good written and spoken English communication skills
* Valid driving licence and willingness to travel between project sites within the Helsinki Metropolitan Area
* Valid right to work in Finland
* Valid Occupational Safety Card and Electrical Safety Card

Previous experience in datacenter construction projects will be considered a strong advantage. We also value building automation (BMS) knowledge and experience with platforms such as Metasys, EasyIO, Tridium Niagara, Trend, Siemens, Schneider Electric, or similar systems. Experience managing large-scale projects, working in regulated environments, and proficiency with project management tools such as MS Project or Primavera will further support success in this role.

PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certifications, as well as a degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Automation, or a related field, are considered advantageous.

Details:

The position is based in the Helsinki Metropolitan Area across multiple datacenter construction sites. The assignment starts ASAP and will last approximately 12 months.

Working hours are between Monday to Friday from 8:00 am to 5:00 pm and Saturday from 8:00 am to 2:00 pm.

jobs.title: Pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent søges til Naturly – 37 timer
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at gøre en forskel for unge – også når dagen ikke går helt efter planen?

Naturly søger en pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt på vores børne- og ungehjem.

Vi leder efter dig, der kan skabe ro, struktur, relation og udvikling omkring unge, som har brug for voksne, der både kan stå fast og være nysgerrige på det, der ligger bag en adfærd.

Hvem er vi?

Naturly er et mindre, privat børne- og ungehjem med 5 pladser efter Barnets Lov § 43 samt 1 fleksibel plads efter Servicelovens § 107.

Vores målgruppe er unge i alderen 12–22 år, som blandt andet kan have ADHD/opmærksomhedsforstyrrelser, angst, stressbelastning, tilknytningsvanskeligheder og erfaringer med omsorgssvigt.

Vi arbejder med KRAP som pædagogisk metode samt en mentaliserende og strukturpædagogisk tilgang.

Hos os skal faglighed ikke kun stå i en metodebeskrivelse. Den skal kunne ses i hverdagen, i relationen til den unge, i vores refleksioner og i vores dokumentation.

Vi søger dig, der

er uddannet pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent, og som har lyst til at arbejde tæt sammen med unge, kolleger og ledelse.

Du må gerne have erfaring fra døgnområdet eller med vores målgruppe, men det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, stabil, ansvarlig og fagligt reflekterende.

Du skal kunne bevare roen, når en ung har svært ved det, være nysgerrig på det, der ligger bag adfærden, og samtidig være tydelig omkring de rammer, der skaber tryghed og forudsigelighed.

Vi prioriterer din faglige udvikling

På Naturly skal man ikke stå alene med de faglige udfordringer. Vi prioriterer tid til refleksion, sparring og udvikling af vores fælles praksis.

Hos os får du blandt andet:

• Løbende supervision
• Faglig sparring med kolleger og ledelse
• Faste faglige drøftelser
• Mulighed for relevante kurser og kompetenceudvikling
• En arbejdsplads med korte beslutningsveje og tæt kontakt til ledelsen
• Mulighed for at være med til at præge og udvikle vores faglige praksis
• Et tværfagligt kollegialt fællesskab med fokus på en fælles faglig retning

Arbejdet foregår i døgnregi, og vagterne vil derfor også omfatte aften, weekend og døgnvagter.

Det vigtigste for os er ikke, om der står pædagog, ergoterapeut eller social- og sundhedsassistent på dit eksamensbevis. Det vigtigste er, hvad du bringer med dig ind ad døren – fagligt og menneskeligt.

Stillingen: Fastansættelse, 37 timer ugentligt.
Tiltrædelse: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen eller Naturly, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.

Naturly – et lille sted med plads til udvikling.

Une bonne communication orale et écrite
Une bonne aisance relationnelle et le sens des responsabilités
Etre inscrit.e à France Travail

Un échange téléphonique avec notre Chargé.e de recrutement
Des tests de prérequis (électricité et logique) et un entretien de motivation en face à face
La validation de votre candidature

Architectural Accommodation osasto vastaa arkkitehtonisista systeemeistä ja sisustusalueiden perussuunnittelun koordinoimisesta. Lisäksi ryhmällä on ADA-, luovutusdokumentaatio-, IHM-, 3D- ja Sustainability spesialistit.

Osana Architectural Accommodation osastoa Material Coordination tiimimme vastaa matkustajille ja miehistölle näkyvien tilojen perussuunnittelusta ja tiettyjen materiaalien hankinnasta – sinun roolisi osana tiimiäsi on varmistaa, että tehtävään liittyvät hankintakokonaisuudet pysyvät hallinnassa moniprojektiympäristössä. Tiloja ovat esimerkiksi mm. hyttialueitten käytävät, sairaala ja ohjaamo.

Tehtävänkuvaus:

Tehtävääsi kuuluu materiaalikoordinaattorille nimetyn kokonaisuuden hallinta. Toimimme moniprojektiympäristössä eli osallistut tehtäväkokonaisuuden vastuullisena samanaikaisesti usean eri laivaprojektin vaiheisiin alusta loppuun. Toteutamme arkkitehtoniset ratkaisut laivanrakennuksen sääntöjen ja määräysten mukaan.

Tehtäväsi on koordinoida telakan rakentamien alueiden sisustusmateriaalien ja kalusteiden hankintoja osana tiimiä. Hankittavia materiaaleja ovat esimerkiksi katto- ja seinämateriaalit, kaiteet, verhot, WC-materiaalit. Valmistelet tekniset määritelmät ja rajaukset hankintoja varten, laadit kyselyaineiston liitteineen ja vastaat tarve- ja toimitusaikatauluista. Hankinnat tapahtuvat yhteistyössä ostajan kanssa.

Tehtävässä olet vastuussa budjetoinnista ja hankintakokonaisuuksiin liittyvien kulujen seurannasta ja hallinnasta. Ennakointi sekä kehitys- ja säästötoimenpiteet kuuluvat vastuullesi.

Tehtävään kuuluu vahva kommunikaatio eri toimijoiden kanssa. Osallistut neuvotteluihin kokonaisuuksien asiantuntijana. Materiaalin ekologisuuden ja soveltuvuuden selvittäminen käyttötarkoitukseen on vastuullasi ja hyväksytät ratkaisut ja toteutuksen tarvittaessa asiakkaallamme sekä tuotannossa.

Materiaaliosaamisen lisäksi tehtävä vaatii ymmärrystä teknisistä vaatimuksista ja ratkaisuista.

Työtehtäväsi ryhmässä muokkautuu ja kehittyy kokemuksesi mukaisesti. Nyt haemme henkilöä kasvamaan vastuulliseen tehtävään.

Mitä odotamme sinulta:

Haemme tiimiimme aktiivista henkilöä, joka kykenee toimimaan tehokkaana ja positiivisena linkkinä niin oman ryhmän, kuin muiden osastojen, asiakkaan, arkkitehtien ja aluerakentajan välillä. Hallitset hyvin aikataulutuksen ja pystyt toimimaan samanaikaisesti usean eri tahon kanssa itsenäisesti.

Sinulla on kyky toimia hektisessä moniprojektiympäristössä, joka taas edellyttää kykyä suunnitella oma ajankäyttö projektien tarpeiden mukaan.

Taitoa ja näkemystä toimia asiakasrajapinnassa, joka on neuvotteluja ja päivittäistä kanssakäymistä telakan projektiosaston, perussuunnittelu- ja sisustusvarustelun osastojen kanssa. Työ sisältää myös materiaalitoimittajien kanssa neuvotteluja ja tiedonvaihtoa läpi projektien. Telakan organisaatiossa edustetaan systeemin parasta osaamista.

Eduksi katsotaan laivateollisuudessa yleisesti käytettyjen sisustusmateriaalien ja toimittajien tuntemus, kustannustieto sekä laivapuolen sääntöjen ja vaatimusten tuntemus.

Seuraavien ohjelmistojen hallintaa: Excel ja muut Office ohjelmat, SAP, Kronodoc /Wave, AutoCad / jonkin 3D ohjelma

Olet oma-aloitteinen, tartut reippaasti toimeen ja haluat olla mukana luomassa positiivista ja kannustavaa ilmapiiriä. Eduksi on, että sinulla on kokemusta projektikoordinoinnista ja tehtävään sopiva koulutus. Lisäksi tarvitset hyvää suullista ja kirjallista englannin kielen taitoa.

Kokemus laivanrakennuksesta katsotaan eduksi, mutta meillä kasvat laivanrakentajaksi kokeneiden osaajien opastuksessa.

Huomioithan, että edellytämme valitulta henkilöltä hyväksyttyä huumausainetestiä sekä terveystarkastuksessa todettua sopivuutta työsuhteen tehtäviin.

Miksi tulla meille töihin?

Pääset työskentelemään laivanrakennuksen huipulla. Maailman edistyksellisimmät risteilyalukset suunnitellaan ja rakennetaan Meyer Turun telakalla. Meidät tunnetaan huipputeknologisesta osaamisestamme, monialaisesta tuotannostamme sekä innovatiivisista ratkaisuistamme, jotka vievät koko laivanrakennusalaa eteenpäin. Tilauskantamme ulottuu pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Vuonna 2024 liikevaihtomme oli 1,82 miljardia euroa ja työntekijöitä oli noin 2 200.

Olet osa huipputekijöiden porukkaa. Meillä on osaamista, jota ei löydy mistään muualta. Telakallamme on yli 450 ammattia, ja olemme kaikki laivanrakentajia – jokaisen työpanosta tarvitaan yhteisen päämäärän saavuttamiseen.

Saat myötätuulta urallesi. Kannustamme työntekijöitämme kehittymään, oppimaan uutta ja tarttumaan tilaisuuksiin. Mahdollistamme pitkät työurat: uusia, mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä löytyy usein oman organisaatiomme sisältä.

Työsuhde-edut ovat kohdallaan. Telakan oma työterveysasema tarjoaa monipuolisia palveluja, apua ja tukea koko työurasi ajan. Vapaa-ajalla voit käydä Meyer Turun kuntosalilla, osallistua monipuolisten harrastusryhmiemme toimintaan tai käyttää liikunta- ja kulttuurietuja muihin harrastuksiisi.

Your role and the team

You will also own and develop the Marine AI roadmap and initiative pipeline, ensuring that the most valuable opportunities are identified, prioritized, and translated into practical solutions.

In this role, you will act as the bridge between business and technology, working closely with marine engineering experts, the Group AI team, and external partners. You will evaluate emerging AI technologies, guide technology choices, and ensure that AI solutions deliver tangible value to ship design, engineering, and business processes.

Initially, the role is highly hands-on, combining strategic ownership with practical experimentation, prototyping, and solution development. As our AI capabilities grow, the role may evolve into leading a broader Marine AI development function.

Success in this role means:

Our ideal candidate is a technically capable and business-minded professional who understands the potential of modern AI technologies, can translate Marine business challenges into concrete development initiatives, and drives those initiatives from concept to implementation.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is looking for a technically qualified and commercially focused Key Account Manager for its sales of high quality cast iron solutions.

THE POSITION

In order to consolidate and expand our sales activities, we need to strengthen our sales team by recruiting a qualified Key Account Manager.

You will be given responsibility for strategically important customers, all of which are market-leading OEMs or system providers, including those in the truck sector. Your role will be to expand and enhance the sales turnover among existing customers, while at the same time cultivating new customer relationships. A significant part of the role also involves making sustained efforts to secure up-to-date framework agreements and contracts in addition to communicating customer requirements and expectations.

The sales process consists of offering to produce the customers’ cast iron components. Once the items are being produced, the sales work will involve continuously negotiating and adjusting the sales prices of the individual components, as well as negotiating and maintaining other commercial conditions. These conditions include packaging, logistics solutions, framework agreements for quality and delivery, and aftermarket terms.

Your normal working day will vary from administrative tasks at the office in Holstebro, where you will work closely with Production, the Production Engineering Department (PED), Business Controlling and other company stakeholders. You will also be responsible for planning and conducting your external customer visits, primarily in Europe where you can expect up to around 50 days’ travelling per year. You will also help with and prepare data and presentations for sales meetings and trade fair attendance, as well as continuously reporting to Sales Management.

As part of a cross-organisational partnership, you will familiarise yourself with the customers’ projects and thus become the most important link of the contact between the customer and your colleagues across the entire organisation.

When out visiting customers with a view to sales, you will always have a ‘One Stop Shop’ cast iron solution to call upon. By this, we mean that BIRN is able to cast, machine, assemble and surface-treat the products so that they can be delivered directly to the customer’s production line or application without further processing. This is both efficient and sustainable.

Are you looking to combine your technical curiosity and skills with a strategic responsibility for sales and long-term customer relationships in an international industrial group? If so, you may be the person we are looking for as a Key Account Manager.

YOUR DUTIES

You will be given a central role in the sales organisation, with your work including the following:

  • Responsibility for and the continued development of a portfolio of four to six major strategic customers in Europe, primarily in Scandinavia. You will be responsible for a turnover of at least € 25 million
  • Building up long-term relationships with the customers’ stakeholders in the fields of purchasing, development, quality and logistics
  • Technical and commercial advice during the customers’ development and project phases
  • Planning and conducting customer visits, contract and price negotiations and major framework agreements
  • Ongoing budget monitoring, forecasts and sales reports at customer level
  • Searching for, analysing and developing new customer potentials and market segments
  • Close internal collaboration with production engineering, quality, controlling and finance
  • Participation in sales and strategy activities across the organisation

The position involves some travel, primarily in Europe.

QUALIFICATIONS

We expect you to have the following:

  • Extensive advanced technical training/experience, ideally supplemented with commercial skills, e.g. engineer, marine engineer or equivalent. A skilled trade background, supplemented by commercial training or experience, is another option
  • Experience of technical sales, project sales or Key Account Management; alternatively, you will have been recently trained and have the right level of drive. The start date will be adapted to suit the right candidate
  • The ability to thrive in an outward-facing role with extensive customer contact, and to plan your day-to-day work independently
  • The ability to work in a structured manner on CRM, budgets, documentation and monitoring. You will need to be skilled in using digital tools, for processing both text and numbers
  • The ability to communicate without difficulty in English and, preferably, also in Danish – and, ideally, in the other Scandinavian languages
  • The technical flair and ability to get to grips with the customers’ business and applications
  • A passenger car driving licence and a valid passport with no travel restrictions

At a personal level, you will be skilled in relationships, persistent and curious, with the motivation to create value through collaboration based on trust and a high level of professionalism.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will become part of Vald. BIRN A/S, a solid and internationally represented industrial enterprise with strong values and a high degree of professionalism. In addition, you will receive:

  • A central, independent role with a high level of influence on customers, sales and commercial development
  • A strong professional environment with close collaboration across the Group
  • Thorough on-boarding and training in products, markets and the organisation
  • Good opportunities for both professional and personal development
  • Attractive terms and conditions of employment, including a pension scheme and health insurance
  • A good canteen scheme and active staff association
  • An informal work environment that focuses on well-being, responsibility and sustainability

ABOUT THE BIRN GROUP

Vald. BIRN A/S in Holstebro is the Group Headquarters of one of Northern Europe’s largest foundry Groups. We supply highly processed cast iron components to the truck industry and others, as well as industrial hydraulics and machine components. Sustainability, the circular economy and responsibility are integral parts of our DNA. The Group employs around 750 staff, of which around 480 are in Holstebro.

APPLICATIONS

If you have any questions about the position or the BIRN Group, please feel free to contact Group CSO Peter Frost Jepsen on tel. +45 3016 0160 or Group HR Manager Morten Madsen on tel. +45 3016 0115.

Please note that we are processing applications on a continuous basis and will close the position once we have found the right candidate. As mentioned above, the start date can be adjusted to suit the right candidate. Please submit your application via our recruitment system, which you will find at [insert link]. Candidates who proceed to a second interview can expect to complete a personality profile as part of the process.

We would encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, ethnicity or age, to apply for the position.

jobs.title: Tiler
jobs.description:
The duties of a waterproofer and tiler include a wide range of wet-room and tiling work in both new-build and renovation projects. Work areas include bathrooms, toilets, saunas, utility rooms, kitchens, and other interior and exterior spaces requiring tiling.

The duties include:

- Reviewing construction drawings and work instructions

- Protecting the work area and inspecting the condition of the substrate

- Removing old tiles, waterproofing membranes, and other surface materials when necessary

- Cleaning, sanding, levelling, and straightening wall and floor surfaces

- Checking floor slopes and correcting them when necessary

- Applying primers and preparing surfaces

- Waterproofing wet rooms in accordance with the system manufacturers instructions

- Carefully sealing corners, penetrations, joints, and floor drains

- Measuring, planning, setting out, and installing wall and floor tiles

- Cutting, drilling, and fitting tiles

- Preparing and applying tile adhesive

- Grouting tiled surfaces and applying silicone sealant

- Epoxy grouting and other specialist grouting when required

- Cleaning, finishing, and protecting completed surfaces


The work involves handling various types of tiles, including ceramic tiles, clinker tiles, mosaics, and natural-stone tiles. The employee must be able to use the materials, machinery, tools, and equipment required for waterproofing and tiling work.

The position requires care, precision, high-quality workmanship, and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team. The employee must be able to read construction drawings, take the necessary measurements, follow site schedules, and comply with material manufacturers installation instructions.

Työpaikkanasi toimii viihtyisä Iltalan hoivakoti Espoon Viherlaaksossa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella. Meillä on 60-asiakaspaikkaa ja tarjoamme ympärivuorokautista tehostettua palveluasumista kodinomaisessa ympäristössä.

Työkulttuurissamme korostuvat avoimuus ja positiivisuus sekä elämänmakuinen arki. Haluamme tarjota asiakkaillemme turvallisen ja hyvän hoidon rauhallisessa ilmapiirissä huomioimalla heidän fyysiset, psyykkiset, sosiaaliset ja hengelliset perustarpeensa. Tuemme asiakkaidemme omatoimisuutta sekä kunnioitamme heidän yksilöllisyyttään ja itsemääräämisoikeuttaan. Laadukkaan perushoivan lisäksi tarjoamme heille monipuolista aktiviteettia sisällä ja ulkona.

Sairaanhoitajien lisäksi Iltalassa työskentelee fysioterapeutti, lähihoitajia, hoiva-avustajia, keittiötyöntekijöitä, laitoshuoltajia ja pesulatyöntekijä, jolloin voimme tarjota sinulle mahdollisuuden keskittyä hoitotyöhön. Iltalassa panostamme työhyvinvointiin ja työssäjaksamiseen.

Sairaanhoitajanamme työskentelet osana vastaavan sairaanhoitajan luotsaamaa tiimiä. Työpäiväsi koostuvat asiakkaidemme tarvitsemasta perushoivasta, lääkehoidosta ja tarvittaessa myös sairaanhoidollisista tehtävistä huolehtimisesta sekä osaston mielekkään arjen kehittämisestä ja toteuttamisesta. Sairaanhoitaja toimii myös omahoitajana, jonka vastuualueisiin kuuluvat RAI-toimintakykyarvioinneista, asiakassuunnitelmista sekä läheisyhteistyöstä huolehtiminen. Loma-aikoina ja tarvittaessa sijaistat myös osaston vastaavaa sairaanhoitajaa.

- sairaanhoitajan tutkintoa

- valmiutta tiimityöskentelyyn ja kiinnostusta vanhustyöhön
