jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to join Etteplan!

In this role, you will lead large embedded systems projects for our industrial customers. We help our customers succeed in their R&D, productization and in every phase of their projects from requirements to final delivery. Our diverse range of clients and projects across different industries lets you build broad experience and grow your career. You will work at the center of multidisciplinary teams, balancing technical scope, schedule, and budget while keeping the customer relationship strong throughout the project.

As a Senior Project Manager at Etteplan your work includes:

·leading large, complex embedded systems projects across their full lifecycle

·planning and managing scope, schedule, budget and risk

·building and coordinating multidisciplinary project teams

·acting as the primary point of contact for customer stakeholders

·reporting project status and escalating risks to internal and customer management

·contributing to presales and proposal work for new embedded projects

The position is based in Finland, the location preferably being Espoo or Tampere.



Who are we looking for?

·You have several years of experience managing large embedded system projects, ideally in an industrial or product-development context

·You have strong interpersonal and leadership skills and can guide multidisciplinary technical teams towards a shared goal

·You are familiar with embedded systems development practices and can speak credibly with both engineers and customer executives

·You have a solid grasp of project management methods (agile, stage-gate, or hybrid) and tools

·You are comfortable owning schedule, budget and risk on projects of significant scale

·You have an applicable educational background, such as a degree in engineering or a related technical field

·Good written and spoken Finnish and English skills are required



Interested?

Please send your application through our recruitment system as soon as possible. We review applications already during the application period.

At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions, in line with our way of working. For this role, the typical monthly salary is 5400-6600€/month, depending on your background.

We encourage applications from all qualified candidates who have the legal right to work in the EU. Please note that Etteplan does not currently provide visa sponsorship or work permit sponsorship for this role.

jobs.title: A Two-Day Training Programme with a Pathway to Employment for Professional Chefs!
jobs.description:
AALTOVOIMA - AALLON VOIMALLA TÖIHIN 


Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy

17–18 October 2026 | Helsinki | 10:00–17:00

Are you a chef or kitchen professional looking for a new job opportunity, seasonal work or the next step in your career?

Aaltovoima Pohjoinen is organising the Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy – a free, two-day intensive training programme where you can develop your professional skills under the guidance of top-level professionals and build a concrete pathway towards seasonal work in Lapland.

This is not an ordinary course. The Academy combines hands-on training, professional development and a direct pathway to employment through Aaltovoima in leading hotels and restaurants across Lapland.


Who is the Academy for?

We are looking for:

 * Trained chefs and kitchen professionals looking for a new job or seasonal work
 * Early-career chefs with basic professional skills and a strong motivation to develop quickly
 * International professionals with sufficient language skills and the right to work in Finland
 * Chefs interested in Laplands hotels, experiential restaurants and international clientel


What does the Academy offer?

Top-level trainers
The training is led by experienced professionals Aki Kantelinen and Johan Kurkela, who will share their practical expertise and experience from professional kitchens.

Two intensive days
The training focuses on hands-on work, the demands of professional kitchens and what it takes to succeed during the busy winter season in Lapland.

Certificate of completion
Participants who successfully complete the Academy will receive an Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy Certificate.

A pathway to employment
Aaltovoima will connect participating chefs with suitable job opportunities in hotels and restaurants across Lapland during the upcoming winter season.


Practical information

 * The Academy takes place on 17–18 October 2026
 * Both days run from 10:00 to 17:00
 * The training is free of charge
 * The Academy will be held in the professional test kitchen located upstairs at Brasserie Lionne in Helsinki
 * Hans Välimäki is providing the facilities for the Academy
 * Participants are responsible for arranging and covering their own travel and accommodation costs in Helsinki
 * Participants must bring their own chefs clothing and knives
 * Participants selected for the Academy commit to seeking employment through Aaltovoima during the upcoming winter season


Application

Application deadline: 7 October 2026

Selected applicants will be notified on 9 October 2026.

There is no need to attach a CV to your application. Applicants will enter their information directly into the application system and answer the following questions:

 1. What is the best dish you have ever eaten, and why?
 2. What is your favourite restaurant, and why?
 3. Where do you see yourself in seven years?

We are looking for motivated chefs who are passionate about food, eager to develop their skills and ready to take the next step in their careers.

Apply for the Aaltovoima Lapland Chef Academy and build your pathway towards an exciting winter season in Lapland!


For more information about the Academy, please contact:

jobs.title: Bid Manager
jobs.description:
At VARD, we create innovative and sustainable solutions for the global maritime industry. Combining engineering excellence, cutting-edge technology, and strong teamwork, we design and build some of the world’s most advanced vessels.

At the same time, we believe our people are our greatest strength. We foster an inclusive and supportive environment where talents can grow, ideas are valued, and individuals are empowered to make an impact.

Vard Interiors is a leading supplier of turnkey interior, insulation, piping, and HVAC-R solutions for the maritime industry. As part of the VARD value chain, we work closely with shipowners, designers, and shipyards to create functional, sustainable, and high-quality onboard environments. With a strong focus on innovation, craftsmanship, and customer value, we help bring some of the industry’s most advanced vessels to life.

We are currently looking for a Bid Manager to join our team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to apply your expertise, collaborate with skilled colleagues, and contribute to exciting projects across the VARD value chain.

Ready to make an impact at VARD?


Duties and responsibilities
  • Lead and coordinate the bid process for assigned sales projects.
  • Prepare and review cost calculations and commercial proposals.
  • Develop and review technical proposals for customers.
  • Maintain and improve cost estimation tools, routines and databases.
  • Conduct cost analyses and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
  • Perform risk assessments and maintain risk registers throughout the sales process.
  • Collaborate with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders to clarify project scope and requirements.
  • Facilitate project handover from Sales to Project Execution.
  • Support the continuous development of estimating methodologies and best practices
Qualifications
  • Relevant higher education, or equivalent experience.
  • Good written and spoken English and Norwegian skills.
  • Knowledge of vessel interiors, HVAC and piping systems.
  • Understanding of shipbuilding processes and the maritime industry.
  • Experience with cost estimation, commercial analysis or bid management is an advantage.
  • Proven experience in securing contracts and delivering successful bids is considered a plus.

 

VARD works systematically for inclusion and diversity and encourage everyone to apply, even if your competence does not match 100% the above. 

This employment may require a background check, or security clearance by the Norwegian National Security Authority.

Personal qualities
  • Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
  • Commercially minded with a strong business understanding.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented, with excellent problem-solving abilities.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented in your approach to work.
  • Able to manage multiple priorities and deliver under tight deadlines.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
  • Resilient, focused and able to perform effectively under pressure
  • Identify yourself with the VARD values Craftmanship, Salesmanship and Fellowship.
Our commitment to you
  • A good working environment with exciting and important tasks in an international environment 
  • Competitive pension scheme and insurance package 
  • Subsidized lunch in the office canteen 
  • Subsidized membership at the gym 
  • Occupational health service 
  • Flexible work from home policy 
  • Free mobile phone usage and subsidized internet at home 
  • Central office location and free parking
  • We understand the importance of continuous learning and we strive to give you the chance to gain new skills and further develop your caree

VARD recognizes the importance of having fun at work, this is why with Social by VARD you will have the chance to bond with colleagues through new experiences and shared interests. The social offer varies throughout the year and includes activities like 'walk and talk' during lunch hours, fjord cruises, cooking lessons, go karting, football practices and wine tasting, just to name a few. 

With the right blend of fun, expertise and hard work, we are creating ships for the future. Join us!

jobs.title: Destination Guide, Lapland Hotels SnowVillage, Kittilä
jobs.description:
We are looking for DESTINATION GUIDE for our client, Lapland Hotels SnowVillage, for the winter season 2026-2027.

The role of a Destination Guide is international and diverse. The work includes, among other duties, leading guided tours for groups in the snow and ice world. Employment begins on November 23, 2026, and is expected to continue until April 4, 2027. Full-time work is available at 112.5 hours per three-week period. The employment contract will be concluded between the employee and Staffpoint.

We hope you have

- Previous experience in customer service and strong group management skills

- A positive attitude reflected in the way you work

- Readiness to work in a busy and international environment

- Motivation to work in a dynamic and versatile role

- In addition to English, proficiency in German, French, or Spanish is considered an advantage

We offer you

- Interesting and varied work in a pleasant, active, and enjoyable work environment

- A fantastic and close-knit team that many employees return to season after season

- Comprehensive employee benefits across three business areas (Lapland Hotels, Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts)

- Accommodation arranged by the client

- Salary negotiable based on experience, but at minimum according to the collective agreement for the hospitality industry (Marava TES) plus applicable supplements


Lapland Hotels SnowVillage uniquely combines the magical worlds of snow and ice. Every year in November, a one-of-a-kind icy attraction covering approximately two hectares is built in Lainio, featuring ice sculptures, an ice restaurant, and an ice bar. Reception and restaurant facilities, however, are comfortably located within warm log-built surroundings.

Smiling customer service and creating memorable experiences are the core values of SnowVillage. Lapland Hotels SnowVillage welcomes approximately 80,000 visitors annually, and the theme changes every year. Its location near the Levi and Ylläs ski resorts ensures a busy winter season. SnowVillage is approximately 45 km from Levi, 30 km from Äkäslompolo, and 15 km from Ylläsjärvi.

The accommodation is located approximately 15 km from the workplace, so a car or a driving licence is essential.

Please note that we process applications throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found. Submit your job application and we'll see you in magical Lapland! Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. All applications should be submitted through our website.


Lapland Hotels

Lapland Hotels & Safaris Oy offers northern experiences for all senses. It consists of Finland's largest private hotel chain Lapland Hotels, the Nordic region's largest program service company Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts. The entire group employs a total of about 1,950 people.

Lapland Hotels includes 20 hotels, over 2,600 rooms and apartments, and more than 11,000 restaurant seats throughout Finland: in Ylläs, Levi, Saariselkä, Rovaniemi, Olos, Luosto, Kilpisjärvi, Pallas, and Hetta, as well as in Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Kuopio, and Kartano & Spa Hotel Haikko in Porvoo.

Lapland Safaris offers unique nature activities in Lapland's five locations: Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Levi, and Luosto. An essential part of the safari selection is dog sledding experiences, which are provided by Lapland Husky Safaris, a member of the same tourism group. The company is the largest operator in its field in Finland and has four kennels in Rovaniemi, Luosto, Saariselkä, and Muonio. Lapland Ski Resorts consists of five ski resorts located in Ylläs, Luosto, Olos, Pallas, and Rovaniemi

jobs.title: Mekanisk prosjektleder/teknisk ingeniør
jobs.description:
Som mekanisk prosjektleder/teknisk ingeniør vil du ha en sentral rolle i utvikling, prosjektering og forbedring av mekaniske løsninger og produksjonsutstyr. Du vil være en del av prosjektstaben og jobbe tett med produksjonen, leverandører og interne fagmiljøer. Du vil være med å bidra til å sikre robuste, effektive og kvalitetssikrede tekniske leveranser.

Rollen kombinerer:

  • Prosjektering og teknisk utvikling
  • Mekanisk design og dokumentasjon
  • Prosjektledelse og koordinering
  • Løsningsutvikling og kontinuerlig forbedring

Du får mulighet til å påvirke hele livsløpet – fra idé og design til installasjon, testing og videre optimalisering!


Arbeidsoppgaver

Hva skal du jobbe med?

  • Prosjektering, dimensjonering og utvikling av mekaniske løsninger
  • Design, konstruksjon og utarbeidelse av tekniske tegninger (2D/3D – Autodesk Inventor)
  • Utarbeidelse og oppfølging av maskindokumentasjon, CE-merking og interne dokumentasjonskrav
  • Lede og koordinere tekniske leveranser i prosjekter
  • Kontakt og oppfølging av leverandører, rådgivere og underleverandører
  • Kalkulasjon og teknisk støtte i interne prosjekter
  • Bidra til forbedringsarbeid, kvalitetssystemer og dokumentstyring
  • Delta i utviklingsarbeid knyttet til mekaniske systemer, tekniske løsninger og arbeidsmetoder
  • Støtte prototyping, testing, verifikasjon og teknisk kvalifisering
Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)

Hva ønsker vi at du har av kvalifikasjoner?

  • Høyere utdanning innen relevante mekaniske fag
  • Erfaring fra prosjektering, mekanisk design, løsningsutvikling eller prosjektledelse
  • Erfaring med Autodesk Inventor / AutoCAD
  • God teknisk forståelse og evne til å omsette krav til praktiske løsninger
  • Erfaring med tekniske beregninger, dimensjonering og dokumentasjon
  • Gode norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, muntlig og skriftlig

Hvem er du?

  • Praktisk, teknisk og nysgjerrig!
  • Jobber strukturert og er tydelig i kommunikasjonen
  • Tar ansvar, viser initiativ og trives med selvstendig arbeid
  • Er løsningsorientert og kvalitetsbevisst
  • Motiveres av å utvikle gode tekniske løsninger og bidra til kontinuerlig forbedring
  • Er en lagspiller som trives i tverrfaglige miljøer

Hva får du hos oss?

  • En nøkkelrolle i utviklingen av avanserte mekaniske løsninger
  • Mulighet til å påvirke hele prosjektets livsløp – fra idé til ferdig teknisk løsning
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø med erfarne ingeniører og tekniske spesialister
  • Et arbeidsmiljø preget av tillit, korte beslutningsveier og høy trivsel
  • En arbeidsplass som satser på kvalitet, utvikling og bærekraftige løsninger

jobs.title: Data Scientist for Department of Biology
jobs.description:
We are Earth scientists who accumulate large data sets on the composition of sedimentary rocks in geologic time on modern sediments from throughout the world. Our ambition is to generate coupled interactive data sets, where data can be easily extracted, and compared with other literature data sets. What we need is a data scientist to help us organize and curate our data, to extract data from the literature and to generate computational platforms for data analysis. A GIS framework will be important for some of the data organization analyses.

Overall, we need someone who is motivated, with good ideas as to how data bases can be organized and manipulated and with skills using GIS. To be considered for this position the applicants should have a PhD degree. 

The data scientist will be part of the Nordcee research group and specifically the Canfield Villum group exploring the relationship between the evolution of the Earth’s
chemical environment and the evolution of life. The position is based at the Department of Biology.

The position will run from February 1 2027 until June 30, 2029.

Salary and employment terms
Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.description:

Contexte :
Nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Cybersécurité Senior pour rejoindre le pôle Expertise de l'équipe Cybersécurité de la DSI. Le pôle accompagne les équipes internes sur les sujets d'architecture, d'innovation et de sécurisation du SI. La mission consiste à accompagner les équipes agiles dans l'atteinte d'un niveau élevé de sécurité, à définir les exigences et doctrines de sécurité, à challenger les solutions existantes et à contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la cybersécurité.
Missions principales :
-        Accompagner les équipes agiles dans l'intégration des exigences de sécurité et leur mise en conformité.
-        Définir et faire évoluer les doctrines et requis non fonctionnels de sécurité.
-        Réaliser des missions d'architecture de sécurité technique sur les applications, socles et environnements Cloud.
-        Accompagner les équipes sur les pratiques DevSecOps et la sécurisation du cycle de développement logiciel.
-        Challenger les solutions techniques existantes et assurer une veille technologique régulière.
-        Analyser et challenger les résultats d'audits offensifs (pentest, red teaming) et accompagner la remédiation des vulnérabilités.
-        Accompagner l'exploitation et l'acculturation autour de solutions de cybersécurité : DLP, CNAPP, SSE, VOC, DMARC, Cloud souverain, etc.
-        Accompagner la mise en œuvre de solutions de chiffrement à l'état de l'art, notamment dans le cadre de la transition post-quantique.
-        Valider la conformité cybersécurité des nouveaux socles et applications du SI.
-        Contribuer à la sécurisation des applications à l'aide de l'IA et aux nouveaux usages autour des LLM, MCP et de l'agentique.
-        Contribuer à la stratégie et à l'amélioration continue des activités de l'équipe Cybersécurité.
-        Participer ponctuellement à d'autres sujets transverses de cybersécurité selon l'actualité et les besoins de la DSI.
Livrables attendus :
-        Doctrines et exigences de sécurité applicables aux équipes agiles.
-        Analyses et recommandations d'architecture cybersécurité.
-        Avis et validations de conformité cyber des applications et socles.
-        Analyses et plans de remédiation issus des audits offensifs.
-        Recommandations d'amélioration DevSecOps et SSDLC.
-        Documents de veille, études et recommandations technologiques.
-        Accompagnement au déploiement et à l'adoption des solutions de cybersécurité.
-        Recommandations et dispositifs liés au chiffrement, à la PKI, aux certificats et à la transition post-quantique.
-        Contributions à la stratégie et aux plans d'amélioration continue de la cybersécurité.
Profil recherché :
-        Expérience significative en architecture cybersécurité et en sécurité technique.
-        Solides compétences en sécurité des applications, des API, du Web, des systèmes, des réseaux et du Cloud.
-        Expérience pratique en développement et en DevSecOps : SSDLC, SAST, DAST, SCA, CNAPP, CSPM, etc.
-        Expérience en sécurité offensive : pentest et/ou red teaming.
-        Certification sur un ou plusieurs Cloud Service Providers : AWS, Azure et/ou GCP.
-        Maîtrise des environnements Cloud et infrastructures : AWS, Azure, GCP, VMware, Kubernetes.
-        Bonnes connaissances en gestion des identités et des accès : OIDC, SAML, SCIM.
-        Connaissances des architectures réseau et sécurité : ADN, SASE.
-        Solides connaissances en cryptographie, certificats/CLM, PKI, KMS/HSM.
-        Connaissances des méthodologies d'évaluation des risques : ISO, NIST, etc.
-        Bonne compréhension des technologies IA : LLM, MCP, agentique, ainsi que des solutions telles que Dust, Mistral et Copilot.
-        Maîtrise des environnements Linux, Windows et macOS.
-        Expérience en environnement Agile/Scrum ; certification SAFe appréciée.

jobs.title: Vil du forme fremtidens grønne og levende arbeidsplasser på Sunnmøre?
jobs.description:
Er du en relasjonsbygger som motiveres av å skape visuelle endringer og bedre trivsel for ansatte?

 

Har du lyst til å selge et produkt alle vil ha, og som beviselig forbedrer arbeidsmiljøet? Safari Planter AS opplever solid vekst, og nå søker vi deg som vil ta eierskap til B2B-markedet vårt i Ålesund og omegn.

 

Hvorfor er dette en unik mulighet?

De fleste selger software, forsikring eller kaffemaskiner. Hos Safari Planter selger du en opplevelse, bedre inneklima og estetiske arbeidsplasser. Grønne vegger, spektakulære atriumløsninger og skreddersydd planteinteriør er i vinden som aldri før. Bedrifter investerer tungt i å få de ansatte tilbake til kontoret – og her sitter du med nøkkelen.

 

Som B2B-selger hos oss får du en sjelden kombinasjon av kreativ rådgivning og rendyrket business-to-business-salg. Du blir vårt ansikt utad mot regionens mest spennende bedrifter, eiendomsutviklere og arkitekter.

 

 

Hva vil hverdagen din bestå i?

Du vil ha stor frihet til å legge opp din egen arbeidsdag, med base fra vårt kontor i Ålesund. Hovedfokus er å fylle egen portefølje og skape grønnere rom for næringsliv og offentlig sektor:

 

  • Oppsøkende salg og relasjonsbygging: Du identifiserer muligheter, booker møter og bygger langsiktige partnerskap med beslutningstakere.
  • Kreativ rådgivning: Du lytter til kundens behov og tegner ut helhetlige løsninger i grensesnittet mellom interiør, arkitektur og biophilia (menneskets behov for natur).
  • Anbud og prosjekter: Du driver prosessene fra første kontakt og tilbudsskriving til forhandlinger og avtaleinngåelse – inkludert offentlige anskaffelser.

  • Nettverksbygging: Du representerer Safari Planter på messer, bransjetreff og i samarbeid med lokale arkitekter og interiørarkitekter.

     

 

Hvem er du?

Vi ser etter deg som trigges av å lukke avtaler, men som forstår at et godt salg starter med tillit. Du har gjerne erfaring fra prosjektsalg, kapitalvaresalg eller interiørløsninger mot bedriftsmarkedet

 

  • Du er en jeger med rådgiverhatt: Du trives med oppsøkende aktivitet, men fremstår som en profesjonell og lyttende sparringspartner for kunden.
  • Du har kommersiell teft: Du forstår B2B-markedet, hvordan offentlige innkjøp fungerer, og hvordan du posisjonerer Safari Planter som den foretrukne leverandøren.
  • Du har nettverk på Sunnmøre: Det er en stor fordel om du allerede kjenner det lokale næringslivet i regionen.
  • Språk og logistikk: Du kommuniserer flytende på norsk (skriftlig og muntlig), har gode engelskkunnskaper, og førerkort klasse B er et krav da du vil være mye på farten.

 

 

Hva kan vi tilby deg?
  • En attraktiv lønnsmodell: Konkurransedyktig fastlønn i bunn, kombinert med en provisjonsmodell som belønner gode resultater.
  • Høy påvirkningskraft: Vi er en fremoverlent organisasjon der veien fra idé til beslutning er kort. Du får være med på å forme våre fremtidige konsepter og salgsstrategier.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø: Du blir en del av et uformelt, engasjert og faglig sterkt team som brenner for det de leverer.
  • Et takknemlig produkt: Du selger løsninger som bidrar direkte til økt trivsel, lavere sykefravær og flottere visuelle rammer hos kundene dine.

jobs.title: Palveluvastaava, ABC Kausala
jobs.description:
Primary location:
IITTI

Haussa on vakituiseen ja osa-aikaiseen (30 h/vko) työsuhteeseen

PALVELUVASTAAVA, ABC KAUSALA.

Palveluvastaava toimii vuorovastaavana, joka vastaa liikennemyymälän asiakaspalvelun sujuvuuden lisäksi keittiön, salin ja marketin saumattomasta yhteistyöstä. Vastuutehtäviin kuuluu myös muiden vuorossa olevien työntekijöiden ohjaamista ja auttamista kohti onnistunutta palvelukokemusta ja asetettuja tavoitteita. Palveluvastaava näyttää omalla esimerkillään, miten asioihin suhtautuu ja miten niitä ratkaisee. Hän osoittaa läsnäoloaan osallistumalla päivittäisiin, ihan tavallisiin työtehtäviin muiden työntekijöiden tavoin.

Tehtävässä menestyminen perustuu yhteisiin palvelu- ja laatutavoitteisiin, jotka ohjaavat kaikkea toimintaamme arjessa. Tukenasi on koko ABC Kausalan ammattitaitoinen porukka: kenttäpäällikkö, liikennemyymälävastaava, muut palveluvastaavat sekä osaavat ja sitoutuneet liikennemyymälätyöntekijät. Tämä vastuutehtävä on hyvä ponnahduslauta myös mahdollisiin tuleviin, vaativampiin esihenkilötehtäviin, mikäli sellaiset sinua kiinnostavat.

Palveluvastaavalta odotamme:
💡Kokemusta ja/tai koulutusta matkailu- ja ravintola-alalta, päivittäistavarakaupasta tai esihenkilötyöstä.
💡Hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä ohjata tiimin päivittäistä toimintaa. Koko työryhmän etua ajatellen on tärkeää, että osaat antaa selkeitä ohjeita sekä pystyt tuomaan ajatuksesi ja näkemyksesi ilmi rakentavasti ja kannustavasti.
💡 Iloista ja vastuuntuntoista asennetta sekä kykyä puuttua epäkohtiin.
💡 Paineensietokykyä ja taitoa priorisoida. Pääsi pysyy kylmänä myös paineen alla ja pystyt tekemään nopeita päätöksiä, reagoimaan muutoksiin ja saamaan silti asioita aikaiseksi.
💡 Perustasoisia tietoteknisiä valmiuksia. Aiempi osaaminen S-ryhmän järjestelmistä katsotaan eduksi.
💡 Hyviä asiakaspalvelutaitoja. Meillä jokainen on asiakasta varten ja osallistuu asiakaspalveluun.

Tehtävässä toimiminen edellyttää vuorotyövalmiutta kaikkina ABC Kausalan aukioloaikoina. Työkielemme on suomi, muun kielitaidon sekä anniskelu- ja hygieniapassin katsomme eduksi.

Valitulle henkilölle tarjoamme:
💚 S-ryhmän epätavallisen monipuoliset koulutus- ja etenemismahdollisuudet. Vastuurooli ja monipuolinen työnkuva takaavat sopivan haasteen lisäksi myös palkitsevia hetkiä.
💚 Vakituisen työsuhteen alueen suurimman yksityisen työnantajan palveluksessa.
💚 Kaupan alan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen, aiempaan kokemukseen ja koulutukseen perustuvan tuntipalkan (11,16-14,93 €/h) sekä tehtäväkohtaisen vastuulisän 5 %.
💚 S-Ryhmän poikkeuksellisen hyvät henkilöstöedut, jotka ovat käytössäsi heti työsuhteen ensimmäisestä päivästä lukien.

Lisätiedot ja rekrytoinnin aikataulu
📅 Hakuaika päättyy su 11.10.2026.
📌 Kaikki hakemukset tulee jättää suoraan rekrytointijärjestelmäämme. Myöhässä tai sähköpostitse saapuneita hakemuksia emme käsittele erikseen.
🖋 Loppuvaiheen hakijoilta saatamme odottaa osallistumista soveltuvuusarviointiin osana rekrytointiprosessia.
📞 Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa kenttäpäällikkö Jenni Frimodig p. 010 7625 021.021.

jobs.title: Sähköasentaja
jobs.description:
Keskussähköasentaja, EC-Products Oy, Pello (Oppisopimusmahdollisuus!)

EC-products Oy on sähköalan perheyritys, joka on toiminut Pellossa vuodesta 2003 lähtien. Yritys on vakiinnuttanut paikkansa laadukkaiden sähkökeskusten valmistajana ja yritys toimittaa sähkökeskuksia ympäri Suomen. Yritys työllistää tällä hetkellä 10 henkilöä ja nyt yritys etsii kasvaviin tarpeisiinsa viittä keskussähköasentajaa. Olemme lanseerassa uusia tuotteita markkinoille, jonka vuoksi tarvitsemme lisätyövoimaa. Myös lyhyemmät työsuhteet mahdollisia.

Odotamme Sinulta:

\-Sähköalan koulutusta tai alan harrastuneisuutta.

\-Oma-aloitteisuutta, kykyä itsenäiseen työhön sekä joustavuutta.

\-Motivoitunutta asennetta sekä halua oppia uutta.

Tarjoamme Sinulle:

\-Ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön tuen.

\-Käytännönläheisen työn, missä pääset näyttämään osaamisesi sekä kehittämään itseäsi.

\-Hyvän perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan.

\-Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan, mitä on mahdollista korottaa ammattitaidon sekä työkokemuksen lisääntyessä.

Lisäksi Pello tarjoaa upean luonnon sekä monipuoliset vapaa-ajan mahdollisuudet. Kesällä voit esimerkiksi lohestaa, meloa tai patikoida sekä talvella hiihtää, lasketella tai pilkkiä. Tule kokemaan monipuoliset ja vaihtelevat vuodenajat Suomen kalastuspääkaupungissa Pellossa! Lisätietoa Pellosta saat https://travelpello.fi/

Otamme uudet työntekijät ilolla joukkoomme ja autamme Sinua käytännön asioissa, kuten asunnon hankkimisessa.

Jos kiinnostuit, voit tutustua yrityksen kotisivuihin: https://ecproducts.fi/

Ota yhteyttä ja lähetä työhakemus sähköpostilla: Harri Timonen/ 0400 698 778/ harri.timonen@ecproducts.fi

Located in Santa Claus Village, Snowman World invites the whole family to winter fun at a snowy playground made of snow and ice. In Santa Claus Village also locates charming gingerbread houses of Piparina and a cozy restaurant where customers can savor authentic Lapland flavors and relax in private gingerbread cottages throughout the day.

We are now looking for waiters for the fast-paced Christmas season of 2026–2027 at Piparina. As a waiter, you will be responsible for providing the best possible service experience for customers throughout their visit to the restaurant, recommending delicious dishes from the à la carte menu, as well as excellent drink pairings.

Full-time work (112.5 hours/3 weeks) is available from the end of November until 6.1.2027. Part-time work is also possible according to your availability! - Experience or education relevant to waiter duties

Nous recrutons un pédodontiste H/F en salariat pour intégrer une structure dentaire moderne située à Vauréal (Val-d'Oise).
Description et missions
Vous exercerez en tant que pédodontiste exclusif ou en bénéficiant d'une formation approfondie en orthodontie, selon votre projet professionnel. Vous rejoindrez un environnement favorisant une prise en charge optimale des jeunes patients, avec un support clinique et administratif complet : assistante dentaire dédiée au fauteuil et équipe de secrétaires assurant la gestion des rendez-vous et du suivi administratif. La structure garantit un flux constant de nouveaux patients, assurant un agenda bien rempli.
ADN de la structure
La clinique bénéficie d'infrastructures modernes, récemment rénovées, et dotées de technologies de pointe : Invisalign Diamond Provider, scanners de dernière génération, panoramique, cone beam et céphalométrie. L'équipe est composée de 10 assistantes dentaires et 5 secrétaires, assurant une gestion fluide et efficace. Les praticiens bénéficient également d'un accompagnement personnalisé pour leur installation et leur évolution professionnelle.

Cette opportunité vous permettra de percevoir une rémunération attractive, définie selon le profil du candidat.

jobs.title: Palvelupäällikkö taloushallinnon tiimiin Ouluun
jobs.description:
Johda tiimiä ja kehitä asiakkuuksia

Haluatko yhdistää tiimin ja asiakkuuksien johtamisen sekä kehittämistyön roolissa, jossa pääset oikeasti vaikuttamaan? Meillä pääset vetämään asiantuntevaa tiimiä ja rakentamaan sujuvaa arkea sekä asiakkaille että omalle porukallesi. Haemme taloushallinnon tiimiin palvelupäällikköä vakituiseen työsuhteeseen vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa Oulussa ja lähipaikkakunnilla. Työntekopaikkana toimii Oulun seutu ja odotamme työskentelyä pääosin Oulun tai lähikuntien toimistollamme.



Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

- Tiimin toiminnan johtaminen annettujen tavoitteiden mukaisesti

- Töiden organisointi ja resursointi

- Asiakkuuksien johtaminen, kehittäminen ja asiakashuolenpito

- Asiantuntijoiden sparraus ja osaamisen kehittäminen

- Palvelun laadun varmistaminen

- Toimintatapojen ja palveluiden kehittäminen sekä muutosten jalkauttaminen omassa tiimissä



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen roolin, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan

- Osaavan ja tukevan kollegaverkoston, esihenkilön ja hallinnon palvelutiimit

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää sekä omaa että tiimisi osaamista

- Kilpailukykyiset edut: laajennettu työterveys, suoritukseesi perustuva tulospalkkio sekä joustavat hyvinvointiedut (liikunta, kulttuuri, hyvinvointi, työmatkat...)



Tunnistatko itsesi tästä?

- Sinulla on kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä ja asiakkuuksien johtamisesta

- Osaat organisoida, priorisoida ja delegoida

- Johdat mielelläsi esimerkillä ja innostat muita onnistumaan

- Viestit selkeästi ja rakennat sujuvaa yhteistyötä

- Haluat kehittää toimintaa ja viedä asioita eteenpäin



Meillä pääset osaksi yhteisöä, jossa

- yhdessä tekeminen näkyy arjessa

- tukea saa aina, ja ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava

- arvostamme kehittämishalua, vastuullisuutta ja aitoa kiinnostusta ihmisten johtamiseen



Toimimme Aallon arvojen mukaisesti: Osaan, Palvelen, Huolehdin, Kehityn. Yhdessä muodostamme tilitoimiston – monimuotoisen työyhteisön, työpaikan ja asiantuntijaorganisaation, jossa jokainen meistä voi työskennellä ylpeyttä, tyytyväisyyttä ja turvallisuutta tuntien. Yhteistyö kanssamme perustuu molemminpuoliseen kunnioitukseen, luottamukseen ja rehellisyyteen. Uskomme menestyksen kumpuavan tyytyväisistä asiantuntijoista, jotka mahdollistavat tyytyväiset asiakkaat. Strategiamme ydinajatus kulminoituu Aallon sloganiin Tilitoimistoni.

jobs.title: Wilderness Guide
jobs.description:
**Are you looking for meaningful work in the magical nature of Lapland? Do you want to provide guests with unforgettable experiences away from commercial mass tourism?**

**Flow Lapland Experiences Oy** is a Rovaniemi-based experience and activity service company offering high-quality, authentic, and personalized small-group tours. In our operations, we focus on high safety standards, genuine interactions, and unique nature experiences. We are now looking for a motivated and customer-oriented **Wilderness & Nature Guide**to join our team and create unforgettable moments for our international guests.

Your Versatile Responsibilities

As a guide, you will be the most important link between the customer and Laplands unique nature. Your workday will mainly consist of the following tasks:

- **Northern Lights Tours (Aurora Hunting):** Guiding groups and taking photography of the Northern Lights during evening and nighttime hours.

- **Winter Activities & Day Trips:** Leading diverse nature excursions, such as trips to the iconic Korouoma ice falls area and wildlife park visits.

- **Customer Service:** A warm, active, and attentive approach when interacting with guests from all over the world.

- **Responsibility & Safety:** Ensuring group safety, overall well-being, and tour schedules in arctic conditions.


What We Expect From You

**Requirements:**

- **Language Skills:** Excellent spoken English.

- **Driver's License:** A valid Category B driver's license and strong confidence driving in challenging arctic winter conditions.

- **Attitude:** A positive customer service mindset, flexibility, and strong teamwork skills.

- **Stress Tolerance:** Ability to act responsibly, calmly, and methodically, even in changing situations.


**Considered an Advantage:**

- Previous experience as a wilderness, nature, or activity guide.

- Valid first aid certification (e.g., EA1 / EA2 / Wilderness First Aid).

- Excellent photography skills (especially knowledge of Northern Lights and night photography).

- Proficiency in languages other than English.


What We Offer You

- **An Inspiring Work Community:** We are a close-knit and supportive team where we invest in everyones well-being through friendly competitions, social evenings, and team recreation days.

- **An Eventful Everyday Life:** A diverse and meaningful role in stunning surroundings—you get to experience Lapland's winter, snow-laden forests, and Northern Lights from the best seat in the house.

- **Training & Career Growth:** As a fresh and growing company, we aim to be an exemplary employer in the tourism industry. We offer comprehensive onboarding and genuine opportunities to develop and advance in your career.

- **Flat Hierarchy & Influence:** Our management is involved in daily operations, offering you the opportunity to significantly influence company development, participate in product development, and take on new responsibilities.

- **Remuneration:** We follow the collective agreement for the ski, tourism, restaurant, and leisure service sector (MaRaVa TES). Salary is determined according to the collective agreement or negotiable based on your experience.

Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: ΠΩΛΗΤΕΣ/ΠΩΛΗΤΡΙΕΣ
jobs.description: ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΑ: ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΒΟΗΘΕΙΑ ΣΤΗΝ ΕΠΙΛΟΓΗ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ. ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑ ΣΤΟ ΤΑΜΕΙΟ. ΔΙΑΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΚΑΘΑΡΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΤΑΞΗΣ ΣΤΟΝ ΧΩΡΟ ΤΟΥ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑΤΟΣ. ΕΛΕΓΧΟΣ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ ΚΑΤΑ ΤΗΝ ΠΑΡΑΛΑΒΗ ΤΟΥΣ. ΤΑΚΤΙΚΗ ΑΝΑΠΛΗΡΩΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΠΡΟΙΟΝΤΩΝ ΣΤΑ ΡΑΦΙΑ. ΑΝΑΛΗΨΗ ΟΠΟΙΟΝΔΗΠΟΤΕ ΑΛΛΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΚΑΘΟΡΙΣΤΟΥΝ ΑΠΟ ΤΟΝ/ΤΗΝ ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟ/Η ΤΟΥ ΚΑΤΑΣΤΗΜΑΤΟΣ.  , ΑΠΑΙΤΗΣΕΙΣ: ΑΡΙΣΤΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΗΣ ΓΛΩΣΣΑΣ. ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΕΣ ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΕΣ, ΦΙΛΙΚΗ ΔΙΑΘΕΣΗ, ΠΡΟΣΟΧΗ ΣΤΗ ΛΕΠΤΟΜΕΡΕΙΑ. ΕΥΓΕΝΕΙΑ, ΠΡΟΘΥΜΙΑ, ΥΠΕΥΘΥΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΟΜΑΔΙΚΟ ΠΝΕΥΜΑ.  , Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: - ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΥΦΙΣΤΑΜΕΝΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΝΕΩΝ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ ΜΕΣΩ ΤΗΛΕΦΩΝΟΥ, ΗΛΕΚΤΡΟΝΙΚΟΥ ΤΑΧΥΔΡΟΜΕΙΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΝΤΗΣΕΩΝ ΟΠΟΥ ΑΠΑΙΤΕΙΤΑΙ.   - ΑΝΑΠΤΥΞΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΟΛΟΓΙΟΥ, ΔΙΕΥΘΕΤΗΣΗ ΡΑΝΤΕΒΟΥ, ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΠΡΟΣΦΟΡΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑ ΜΕ ΠΕΛΑΤΕΣ.   - ΠΑΡΟΧΗ ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΕΙΑΚΗΣ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗΣ, ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗ ΑΡΧΕΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΛΛΗΛΟΓΡΑΦΙΑΣ, ΟΡΓΑΝΩΣΗ ΠΡΟΓΡΑΜΜΑΤΟΣ ΠΡΟΣΩΠΙΚΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΣΥΝΕΡΓΕΙΩΝ, ΚΑΘΩΣ ΚΑΙ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΒΑΣΙΚΩΝ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΩΝ ΑΝΘΡΩΠΙΝΟΥ ΔΥΝΑΜΙΚΟΥ (HR).   - ΕΚΤΕΛΕΣΗ ΛΟΙΠΩΝ ΣΥΝΑΦΩΝ ΚΑΘΗΚΟΝΤΩΝ ΠΟΥ ΣΧΕΤΙΖΟΝΤΑΙ ΜΕ ΤΗ ΘΕΣΗ. , ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΟ ΚΑΙ ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΟ ΑΤΟΜΟ ΜΕ ΑΡΙΣΤΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΕΛΛΗΝΙΚΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΓΓΛΙΚΩΝ, ΚΑΛΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ Η/Υ. ΕΜΠΕΙΡΙΑ ΣΕ ΕΞΥΠΗΡΕΤΗΣΗ ΠΕΛΑΤΩΝ, ΠΩΛΗΣΕΙΣ Ή ΔΙΟΙΚΗΤΙΚΗ ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΘΑ ΘΕΩΡΗΘΕΙ ΕΠΙΠΡΟΣΘΕΤΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ.  ΜΕ ΑΔΕΙΑ ΟΔΗΓΟΥ ΚΑΙ ΙΔΙΟΚΤΗΤΟ ΟΧΗΜΑ.  ΓΙΑ FULL-TIME + PART-T , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , PRODROMOS CHRYSANTHOU , pchrysanthou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.description: ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΗΝ ΚΑΘΗΜΕΡΙΝΗ ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΤΩΝ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΑΣΤΙΚΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΤΗΣ ΛΕΙΤΟΥΡΓΙΑΣ ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ. ΔΙΕΝΕΡΓΕΙΑ ΕΠΙΘΕΩΡΗΣΕΩΝ, ΕΝΤΟΠΙΣΜΟΣ ΚΑΙ ΚΑΤΑΓΡΑΦΗ ΚΑΚΟΤΕΧΝΙΩΝ, ΤΕΧΝΙΚΩΝ ΖΗΤΗΜΑΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΕΚΚΡΕΜΟΤΗΤΩΝ (SNAGGING) ΚΑΙ ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΤΗΣ ΑΠΟΚΑΤΑΣΤΑΣΗΣ ΤΟΥΣ. ΠΑΡΑΚΟΛΟΥΘΗΣΗ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ, ΕΠΙΣΚΕΥΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΠΡΟΟΔΟΥ ΕΡΓΟΛΑΒΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΥΠΕΡΓΟΛΑΒΩΝ. ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΙΣ ΕΠΙΘΕΩΡΗΣΕΙΣ ΚΑΙ ΠΑΡΑΔΟΣΕΙΣ ΑΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΣΤΗΝ ΤΗΡΗΣΗ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΗΣ ΤΕΚΜΗΡΙΩΣΗΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΡΧΕΙΩΝ. ΑΝΑΦΟΡΑ ΘΕΜΑΤΩΝ ΠΟΙΟΤΗΤΑΣ, ΥΓΕΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΣΦΑΛΕΙΑΣ, ΚΑΘΥΣΤΕΡΗΣΕΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΟΚΛΙΣΕΩΝ ΣΤΟΝ ΜΗΧΑΝΙΚΟ ΕΡΓΟΤΑΞΙΟΥ Η PROJECT MANAGER. ΥΠΟΣΤΗΡΙΞΗ ΣΤΗ ΔΙΑΣΦΑΛΙΣΗ ΣΥΜΜΟΡΦΩΣΗΣ ΜΕ ΤΙΣ ΔΙΑΔΙΚΑΣΙΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΑΠΑΙΤΗΣΕΙΣ ΤΟΥ ΕΡΓΟΥ. , ΤΕΧΝΙΚΟ ΔΙΠΛΩΜΑ/ΠΙΣΤΟΠΟΙΗΤΙΚΟ Η ΣΧΕΤΙΚΟ ΠΡΟΣΟΝ. ΠΡΑΚΤΙΚΗ ΓΝΩΣΗ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΑΣΤΙΚΩΝ/ΟΙΚΟΔΟΜΙΚΩΝ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΩΝ. ΙΚΑΝΟΤΗΤΑ ΕΝΤΟΠΙΣΜΟΥ ΤΕΧΝΙΚΩΝ ΖΗΤΗΜΑΤΩΝ. ΕΠΙΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΑΚΕΣ ΚΑΙ ΟΡΓΑΝΩΤΙΚΕΣ ΔΕΞΙΟΤΗΤΕΣ. ΒΑΣΙΚΕΣ ΓΝΩΣΕΙΣ Η/Υ ΚΑΙ ΑΔΕΙΑ ΟΔΗΓΗΣΗΣ. , Please note that copy of the letter and CV sent to the employer should also be sent to the (EURES ADVISOR , MARIA PITSILLIDOU , mpitsillidou@dl.mlsi.gov.cy). Please include the national vacancy reference number

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer, remote work
jobs.description:
About the role

As a Senior Fullstack Developer, you will lead the modernization of our client's ERP system, transitioning legacy Java/GWT interfaces into modern React applications. Operating in a tight-knit, two-person team, you will leverage advanced agent-driven development tools.

You are offered
the opportunity to work 100% remotely on a long-term, stable project. You will have the creative freedom to pioneer agent-based AI development workflows and play a key role in modernizing a business-critical system.

Work tasks

Modernizing a legacy ERP system by transitioning it to a React and Java-based architecture, utilizing agent-based development methods to implement views, design APIs, and build supporting developer tools.
- Build and modernize ERP views, including search interfaces, editors, and dialogs using React
- Design and implement robust REST APIs to support the new frontend architecture
- Refactor legacy Java/GWT user interfaces into a modern React-based application
- Develop tools and validation checks to keep agent-driven development processes on track

We are looking for

- Advanced knowledge of TypeScript and React
- Practical experience working daily with agentic development methods like Claude Code
- Proven ability to read, refactor, and navigate large legacy codebases
- Strong eye for UI/UX design with the ability to identify and fix visual inconsistencies
- Professional proficiency in English

It is meritorious if you have
- Good knowledge of Java and REST APIs
- Experience with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) or spatial data analysis
- Experience with cloud services, specifically AWS
- Professional proficiency in Finnish
- Experience building business-critical ERP systems

Our recruitment process

This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Full-time Driver Lier
jobs.employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
jobs.description:
We’re looking for Full-Time Drivers to join Oda!

At Oda, we develop affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy. First we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective grocery system, delivering to thousands of Scandinavian doorsteps every week.

As part of our team, you’ll work with smart, passionate colleagues who bring their whole selves to work every day. It’s a fast-moving, collaborative environment where everyone is welcome and everyone’s opinion matters. Whether you're shaping the future of online retail, tackling complex logistical problems, or making everyday life better for our customers, your work will have a real impact. Read on to find out what part you could play in our story.

We are hiring for both morning and evening shifts. Please specify what shift you're applying for in your application.


What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Report directly to our Driver Operating Managers and Team Leaders at your site as an essential part of our dedicated delivery team.

  • Be a Customer Hero: You’ll be on the road bringing groceries and smiles directly to our customers, ensuring a top-notch "Oda experience" at every doorstep.

  • Keep the wheels turning: You’ll handle loading and unloading with speed and care, ensuring every box arrives in perfect condition.

  • Own your ride: You’ll take pride in your van, keeping it clean, presentable, and ready for the road.

  • Pay it forward: You’ll help onboard and train new colleagues, sharing your best tips and tricks from the road.

  • Make us better: We value your brain as much as your driving! You’ll contribute your ideas to help us improve our routines and ways of working.


What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • A valid driving license (Class B): You have held your license for at least 2 years from the date of issue and feel confident and safe behind the wheel.

  • Good communication skills: Comfortable in speaking and writing English. If you also know Norwegian or another Nordic language, that’s a big plus!


What would be nice to have 💡

  • Enjoy being active and thrive in a physically demanding job

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • A strong work ethic and a "can-do" mindset

  • Service-minded and always looking for the best solutions

  • A genuine desire to make our customers happy

  • Responsible and always prioritize safety in traffic


What we offer 🚀

  • A chance to make a real impact as a Full-Time Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love-while shaking up the grocery industry.

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop-less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

  • A chance to shape the future of grocery shopping while building a company that’s here to stay.


Practical information

  • Application deadline: We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once the right candidates are found. We encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Start date: We're looking for our next great team members to join us this November, with planned start dates in weeks 45-47.

  • The position is based on a rotational shift schedule (35,5 h), working one weekend per month.

  • Working Hours:

    • Morning shifts: starts between 04:15 and 06:00

    • Evening shift: starts between 12:45 and 14:30

  • Position: 100% Full-time

  • Location: Drammensveien 189, 3420 Lierskogen


A few final words

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium.


We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡


To ensure a fair and efficient process for everyone, we use Hubert, our virtual assistant, to help us with the first selection. 🤖 Keep an eye on your inbox – shortly after applying, you’ll receive an email with an invite to a chat-based interview. Just make sure your email address is correct so the invite finds its way to you!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Hands-On Facility Manager for a Growing Property Portfolio
jobs.description:
We are looking for a hands-on Facility Manager to ensure smooth daily operations, high cleaning standards, and well-maintained properties across our portfolio. You will coordinate staff, linen logistics, maintenance, and property quality.

Hva vi ser etter Qualifications:

  • Experience from cleaning, property management, hospitality, or similar operational work is an advantage

  • Structured, reliable, and comfortable taking responsibility

  • Hands-on and solution-oriented, with an eye for quality and detail

  • Comfortable coordinating people, schedules, and day-to-day operations

  • Comfortable using digital tools and documentation

  • Flexible and available during the day, including weekends when needed

  • Able to communicate well in Norwegian or English

  • A valid driver's licence

Arbeidsoppgaver

As Facility Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring smooth daily operations, high cleaning standards, and well-maintained properties across our portfolio.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Planning staff schedules, managing labour-hour budgets, and following up on actual hours worked.

  • Managing linen logistics, including distribution, stock levels, ordering, returns, and collection.

  • Identifying and following up on property issues, defects, and maintenance needs, including coordinating repairs, contractors, and suppliers.

  • Ensuring high cleaning standards through training, quality control, and regular inspections of the cleaning team.

  • Carrying out regular property inspections, including checks of appliances, lighting, heaters, smoke detectors, and other equipment.

  • Documenting and managing guest-related damages and compensation claims, including photos, estimates, invoices, and supporting documentation for Airbnb, Booking.com, insurance providers, or property owners.

  • Taking an active part in daily cleaning operations to lead by example and maintain a strong understanding of day-to-day operations.

Vi tilbyr We offer:

  • A key operational role with responsibility and freedom to make decisions

  • Competitive pay

  • Independent and varied work across our growing property portfolio

  • The opportunity to shape routines, standards, and daily operations

  • A friendly, fast-paced work environment with good support

📍 Location: Tromsø and surrounding area

📅 Start date: By agreement

Send a short application to post@tromsofremleie.no or contact us at +47 456 97 800 if you have any questions. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Tromsø Fremleie AS is a local and growing property management company in Tromsø. We provide professional property operations and accommodation services on behalf of property owners, with a strong focus on quality, efficient operations, and well-maintained homes.

Our team works hands-on across cleaning, maintenance, logistics, and daily property operations. We value people who take responsibility, solve problems, and contribute to high standards across our portfolio.

jobs.title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
jobs.description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

jobs.title: Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term) (m/f)
jobs.description:
At BBH, Partnership is more than a form of ownership-it's our approach to business and relationships.  We know that supporting your professional and personal goals is the best way to help our clients and advance our business. We take that responsibility seriously. With a 200-year legacy and a shared passion for what's next, this is the right place to build a fulfilling career.

Depositary Services Senior Representative - Alternative Funds (Fixed-term)

BBH is currently recruiting a Depositary Services Senior Representative to join our dynamic Depositary Services team. In this key role you will be responsible for the coordination and performance of tasks relating to the supervision of assets of Real Estate, Private Debt and Private Equity funds. In addition, you will assess, analyze, and monitor risks and control issues for the products and services falling under the scope of the Depositary obligations.  You will have a high level of technical acumen and analytical skills in order to foster a solution orientated and consultative approach to performing our Depositary obligations

Key Responsibilities:

• Gather and review documentation received in relation to recordkeeping and verification of ownership of real assets (real estate, private debt, private equity, fund of funds) and proactively monitor the status and completion of those tasks and follow up to obtain required client documentation
• Build Strong relationships with Clients and have the knowledge and ability to explain the regulatory drivers behind these requirements
• Review and/or execute daily cash flow monitoring activities by gathering information and reviewing exceptions
• Support team in determining appropriate resolutions to new regulatory obligations.
• Monitor, report, define and document critical internal control processes.
• Formulate corrective actions, where applicable, to resolve identified exceptions.
• Coordinate internal and external projects in an efficient and thorough manner.
• Prepare and review documentation for regulators and external auditors
• Support Team on questions from clients, regulators, external auditors and/or BBH internal departments. Communicate clearly with business area contacts as well as other areas of the Bank
• Maintain effective working relationships at relevant levels with other departments
• Escalate within the team significant audit issues, set direction/communicate proposed manner of resolution of audit issues and concerns that have a significant impact
• Develop and maintain peer relationships to share best practices

Qualifications:

1. Education level and/ or experience

• Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting
• 2 to 4 years' experience working within the alternative funds industry or relevant business line experience
• Proficient Business level German skills are considered as an advantage

2. Knowledge and skills

• Excellent analytical, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to present complex and sensitive issues
• Technical skills in alternatives and regulation
• Good knowledge in European and local regulatory requirements
• Demonstrates Microsoft Office skills (with emphasis placed on Excel proficiency).
• Ability to learn and adapt to new technologies and systems
• Ability to identify, escalate and resolve a problem.
• Ability to communicate professionally through effective verbal and written skills.
• Ability to manage time efficiently and effectively.
• Organizational skills and detail-oriented.
• Ability to work in a team environment.
• Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure.
• Ability to manage and inspire people

We value diverse experiences. We value diverse experiences and transferrable skillsets. If your career hasn't followed a traditional path, includes alternative experiences, or doesn't meet every qualification or skill listed in the job description, please do go ahead and apply.

About BBH:

Brown Brothers Harriman (BBH) is a premier global financial services firm, known for premium service, specialist expertise, technology solutions and partnership approach to client management. Across Investor Services and Capital Partners, we work with an enviable roster of sophisticated clients who make BBH their first call when they are tackling their hardest challenges. Delivering for our clients and each other energizes us.

We believe that how we do our work is just as important as what we do. We are relentless problem solvers who know our best ideas come from collective debate and development-so we are never possessive about our ideas. Every day we come together as a diverse community of smart and caring people to deliver exceptional service and expert advice-creating success that lasts. No matter where you sit in the organization, everyone is empowered to contribute their ideas. BBHers can pick up the phone and call any colleague, and they are happy to help. Expanding your impact beyond your daily role is part of how we operate as trusted partners to one another.

We believe stability is a competitive advantage, but being stable means having the knowledge, skill, and discipline to evolve, often-pushing the boundaries of innovation.  As a private partnership, every investment we make is in the relationships, technologies, products and development we believe are in the long-term interests of our clients and our people. Our long-tenured leaders are experts in their areas and are actively involved in the day-to day business, taking the time to provide guidance and mentoring to build the next generation of BBHers. Because we know, our success begins with yours.

Go to BBH.com to learn more about our rewards and benefits, philanthropy, approach to sustainability or how we support you to thrive personally, physically and financially.

Job Description

The Transport Manager acts as the operational backbone and system Subject Matter Expert (SME) for outbound transportation execution across the EMENA network at Avery Dennison. Reporting to the Head of Transportation, this role bridges strategic regional transport objectives with daily execution—overseeing both direct customer deliveries and internal site movements.
The position combines technical system ownership (TRAX TMS & QAD ERP), master data governance, order/lead-time investigations, carrier integration management, and operational standardization across all regional manufacturing plants and distribution centers.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Transport System Governance & Network Master Data

• Lead-Time & Schedule Administration: Configure, validate, and maintain transport lead-time matrices per shipping site, destination country, and individual ship-to customer location across EMENA.
• Order Cut-Off & Departure Execution: Establish and maintain order entry cut-off times and daily departure schedules to align plant dispatch capabilities with carrier collection slots.
• Routing & Execution Logic: Maintain and optimize TRAX routing rules, logic parameters, and ship-via assignment rules per ship-to destination.
• Carrier & Partner Onboarding: Manage system setup and integration parameters for new logistics service providers following carrier tender allocation or carrier switches; maintain manual partner addresses as required.
• Documentation & Carrier EDI: Setup specific delivery instructions per ship-to to ensure dynamic printing on Weight-Lists and seamless EDI transmission to carriers; configure specialized invoicing setups (e.g., single weight-list per order rule).
• Network Availability & Calendars: Update and govern site and customer holiday closures to prevent system tendering errors and inaccurate delivery commitments.

2. ERP Integration & Analytical Investigations

• Custom Shipping Setup: Configure specialized shipping requirements in QAD, including the setup of "special pallet packlist" rules per ship-to upon request from Customer Service Representatives (CSRs).
• Lead-Time Root Cause Analysis: Conduct structured investigations into lead-time performance and anomalies (segmented by site, country, and ship-to) to resolve bottlenecks.
• Order Diagnostics: Lead end-to-end technical and operational investigations on delayed or stuck orders to identify system vs. operational execution root causes.

3. Outbound Network Governance & Service Excellence

• Oversee daily outbound freight flows, ensuring compliance with defined SLAs for customer deliveries and inter-site transfers.
• Track and report operational performance metrics (OTIF, OTD, weight-list compliance).
• Serve as the primary regional escalation contact for complex transport system failures, carrier delivery exceptions, and site logistics disruptions.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with Customer Experience (CSR), Manufacturing Operations, Warehouse Logistics, and Carriers.
Please note it's a 24 month contract.

Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or Systems Engineering.
• Experience: 5+ years of operational transportation management or logistics systems experience within a complex, multi-site European/EMENA environment.
• Systems Expertise: Hands-on experience with TRAX TMS and QAD ERP transport modules (or equivalent enterprise TMS/ERP combinations); solid understanding of carrier EDI integrations and weight-list/invoicing documentation.
• Skills: Strong analytical capabilities (root-cause analysis on orders and lead-times), continuous improvement mindset, cross-functional communication.
• Languages: Professional fluency in English; additional European languages (German, French, Dutch, Polish) are an advantage.

Additional Information

Here's a glimpse of the great benefits you can expect:

• Compensation & Benefits: Benefit from a labor agreement with salary increases, a qualified social minimum wage, and automatic salary indexation to inflation. Enjoy a seniority incentive, profit sharing, and a 13th-month salary (with the option to convert it into additional leave).

Job Description

As a Trading Execution Specialist within J.P Morgan EMEA Private Bank's Luxembourg Execution Trading Desk, you will have an exciting opportunity to join a dynamic and diverse team. • Cover extensive Clients and Markets: you will be part of a team that covers the whole EMEA region, having the opportunity to work in a fast and dynamic multi-market and multi-cultural environment

Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills:

• Degree educated in finance or business-related subject (or equivalent)

• Proficiency in other European languages is a plus

jobs.title: Strategic Finance, Corporate
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a member of the Corporate Finance team, you'll own the consolidated view of Notion's financial performance — the corporate model, the monthly close-to-reporting cycle, and the numbers that reach our executive team, Board of Directors, and investors. You'll immediately take ownership of core corporate FP&A workstreams, which include the consolidated P&L forecast, the monthly budget-vs-actual and reforecast cycles, and the planning systems that produce them.

 

This role is based San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own the consolidated corporate model and the monthly reporting cadence — close actuals, budget-vs-actual, and the rolling reforecast — and connect reported performance to the revenue, headcount, and spend drivers behind it

 - Maintain and evolve Notion's planning system, primarily Pigment: maintain the corporate model structure, run the monthly data loads and scenario snapshots, reconcile the P&L, headcount, and departmental views, and build new models and views as the business changes

 - Assist in preparing and delivering presentations that effectively communicate Notion's financial performance and outlook to Notion's executive team, Board of Directors, and investors

 - Raise the quality and scalability of our reporting infrastructure, using AI, automation, and stronger data workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and surface insights faster — challenging existing processes and data inconsistencies that get in the way

 - Work cross-functionally across Accounting, BizTech, People, and our Business Partnership (BP) Finance team to keep source data, mappings, and the chart of accounts aligned as operating complexity grows — tightening the handoffs between close and forecast along the way




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 2-5 years of experience across Investment Banking, Private Equity, Big 4, or corporate FP&A / Strategic Finance at a high-growth SaaS technology company

 - Demonstrated ability to build and own rigorous financial models, ideally a three-statement or consolidated operating model for a recurring-revenue or SaaS business

 - Hands-on experience with an enterprise planning tool (Pigment, Anaplan, Adaptive, Vena) or a clear track record of becoming fluent in new systems quickly

 - Strong analytical judgment and the ability to move from detailed data to a clear point of view on performance, risks, and opportunities

 - Ability to operate independently in ambiguous environments and communicate clearly with both financial and non-financial audiences

 - Ability to build finance processes from scratch and improve existing ones with a lens on long-term scalability and sustainability




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $120,000 - $150,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Ceptuvē “Lāči” viss notiek mazliet savādāk. Pamatīgāk. Te strādā ļaudis, kas prot darīt savu darbu no sirds un ar prieku, pa īstam un patiesi. Pie mums darba netrūkst, tādēļ  piedāvājam darbu:

Strādniekam Saimniecības nodaļā

No Jums sagaidām:

  • Fizisku izturību un spēja veikt saimnieciskos darbus;
  • Atbildīga attieksme pret darbu;
  • Spēja strādāt patstāvīgi un sadarboties komandā;
  • Vēlama iepriekšēja pieredze līdzvērtīgā darbā (tiks uzskatīta par priekšrocību).

Mēs tev uzticēsim:

  • Katru dienu vai pēc vajadzības uzkopt uzņēmuma teritoriju;
  • Veikt sezonālos darbus: tīrīt sniegu un kaisīt pretslīdes materiālus; pļaut zāli; grābt lapas;
  • Veikt atkritumu šķirošanu (plēves, papīrs, kartons, plastmasa u.c.);
  • Kontrolēt inventāra stāvokli, savlaicīgi veikt tā remontu savu iespēju un prasmju robežās, nepieciešamības gadījumā organizēt inventāra remontu;
  • Palīdzēt uzturēt ražošanas telpas atbilstoši sanitārajām un saimnieciskajām prasībām;
  • Nepieciešamības gadījumā veiksi nelielus telpu kosmētiskos;
  • Pildīt citus ar teritorijas un saimniecības uzturēšanu saistītus uzdevumus.

Mēs piedāvājam:

  • Stabilu darbu un sociālās garantijas;
  • Nepieciešamo inventāru un darba apģērbu;
  • Darbu maiņās 4 darba dienas, 2-3 brīvdienas;
  • Bruto darba algu no 6 EUR/h  mēnesī, un motivējošu prēmiju sistēmu pēc pārbaudes laika;
  • Transportu no Jelgavas un no Saldus līdz ceptuvei “Lāči” un atpakaļ;
  • Bezmaksas naktsmītnes darba maiņās;
  • Subsidēto ēdināšanu;
  • Draudzīgu un atbalstošu kolektīvu.

Darba vieta: SIA “Lāči” Nr.40101006613, Rīgas-Liepājas šosejas 12.km., „Benūžu Skauģi”, Babītes
